descriptionHtml:
hackajob is collaborating with Barclays to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

Embark on a transformative journey as a VP - Product Owner, where you'll have to support change delivery managers in the delivery of successful projects, while ensuring that project management processes and practices are aligned with controls and governance standards and that projects are aligned with the organisation's strategic objectives.

Key Critical Skills Required For This Role Include

  • Candidate must be experienced as an agile Product Owner or Lead Product Owner.
  • Experience with Banks & Financial Institutions ideally with digital/ challenger banks will be added advantage.
  • Strong data focus and experience (candidate will be leading a Data Product delivery).
  • Candidate can be a technical product owner with strong tech & data background.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is based out of Pune.

Purpose of the role

To support change delivery managers in the delivery of successful projects, while ensuring that project management processes and practices are aligned with controls and governance standards and that projects are aligned with the organisation's strategic objectives.

Accountabilities

  • Support to change delivery managers, ensuring their programme is compliant with the Barclays Control Framework, including oversight of controls and governance standards.
  • Creation and implementation of standardised PMO processes and methodologies that are aligned with controls and governance standards and that support the delivery of successful projects.  .
  • Monitoring of project performance, including tracking of project progress, identification of risks assumptions, issues and dependencies, and creation of report on project status to senior management.
  • Support of project documentation, including maintenance of project plans, schedules, and budgets, and ensuring that project documentation is up-to-date and accurate.
  • Facilitation of project governance, including ensuring that projects are aligned with the organisation's strategic objectives, and that project risks assumptions, issues and dependencies are managed effectively.
  • Provision of change management framework training to project managers and other stakeholders, ensuring that they have the necessary skills and knowledge to deliver successful projects.  .
  • Continuous improvement of project management practices, including identification of areas for improvement and implementation of changes to improve project delivery.

Vice President Expectations

  • To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
  • If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
  • OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
  • Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
  • Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
  • Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
  • Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
  • Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
  • Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
  • Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
  • Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

You’ll work alongside dynamic and collaborative teammates.You'll play a pivotal role in driving innovation, ensuring the development and delivery of high-performing, cost-effective, and competitive bogie products that align with Alstom's mission for smarter and greener mobility. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (engineering, industrial, procurement, tender and costing), lead product roadmaps, and ensure the successful execution of programs, and much more.You’ll specifically take care of coordinating product strategies and roadmaps, as well as ensuring product readiness for tenders and projects, but also fostering collaboration across teams to achieve quality, cost, and delivery targets.We’ll look to you for:Representing the RSC Platform on-site and ensuring innovation, development, tendering, launch, and sustainability for assigned technologies and products Overseeing product portfolio management and ensuring alignment with the RS platform Leading product roadmap activities, including development, procurement, and industrial strategy Delivering QCD (Quality, Cost, Delivery) targets for programs Managing product validation and homologation processes to meet market regulations Driving product competitiveness through continuous improvement and Return of Experience (REX) All About YouWe value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:Master’s degree in a technical or equivalent field 10+ years of experience in product management Knowledge of product business and industrial environments Experience in transversal and/or international leadership roles Fluency in both English and French Strategic vision and ability to benchmark competition Strong management and organizational skills within a matrix environment Excellent communication skills and team-oriented mindset Proactive problem-solving and decision-making abilities Knowledge of the railway industry Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines Work with new security standards for rail signalling Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues Contribute to innovative projects Utilise our inclusive and flexible working environment Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning Progress towards senior leadership opportunities Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension) You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!Important to noteAs a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. descriptionHtml:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time Bogie Product Director in Bangalore we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your strategic vision and leadership expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside dynamic and collaborative teammates.

You'll play a pivotal role in driving innovation, ensuring the development and delivery of high-performing, cost-effective, and competitive bogie products that align with Alstom's mission for smarter and greener mobility. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (engineering, industrial, procurement, tender and costing), lead product roadmaps, and ensure the successful execution of programs, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of coordinating product strategies and roadmaps, as well as ensuring product readiness for tenders and projects, but also fostering collaboration across teams to achieve quality, cost, and delivery targets.

We’ll look to you for:

  • Representing the RSC Platform on-site and ensuring innovation, development, tendering, launch, and sustainability for assigned technologies and products
  • Overseeing product portfolio management and ensuring alignment with the RS platform
  • Leading product roadmap activities, including development, procurement, and industrial strategy
  • Delivering QCD (Quality, Cost, Delivery) targets for programs
  • Managing product validation and homologation processes to meet market regulations
  • Driving product competitiveness through continuous improvement and Return of Experience (REX)

All About You

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

  • Master’s degree in a technical or equivalent field
  • 10+ years of experience in product management
  • Knowledge of product business and industrial environments
  • Experience in transversal and/or international leadership roles
  • Fluency in both English and French
  • Strategic vision and ability to benchmark competition
  • Strong management and organizational skills within a matrix environment
  • Excellent communication skills and team-oriented mindset
  • Proactive problem-solving and decision-making abilities
  • Knowledge of the railway industry

Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

  • Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
  • Work with new security standards for rail signalling
  • Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
  • Contribute to innovative projects
  • Utilise our inclusive and flexible working environment
  • Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
  • Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
  • Progress towards senior leadership opportunities
  • Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Entain India is the engineering and delivery powerhouse for Entain, one of the world’s leading global sports and gaming groups. Established in Hyderabad in 2001, we’ve grown from a small tech hub into a dynamic force, delivering cutting-edge software solutions and support services that power billions of transactions for millions of users worldwide.

Our focus on quality at scale drives us to create innovative technology that supports Entain’s mission to lead the change in global sports and gaming sector. At Entain India, we make the impossible possible, together.


As Director of Product, you will be responsible for driving the vision, strategy, and execution of our product portfolio to deliver exceptional Core Platform & CRM products & services whilst achieving our business goals. You would develop and lead a world class team of product leaders across our locations and be responsible for your platform pillar experience within the Entain group for all our markets and all our brands.

In your role you are part of the Senior Product Leadership Team and will also be working with Entain’s Global Leadership, reporting to the CTO you will be part of the Platform Team.

Are you ready to launch a winning career?


What will you do:

  • You will develop and articulate a compelling and inspiring Core Platform and CRM product vision and strategy that delights our upstream services and customers. You will live and breathe the data and insights about your products, constantly seeking points of leverage that will help us achieve Entain’s broader goals and ambitions.
  • You will champion our transformation of the Platform by partnering with the Platform Engineering Director to modernise the Core Platform and CRM (reward) components which underpin all our businesses.
  • You will design a model for the core Player Account Management (PAM) services as a Platform-as-a-Service, enabling flexible integration and loose coupling.
  • You will use a techno-functional approach to design backend systems that support multiple micro frontend labels effectively.
  • You will develop, lead and coach a stellar team of product managers, guiding them in discovery, prioritization, and execution of product initiatives. By providing development, coaching, objectives and goal setting and performance management, you will ensure the team is motivated and productive, achieving real customer and business impact.
  • You will ensure that your product organisation is aligned with the broader company in pursuing the best opportunities, collaborating closely with cross-functional leaders including design, technology, compliance, commercial, finance and legal.
  • You will partner with technology and design teams to deliver a world class product offering, ensure quality, effective and timely product delivery. You will drive product metrics that demonstrate your product impact for our customers and our business. Aligning product direction and roadmap, you will be making trade-offs as necessary with key stakeholders across the business to deliver high-quality products at a predictable cadence.
  • You will serve as product evangelist both internally and externally. Present product updates and benefits to stakeholders, customers and partners


Qualifications:

  • Significant Product leadership experience managing and leading at a director level in a Product-Led organisation.
  • A demonstrated track record of successfully launching and iteratively scaling online products.
  • Strong understanding of the ecommerce landscape, including knowledge of regulations and compliance considerations when building great customer experiences.
  • Proven experience leading and developing high-performing empowered product teams.
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, analytical, and customer and business problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities, capable of collaborating with diverse teams and stakeholders.
  • Results-driven mindset with a focus on achieving business objectives while maintaining a player-centric approach.
  • Demonstrable evidence of influencing at senior levels of an organisation, the ability to get stakeholders and teams to buy-in into your product vision


Leadership responsibilities:

  • Set the vision and direction for the team, which aligns to our overall business strategy.
  • Provides effective and inspiring leadership and guidance to the teams, ensuring that they are working effectively and efficiently to achieve company goals.
  • Recruits, develops, and retains top talent, actively coaching people to develop and grow, creating development opportunities as they arise.
  • Build a high-performance team culture where outstanding performance is recognised, rewarded and celebrated.


Company Benefits

We know that signing top players requires a great starting package, and plenty of support to inspire peak performance. Join us, and a competitive salary is just the beginning.

Depending on your role and location, you can expect to receive benefits like:

  • Safe home pickup and home drop (Hyderabad Office Only)
  • Group Mediclaim policy
  • Group Critical Illness policy
  • Communication & Relocation allowance
  • Annual Health check

And outside of this, you’ll have the chance to turn recognition from leaders and colleagues into amazing prizes. Join a winning team of talented people and be a part of an inclusive and supporting community where everyone is celebrated for being themselves.

Supporting Actions

Scope

Business Needs Analysis & Translation

  • Recommend changes to unit / functions products, services and technology footprint to address market conditions and emerging trend
  • Displays a deep understanding of the industry, emerging customer / technology trends and perception of own company vis-à-vis competitors to help business determine business driven technology goals
  • Supervises documentation of business needs and related technology solutions to meet the technology goals

Business case development

  • Leads complex business case development and reviews business cases developed by others
  • Can clearly articulate the proposed technology use case, related financial analysis, risks, alignment with business strategy to stakeholders
  • Collaborates with relevant stakeholders to identify additional technology opportunities for the organization

Technology Scan

  • Applies best practices from other industries on new technology and communicates the same within team / unit /organization
  • Proactively seeks opportunities to identify and recommend changes to existing system applications to enable integration of emerging technologies by piloting Proof of Concepts

Customer Focus

  • Ensures that business continually responds to changing the needs of customer
  • Reviews and revises the customer segmentation strategy periodically to proactively meet their needs
  • Allocates time and resources to new segments and fosters new product / service development proactively
  • Drives a culture of service across the organization through own words and actions
  • Acts as the Business partner for the customer and owns the success / failure of the customer

Teamwork & Collaboration

  • Provides requisite authority, resources & support for the team to function & deliver
  • Breaks down barriers (structural, functional, cultural) between teams, facilitating the sharing of expertise and resources
  • Brings multiple stakeholders, both internal and external, to resolve issues in organization interest
  • Demonstrates collaboration by proactively looking for opportunities for jointly working with different Businesses of the Group
  • Listens actively to every peer, collaborates with them and makes them feel valued and important
  • Commands respect and credibility from colleagues/ peers-both internal and external
  • Encourages and assist others to develop people networks
  • Build long term relationships across a wide spectrum inside and outside the organization and leverages them, when required, to benefit the organization

Technology Digital Strategy Formulation

  • Leverages understanding of business and IT goals to provide input to the IT strategy
  • Conducts feasibility studies to outline risks and issues associated with proposed technology solutions
  • Escalates risks / benefits to though leader for further consideration before going forward with strategy changes and improvements

Demand Management

  • Leverages relationships with business stakeholders to promote usage of new technologies
  • Oversees expectations management of each unit to ensure that business needs are being met
  • Follows user trends and determine gaps that exist between services / application currently utilized as the needs that are presented

Strategic Vendor Selection & Management

  • Participate in larger supplier / partner selection, assists in setting, selection criteria and potential suppliers’ evaluation
  • Establishes supplier / partner relationship governance and reviews performance against defined SLAs
  • Raises service improvements when needed, manages issue and resolve disputes
  • Develops plans for specific business initiatives with vendors / business partners
  • Ensures full benefits to organization and IT are realized from third party agreements
  • Establishes relationship parameters, cost and scope through a clear statement of work

Setting up frameworks of standard & procedures

  • Understand project time frame, team, complexity, risk and resources
  • Sets up framework of standards and procedures
  • Visualizing trends during sprints
  • Direct team to allocate time to the tasks where their expertise makes a difference
  • To facilitate the team if there is any development blockages
  • Prioritise activities for meeting timelines

Agile Methodology adoption

  • Reviews all tasks within each Agile phase to ensure overall quality and accuracy
  • Identifies process improvements and implements solutions in Agile methodology

Product Design and Development

  • Manages multiple product portfolios
  • Design product testing policies and processes
  • Oversees Multiple product releases
  • Track the progress of the project and tasks related to them
  • Mitigate risks, increase members productivity levels
  • Keep business structure and other stakeholders updated on the work status on regular intervals

Requirement Gathering & Analysis (Understand client requirements to deliver right solutions)

  • Examines the entire business application from workflow and an end user perspective
  • Reviews business requirements from multiple user areas to ensure compatibility, Mediates for gaps, conflicts or inconsistencies across requirements
  • Implements new processes and tolls to gather requirements
  • Identifies all points of contact from the system perspective and communicates with relevant stakeholders
  • Identifies impact of proposed requirements and provides guidance around process improvement opportunities
  • Anticipates future requirements and customer needs, impacting the customer journey to enhance product and service offering and omni channel presence for different personas
  • Ensure sign off from operations/ treasury/ finance on the requirement specifications

Solution Design

  • Integrates functional design with overall architecture to support user requirements
  • Determines data and process distribution in a way that balances functionality with technical feasibility
  • Estimates solution cost, resource consumption and response time
  • Assesses the feasibility of an application for a given technical architecture

Change Management

  • Establishes a process that ensures the coherence of system objects and their relationship when the system is deployed
  • Establishes process with lines of business to monitor and track change
  • Ensure that known issues are documented and highlighted appropriately
  • Manage JIRA Sprints and deliveries for TRM module
  • Ensure JIRA process for all change requests for TRM Module

Incident & Problem Management (Application)

  • Assists in the development of policies, procedures and techniques in order to minimize future incident / problem occurrence
  • Implements applications / tools to maximize system integrity
  • Ensures that appropriate action is taken to investigate and resolve problems and documents within the relevant reporting system
  • Coordinates the implementation of agreed remedies and preventative measures

Service Level Management

  • Makes recommendations for Service level Improvement and executes on recommendations to improve
  • Develops and establishes new service levels
  • Measures service level improvements against identified benchmarks and key performance indicators
  • Resolves issues that disrupt operations
  • Monitors trends on SLA compliance overtime and Generates actionable insights
  • Identifies any outliers in terms of SLS compliance

Planning & Budgeting

  • Knowledge of forecasting / budgeting tools and techniques
  • Understands the inputs required to produce an accurate budgetary estimate
  • Analyses reports and provides summary to leadership

Contract Management

  • Operates within unit policy for vendor management
  • Applies the fundamentals of contract formulation when working with procurement to draw up an individual vendor or business partner agreement
  • Monitors vendor / business partner performance against contractual terms and conditions
  • Seeks feedback and performs actions to improve relationship

Miscellaneous

  • Support in handling audits and close observations shared by coordinating with stakeholders
  • Ensure DR, health checks and Business continuity Plan is performed as per process

Reports

  • Responsible for analyzing data and generating detailed reports which focus on relevant development metrics and KPI’s, focusing on the accomplished, planned and blocked tasks
  • Status of projects currently underway and reporting as per frequency

Project Management

  • Ensure quality & timelines are adhered to for all projects.
  • Develop detailed Project plans
  • Monitor adherence to plans to ensure timeliness of projects
  • Review and ensure desired quality of output

Join our India Tech Hub – Be among the first hires!

The Tech Hub will serve as a Global Capabilities Center for a broad range of technology roles, and this is your chance to play a pivotal role in shaping our presence in India. Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world’s most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty.

The Product Owner team makes Kobie's strategic product vision a reality through the development of technology solutions. We drive projects forward, collaborating with development teams and stakeholders to deliver unparalleled personalized experiences to customers worldwide. We are quick on our feet, using critical thinking and creative problem solving to optimize the value of products released. We champion platform standards to achieve long-lasting, quality outcomes that help our clients grow enterprise value through loyalty.

How You Will Make An Impact

  • Lead design and execution of roadmap enhancementsto Kobie Alchemy® Loyalty Cloud's loyalty decisioning (Experience Engine) and experience delivery (Producer) technology product suites.
  • Gather requirements across clients and industry verticals to identify scope and maximize reusability of new feature requests.
  • Manage the product backlogincluding dependencies, priority, sequence, strategy, and business objectives.
  • Identify and address challenges that arise during the product development lifecycle, collaborating with team members to find creative solutions and keep development on track.
  • Provide mechanisms for teams and stakeholders to view and track team and product work progress across releases and major product milestones.
  • Share vision and purpose for all product development efforts, gaininginterest and buy-in from various audiences, including business and technical roles at multiple levels of the organization.
  • Be a steward for excellence in your domain of expertise, advocating for and evolving platform standards while building the team's shared understanding.

What You Need To Be Successful

  • 7+ years working in a Product Owner, Business Systems Analyst, Product Manager, or similar role
  • Demonstrated experience driving Agile/Scrum delivery projects that involve web-based software development and 3rd party integrations via API and batch
  • Strong technical background, with a knack for translating concepts into language business and tech roles can understand

  • Loyalty product, program, or industry experience a plus

To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U.S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Product Owner

Location: Gcorp

Experience: 8–12 Years (preferred in BFSI / Lending Systems)

Role Overview

The Product Owner will be responsible for end-to-end ownership of the FinnOne application, primarily focusing on production support, issue resolution, and change request management. The role requires close coordination with business, operations, IT, and external vendors to ensure system stability, regulatory compliance, and timely delivery of enhancements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Production Support Management
  • Own and manage daily production support activities for the FinnOne application.
  • Ensure high system availability, stability, and performance.
  • Drive incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), and resolution within defined SLAs.
  • Coordinate with IT, infra, and vendor teams for issue triaging and fixes.
  • Monitor recurring issues and implement preventive/corrective actions.
  • Change Request (CR) Management
  • Gather, analyze, and prioritize business requirements and change requests.
  • Prepare functional specifications and user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate with vendors (e.g., Nucleus Software) for effort estimation and delivery timelines.
  • Track CR lifecycle from requirement to UAT to production release.
  • Ensure quality delivery through SIT/UAT and defect closure.
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Act as a single point of contact (SPOC) for business, operations, credit, and compliance teams.
  • Facilitate discussions for requirement finalization, prioritization, and solution design.
  • Provide regular status updates to management on issues, CRs, and releases.
  • Release & Deployment Management
  • Plan and coordinate production releases, deployments, and rollback strategies.
  • Ensure adherence to change management and audit requirements.
  • Support UAT cycles and sign-offs from business users.
  • Compliance & Audit Support
  • Ensure application changes align with regulatory and audit requirements (RBI, internal audits).
  • Maintain proper documentation, audit trails, and approvals.
  • Address audit observations and implement required system controls.
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and system enhancements.
  • Improve system efficiency, turnaround time (TAT), and user experience.
  • Drive optimization of workflows and data integrity.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of FinnOne (LOS/LMS) or similar lending platforms.
  • Experience in production support and incident management.
  • Strong understanding of loan lifecycle, lending operations, and interest/penal calculations.
  • Proven experience in change request and vendor management.
  • Familiarity with API integrations, system interfaces, and data flows.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and coordination skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Experience in NBFC/Banking domain.
  • Exposure to regulatory requirements and audit handling.
  • Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Key Success Metrics

  • System uptime and SLA adherence
  • Turnaround time for issue resolution
  • Timely delivery of change requests/releases
  • Reduction in recurring production issues
  • Stakeholder satisfaction

descriptionHtml:
Position Overview

Anaqua is expanding its development capability in Hyderabad to support and accelerate the evolution of the RightHub platform. We are looking for a strong, delivery-focused Product Owner to work locally with the Hyderabad engineering team and act as the day-to-day product partner for development squads building and enhancing the RightHub platform.

This role is ideal for someone who can bridge product strategy and engineering execution. The Product Owner will translate product direction, customer needs, roadmap priorities, and platform requirements into clear, actionable backlog items for the engineering team. They will work closely with global Product Managers and Product Leadership to ensure the Hyderabad team understands not only what needs to be built, but why it matters.

Experience in intellectual property management software, legal technology, SaaS, enterprise software, or workflow-heavy platforms is highly valuable, but not required. More important is the ability to learn a complex domain, communicate clearly, manage detail, and help engineering teams deliver high-quality software. Proficiency in AI automation using agents is a big plus.

You’ll Love This Job If You Enjoy

Product Ownership and Backlog Management

  • Own and manage the product backlog for one or more RightHub engineering squads in Hyderabad.
  • Translate roadmap priorities, product requirements, customer needs, and stakeholder input into well-structured user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure backlog items are clear, refined, prioritized, and ready for development.
  • Work with Product Managers and Product Leadership to understand strategic priorities and convert them into executable delivery plans.
  • Balance new feature development, technical improvements, customer commitments, defects, and platform modernization work.

Working Closely with Engineering

  • Serve as the primary local product contact for developers, QA engineers, architects, and technical leads.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups where appropriate, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Clarify requirements quickly and remove product-related blockers for the development team.
  • Support engineering in making sensible trade-offs between customer value, usability, technical feasibility, scalability, and delivery timelines.
  • Ensure the team has sufficient business and product context to make good implementation decisions.

Requirements and Acceptance Criteria

  • Write clear user stories, functional requirements, acceptance criteria, process flows, and edge-case scenarios.
  • Define expected product behavior across user roles, permissions, workflows, integrations, notifications, and data states.
  • Work with QA to ensure test scenarios reflect real customer usage and business-critical workflows.
  • Support UX/UI teams by providing context around user needs, business processes, and desired outcomes.
  • Validate completed work against acceptance criteria before release or handover.

Product and Domain Understanding

  • Develop a strong understanding of the RightHub platform, including its modules, architecture, customer workflows, and role within Anaqua’s broader product suite.
  • Build knowledge of intellectual property management processes, including patents, trademarks, deadlines, documents, matters, portfolios, renewals, docketing, and customer collaboration workflows.
  • Work with internal subject matter experts to understand the needs of law firms, corporate IP departments, and other platform users.
  • Ensure product decisions are grounded in customer value and operational reality.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Collaborate with global Product Managers and Product Leadership.
  • Help communicate development progress, risks, dependencies, and scope changes to relevant stakeholders.
  • Support demos, internal enablement, release preparation, and documentation where needed.
  • Act as a key connector between the Hyderabad engineering team and global product stakeholders.

Delivery Quality and Continuous Improvement

  • Help ensure that delivered functionality is complete, usable, reliable, and aligned with product expectations.
  • Identify areas where requirements, backlog processes, handoffs, or delivery ceremonies can be improved.
  • Support a culture of ownership, accountability, quality, and continuous learning within the team.
  • Contribute to stronger product delivery practices as the Hyderabad team scales.

Required Experience And Skills

  • Experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Product Manager, or similar role in a software product environment.
  • Strong experience working directly with software engineering teams in an Agile/Scrum delivery model.
  • Ability to write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional requirements.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to understand complex workflows, data structures, and business rules.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain product needs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage ambiguity.
  • Ability to prioritize effectively and make practical trade-offs.
  • Comfortable working with distributed teams across different time zones.
  • Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Figma, Miro, or similar product delivery tools.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, legal technology, intellectual property software, workflow automation, document management, CRM, ERP, or case/matter management platforms.
  • Familiarity with intellectual property processes (for example, patent and trademark management).
  • Experience working on platforms with complex permissions, configurable workflows, integrations, reporting, or multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
  • Experience supporting modernization of legacy platforms or development of cloud-native software.
  • Experience working with international product and engineering teams.
  • 5+ years of experience.

Personal Attributes

  • Delivery-focused and pragmatic.
  • Curious and willing to learn a complex specialist domain.
  • Comfortable asking questions and challenging assumptions constructively.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Able to build trust with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders.
  • Structured thinker who can turn ambiguity into clarity.
  • Customer-oriented, but commercially and technically realistic.
  • Calm under pressure and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by the Product Owner’s ability to:

  • Keep the Hyderabad engineering team supplied with clear, prioritized, and well-defined backlog items.
  • Improve the speed and quality of product delivery.
  • Reduce ambiguity and rework during development.
  • Build strong working relationships between local engineering teams and global product stakeholders.
  • Develop meaningful understanding of the RightHub platform and the IP management domain.
  • Help deliver platform capabilities that create real value for Anaqua customers.

Anaqua, Inc. is a premium provider of integrated intellectual property (IP) management technology solutions and services. Anaqua’s AQX platform combines best practice workflows with big data analytics and tech-enabled services to create an intelligent environment designed to inform IP strategy, enable IP decision-making, and streamline IP operations. Today, nearly half of the top 100 U.S. patent filers and global brands, as well as a growing number of law firms worldwide use Anaqua’s solutions. Over one million IP executives, attorneys, paralegals, administrators, and innovators in large and medium-sized companies use the platform for their IP management needs. The company’s global operations are headquartered in Boston, with offices across the U.S., Europe, and Asia. For additional information, please visit anaqua.com, or on LinkedIn.

Job Description

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Product Owner – Alternatives POD to join our Fund & Investor Services (FIS) Platform team. This role is located in India.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

  • Own end-to-end product strategy and delivery for Alternatives trade flows, aligned to platform priorities and client outcomes.
  • Lead the migration of legacy processing onto ATOMx, driving a clear transition plan and delivery against defined milestones.
  • Drive scalable and standardized processing that increases automation, improves straight-through processing, and reduces manual intervention and operational risk.
  • Define and prioritize the roadmap for Alternatives workflows, including complex asset lifecycles and non-standard events.
  • Partner with Operations, Technology, and Data teams to align delivery to processing models, control requirements, and platform strategy.
  • Act as the key coordination point across dependent PODs and platforms to manage dependencies and ensure consistent adoption of strategic flows.
  • Set clear ownership boundaries between Product, Operations, and Technology to ensure execution discipline and avoid duplication.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Extensive experience in asset servicing or post-trade environments, with strong exposure to Alternatives.
  • Proven experience operating at Director or Senior Vice President level as a Product Owner, Product Lead, or equivalent in a complex, regulated organization.
  • Strong understanding of trade lifecycle processing, particularly for complex or non-standard asset classes.
  • Experience delivering platform migration or transformation programs, including movement from legacy to strategic architecture.
  • Demonstrated ability to set clear direction, manage dependencies, and drive delivery across multiple teams.
  • Experience leading senior product or change professionals, with accountability for delivery outcomes.

About Us

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

About The Team

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom & BNY LinkedIn

Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards

  • America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
  • World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
  • “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025

Our Benefits And Rewards

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer - Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

About GMNS Product Team

As part of the Global Merchant & Network Services group (GMNS), the GMNS Product team is at the core of American Express, uniquely positioned to support every business unit and customer across the Enterprise. The American Express Network enables over $1.6 trillion in annual spend, serving our Issuers and Acquirers in more than 170 markets worldwide.

We are driving a strategic, multi-year Enterprise Payments program to bring all payments together into a centre of excellence to drive operational excellence for payment execution, enable innovative payment products, services, and capabilities to be built effectively and efficiently, support our BU strategies more closely, and deliver on our customers’ evolving payment needs.

About The Role

The Director Enterprise Payments Product Development is an exciting role, responsible for building modern, scalable enterprise payment capabilities and ensuring high quality predictable delivery across global markets. This role sits within the Enterprise Payments Centre of Excellence and partners closely with Product Management Architecture Engineering Operations and Market teams to translate product strategy into robust technical capabilities and platform solutions.

This leader will be accountable for shaping how Enterprise Payments capabilities are designed, built, and delivered, while driving modernization of legacy payment flows and scaling bank based money movement solutions globally and transforming how payment platforms are developed at American Express.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and grow a high performing product development organization responsible for delivering enterprise grade payment capabilities across Bill Payments, Money Movement, Multi-Rail initiatives
  • Translate enterprise and product management strategies into clear capability roadmaps, technical delivery plans and executable backlogs aligned to priorities
  • Lead discovery and technical solutioning for new payment flows, bank integrations and money movement capabilities supporting critical customer and business journeys
  • Own Product delivery outcomes for Enterprise Payments products including quality reliability scalability and time to market across global releases
  • Define and refine capabilities features user stories and acceptance criteria ensuring solutions meet functional regulatory operational and market needs
  • Balance global platform standardization with market specific requirements ensuring scalable solutions while meeting regulatory and local banking needs
  • Drive modernization of payment capabilities including migration from legacy solutions to resilient scalable and cloud enabled platforms where applicable
  • Establish and monitor delivery and performance metrics to improve predictability throughput quality and incremental value delivery
  • Champion modern product development and delivery practices including agile ways of working iterative value delivery and strong collaboration across teams

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of leadership experience leading Product Development, Product Management, Platform Engineering or a similar role.
  • Deep interest in payments and financial technology with experience or exposure to Bill Pay, A2A payments, ACH, RTP, wires or bank integrations strongly preferred
  • Proven experience building and leading high performing teams across multiple locations and working effectively in a global enterprise environment
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver enterprise platforms or shared services that support multiple business units and markets
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity make trade-offs and drive execution at scale
  • Ability to influence and partner effectively with senior leaders across Product Management Technology Operations and Business teams
  • Experience driving modernization initiatives and adopting new ways of working including scaled agile delivery models
  • Bachelor’s or Masters’ Degree in Engineering, Product, Business or related field.

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Competitive base salaries
  • Bonus incentives
  • Support for financial-well-being and retirement
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
  • Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
  • Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
  • Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
  • Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
  • Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

Job Description

About GMNS Product Team

As part of the Global Merchant & Network Services group (GMNS), the GMNS Product team is at the core of American Express, uniquely positioned to support every business unit and customer across the Enterprise. The American Express Network enables over $1.6 trillion in annual spend, serving our Issuers and Acquirers in more than 170 markets worldwide.

We are driving a strategic, multi-year Enterprise Payments program to bring all payments together into a centre of excellence to drive operational excellence for payment execution, enable innovative payment products, services, and capabilities to be built effectively and efficiently, support our BU strategies more closely, and deliver on our customers’ evolving payment needs.

About The Role

The Director Enterprise Payments Product Development is an exciting role, responsible for building modern, scalable enterprise payment capabilities and ensuring high quality predictable delivery across global markets. This role sits within the Enterprise Payments Centre of Excellence and partners closely with Product Management Architecture Engineering Operations and Market teams to translate product strategy into robust technical capabilities and platform solutions.

This leader will be accountable for shaping how Enterprise Payments capabilities are designed, built, and delivered, while driving modernization of legacy payment flows and scaling bank based money movement solutions globally and transforming how payment platforms are developed at American Express.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and grow a high performing product development organization responsible for delivering enterprise grade payment capabilities across Bill Payments, Money Movement, Multi-Rail initiatives
  • Translate enterprise and product management strategies into clear capability roadmaps, technical delivery plans and executable backlogs aligned to priorities
  • Lead discovery and technical solutioning for new payment flows, bank integrations and money movement capabilities supporting critical customer and business journeys
  • Own Product delivery outcomes for Enterprise Payments products including quality reliability scalability and time to market across global releases
  • Define and refine capabilities features user stories and acceptance criteria ensuring solutions meet functional regulatory operational and market needs
  • Balance global platform standardization with market specific requirements ensuring scalable solutions while meeting regulatory and local banking needs
  • Drive modernization of payment capabilities including migration from legacy solutions to resilient scalable and cloud enabled platforms where applicable
  • Establish and monitor delivery and performance metrics to improve predictability throughput quality and incremental value delivery
  • Champion modern product development and delivery practices including agile ways of working iterative value delivery and strong collaboration across teams

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of leadership experience leading Product Development, Product Management, Platform Engineering or a similar role.
  • Deep interest in payments and financial technology with experience or exposure to Bill Pay, A2A payments, ACH, RTP, wires or bank integrations strongly preferred
  • Proven experience building and leading high performing teams across multiple locations and working effectively in a global enterprise environment
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver enterprise platforms or shared services that support multiple business units and markets
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity make trade-offs and drive execution at scale
  • Ability to influence and partner effectively with senior leaders across Product Management Technology Operations and Business teams
  • Experience driving modernization initiatives and adopting new ways of working including scaled agile delivery models
  • Bachelor’s or Masters’ Degree in Engineering, Product, Business or related field.

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Competitive base salaries
  • Bonus incentives
  • Support for financial-well-being and retirement
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
  • Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
  • Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
  • Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
  • Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
  • Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

Project Description:

Luxoft DXC Technology Company is an established company focusing on consulting and implementation of complex projects in the financial industry. At the interface between technology and business, we convince with our know-how, well-founded methodology and pleasure in success. As a reliable partner to our renowned customers, we support them in planning, designing and implementing the desired innovations. Together with the customer, we deliver top performance!

Responsibilities:

Feature Delivery & Ownership

- Own and deliver multiple features per quarter, with varying complexity across multiple teams

- Ensure smooth delivery across all lifecycle phases: Design, Development, IST, ET, VT, and Production Implementation

- Validate and ensure that delivery timelines are achievable across each phase

Backlog & Requirements Management

- Participate actively in L2 refinement sessions to understand feature scope and priorities

- Decompose features into detailed user stories in collaboration with L1 teams and technical leads

- Maintain a well-defined, healthy, and prioritized backlog, ensuring readiness for sprint execution

- Drive backlog grooming and refinement sessions

Planning & Prioritization

- Perform feature planning in collaboration with L1 teams and engineering leads

- Drive priority decisions in alignment with L2 stakeholders

- Ensure alignment between business priorities, technical feasibility, and delivery timelines

Agile Execution & Team Leadership

- Actively participate in and lead Agile ceremonies: Daily Stand-ups (DSUs), Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives

- Step into Scrum leadership responsibilities (in the absence of Scrum Masters)

- Ensure teams follow Agile best practices and deliver incrementally

Capacity & Delivery Management

- Manage and optimize capacity across three Agile teams

- Ensure efficient utilization of team bandwidth while balancing delivery commitments

- Monitor sprint progress and proactively address delivery bottlenecks

Risk & Dependency Management

- Identify, track, and manage RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) for all features

- Proactively escalate critical risks to L2 stakeholders when required

- Ensure dependencies across systems, teams, and integrations are effectively managed

Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

- Act as the primary interface between L2 stakeholders and L1 teams

- Foster strong collaboration through co-location and active engagement with teams

- Ensure transparent and timely communication of progress, risks, and decisions

Core Banking Domain Responsibilities

- Drive delivery across core banking modules such as CASA (Current & Savings Accounts), Lending / Loans, Payments & Settlements, Customer Lifecycle Management

- Ensure high levels of transaction accuracy, data integrity, and system reliability

- Support integration with downstream and upstream banking systems

Regulatory & Compliance Responsibilities

- Ensure all features comply with banking regulations and guidelines (e.g., RBI, KYC, AML)

- Embed compliance, audit, and security requirements into product features and user stories

- Work closely with Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams

- Support regulatory audits, production readiness reviews, compliance reporting, and documentation

- Ensure adherence to data privacy and protection standards and transaction monitoring requirements

Mandatory Skills Description:

Overall 10+ years of experience in IT and Banking

- Proven hands-on experience (4+ years) as a Product Owner/ Business Analyst in Core Banking domain and working in an Agile product development environment, with demonstrated backlog ownership and delivery execution

- Strong knowledge of core banking platforms (e.g., Hogan, Finacle, T24, Flexcube)

- Deep understanding of Deposits (CASA) and different deposit products and their lifecycle (DDA, TDA/CDAs, etc.), Loans/Lending, Payments

- Good experience with backlog management tools (JIRA, DevOps, etc)

- Strong experience gathering requirements from stakeholders and end users and converting them into clear, testable user stories with acceptance criteria.

- Solid understanding of Agile frameworks (Scrum and/or Kanban) and active participation in Agile ceremonies

- Hands-on experience using Jira, Confluence, or similar tools for backlog management, documentation, and delivery tracking

- Ability to analyze business and data insights to drive prioritization and decision-making; SQL or reporting experience strongly preferred.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technology teams and across time zones



Key Competencie

n- Stakeholder Management and Communicatio

t- Analytical Thinking & Decision Makin

descriptionHtml:
Serko is a cutting-edge tech platform in global business travel & expense technology. When you join Serko, you become part of a team of passionate travellers and technologists bringing people together, using the world's leading business travel marketplace. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, we embrace the richness of diversity, showing up authentically to create a positive impact. There's an exciting road ahead of us, where travel needs real, impactful change.

With offices in New Zealand, Australia, North America, and China, we are thrilled to be expanding our global footprint, landing our growing and established hub in Bengaluru, India. With rapid a growth plan in place for India, we're hiring people from different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives to help us build a world-class team and product.

As one of the Directors of Product at Serko, you will oversee the development of platform shared services that creates the foundation for all of our travel product offerings. You will be responsible for setting and executing the product strategy and roadmap for those services in close collaboration with the Director of Engineering, Platform. In addition, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver exceptional products that meet customer needs and drive business success downstream from the platform delivery. It is expected that you will deliver AI-native platform services that will fuel Serko's most modern agentic products - as such, you will be expected to align and collaborate with other Directors of Product who will rely on the platform to make their product experiences come to life. Successful candidates are expected to demonstrate high levels of technical acumen and have a demonstrated track record of building world-class technology platforms (or similar shared technology services).


Requirements

What you'll do

Platform Product Strategy and Roadmap:

  • Closely collaborating with key stakeholders including Directors of Engineering for Platform, and Directors of Product of Serko's travel Products
  • Translates business strategy and product requirements into scalable, reusable capabilities that evolve shared services into a strategic asset. 
  • Independently anticipates future needs to drive operational efficiency and company-wide innovation with critical inputs from Directors of Product of Serko's travel products
  • Sets clear goals, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives
  • Curates and sequences the platform roadmap by balancing validated travel product demands with strategic priorities
  • Manages trade-offs between resourcing and platform investment. 

AI Innovation:

  • Implements modern technologies into platform product designs to ensure Serko's products are at the forefront of technology solutions for customers, including AI-native experiences
  • Leverages data and insights to drive continuous improvement of product delivery for platform

Stakeholder Communication:

  • Collaborates with product, technology and commercial (Revenue) peers to ensure platform delivery is aligned to company delivery, customer expectations and customer success
  • Communicates effectively with stakeholders, including executives, customers, and partners, to ensure alignment, support for product initiatives and report progress of platform delivery
  • Presents platform product strategies, roadmaps and updates to senior leadership, influencing decisions with compelling data insights

End-to-End Product Management:

  • Delivers world-class platform products that fuel e-commerce experiences for the corporate travel industry, from customer-facing tools to supply-side aggregation and partnerships with 3rd party plugins
  • Oversees the entire platform product lifecycle from ideation to launch, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality standards, while quickly and effectively solving any faults
  • Drives an AI-first platform agenda, ensuring infrastructure is designed to natively support model-driven and agentic product experiences (real-time inference, orchestration, and scalable data pipelines) as a default, not an add-on
  • Raises the bar on velocity with precision, embedding experimentation, automated testing (including model validation), and continuous delivery practices that enable rapid, confident shipping of AI-powered features
  • Owns the evolution of infrastructure as a direct product enabler, delivering scalable, observable, and governed systems that accelerate AI product delivery while meeting enterprise standards for reliability, security, and trust
  • Acts as a bridge between strategic and tactical execution, knowing when to zoom out to empower teams and when to zoom in to remove blockers

Collaborative Development:

  • Partners with cross-functional teams to drive customer outcomes from discovery to launch
  • Collaborates with other product teams  to develop compelling value propositions that drive product adoption and revenue growth

Performance Metrics and Optimization:

  • Defines and tracks key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure platform product success, impact on business objectives, and product adoption
  • Uses data-driven insights to optimize performance and inform strategic decisions in the most effective products to achieve Serko's business objectives

Leadership and Mentorship:

  • Fosters a collaborative and innovative team culture that encourages data-driven decision-making, creativity and continuous improvement
  • Acts as a mentor for other Product Managers across the company to support their ongoing professional development
  • Models AI-native principles in platform delivery encouraging the use and application of AI in platform product delivery
  • Mentor more junior product management staff, even in situations where no direct reporting lines exist, to ensure a continuous learning opportunity for our people

What you'll bring to the team

  • Demonstrable experience in strategic product leadership, demonstrating success in both strategic planning and hands-on execution in a high-growth technology company building technology infrastructure and platforms
  • Ability to translate complex engineering constraints and architectural trade-offs into clear product decisions and to translate travel product requirements back into technically precise platform inputs
  • Deep understanding of product management principles, methodologies, and best practices, especially for high-velocity product development of technology platforms and infrastructure
  • Experience in designing, building and optimizing API-first platforms and shared infrastructure to support e-commerce products with consumer-grade experiences on modern technologies (including AI agentic products)
  • Hunger to learn new technologies and implement ever evolving technological advances into product design and development
  • Strong evidence of analytical and problem-solving skills with experience in data-driven decision making, experimentation in product development, utilisation of data and research to inform product strategies and optimize performance
  • Proven expertise in data-driven decision making that drives continuous improvement in product development
  • Strong commercial acumen  and data-driven approach to decision-making and building products that drive business growth
  • Ability to balance long-term strategy with shorter-term tactical execution, ensuring both high-level vision and operational effectiveness
  • Exceptional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align cross-functional teams as well as work collaboratively across disciplines in the business
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, capable of conveying complex ideas, analytical results and complex business problems to diverse audiences
  • Strong adaptability and resilience, adept at navigating ambiguity, working in uncertainty and driving results in a fast-paced tech environment
  • Experience in the travel tech industry is preferred, or a demonstrated understanding of the unique challenges and opportunities in the business travel industry
  • Appetite to deeply understand the regulatory environment, the complex competitive landscape, and business trends of the evolving corporate travel industry

Benefits

At Serko we aim to create a place where people can come and do their best work.  This means you'll be operating in an environment with great tools and support to enable you to perform at the highest level of your abilities, producing high-quality, and delivering innovative and efficient results. Our people are fully engaged, continuously improving, and encouraged to make an impact.

  • Some of the benefits of working at Serko are:
  • A competitive base pay
  • Medical Benefits
  • Discretionary incentive plan based on individual and company performance
  • Focus on development: Access to a learning & development platform and opportunity for you to own your career pathways
  • Flexible work policy

Apply

Hit the ‘apply' button now, or explore more about what it's like to work at Serko and all our global opportunities at www.Serko.com .

You will be responsible for improving service quality, customer experience, provider performance, response times, and operational efficiency while translating frontline insights into product improvements.You will work closely with customer support, operations, product, engineering, and leadership teams to identify bottlenecks, build scalable workflows, improve internal tools, and ensure descriptionHtml:
About Amenify

Amenify is the leading AI-powered resident commerce platform in the US that helps property managers and residents with services they love. Through a proprietary network of local providers, enterprise integrations, and personalized concierge tools, Amenify powers services like local retail, dining, grocery, home services, maintenance, and more. Through its API integrations powering resident engagement, Amenify is available in 15 million homes in the USA. Amenify was founded in 2017 in San Francisco and has raised $25M to date. 


We encourage high-performers from all backgrounds to reach out, provided they share our core values listed here: https://www.amenify.com/about-us


About the Role

Amenify is seeking a strategic, execution-focused Director – Operations / Product to lead and scale our night-shift operations while partnering closely with leadership on product strategy, process automation, and operational excellence.

This role is ideal for a hands-on leader who can bridge day-to-day operational execution with long-term product thinking. You will be responsible for improving service quality, customer experience, provider performance, response times, and operational efficiency while translating frontline insights into product improvements.

You will work closely with customer support, operations, product, engineering, and leadership teams to identify bottlenecks, build scalable workflows, improve internal tools, and ensure the night operations team consistently delivers high-quality service.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, manage, and scale night-shift operations teams across multiple functions.
  • Ensure strong execution against key operational KPIs, including service quality, response time, fulfillment rate, issue resolution, customer satisfaction, provider performance, and SLA adherence.
  • Build scalable operational processes, workflows, playbooks, and escalation systems.
  • Drive continuous improvements in customer experience, provider experience, service reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Develop dashboards, reporting mechanisms, and performance metrics to track operational health and team productivity.
  • Lead workforce planning, capacity management, scheduling, and resource allocation for night operations.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and partner with cross-functional teams to implement practical, scalable solutions.
  • Create processes that improve accountability, reduce manual work, and increase consistency across teams.
  • Ensure night-shift operations run with urgency, discipline, and strong ownership.
  • Partner with customer, operations, product, and engineering teams to define product priorities and roadmap inputs.
  • Convert operational pain points, customer feedback, provider feedback, and team insights into clear product requirements.
  • Own requirements gathering, user stories, workflow documentation, testing, and product rollout initiatives.
  • Drive adoption of internal tools, automation, and product features that improve operational speed and accuracy.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive workflows, reduce errors, and improve team productivity.
  • Measure product success using operational and business metrics such as response time, resolution time, completion rate, customer satisfaction, provider satisfaction, and cost efficiency.
  • Act as the voice of operations in product discussions, ensuring tools are built for real-world execution and scalability.
  • Partner with leadership to prioritize product improvements that directly impact customer experience and operational efficiency.
  • Build, mentor, and develop high-performing night operations teams.
  • Manage team leads, managers, and individual contributors across multiple operational functions.
  • Create a culture of ownership, accountability, speed, quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Set clear goals, performance expectations, and operating rhythms for the team.
  • Drive coaching, performance management, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives.
  • Improve communication, escalation handling, and cross-functional collaboration across night-shift teams.
  • Foster a team environment where people are proactive, solutions-oriented, and focused on customer outcomes.


Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience across operations, product management, business operations, customer operations, or service delivery.
  • Proven experience leading and scaling large teams in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
  • Strong experience managing night-shift, support, marketplace, logistics, home services, customer operations, or service operations teams is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of operational metrics, process optimization, workforce planning, quality management, and service delivery.
  • Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to improve tools, automate workflows, and launch operational product improvements.
  • Ability to translate customer, provider, and operational feedback into structured product requirements.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience building dashboards, tracking KPIs, and using data to drive decisions.
  • Excellent problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
  • Experience building scalable operational processes, workflows, playbooks, and reporting systems from the ground up.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently own critical business outcomes and drive measurable improvements.
  • Comfortable operating in a startup environment with speed, ambiguity, changing priorities, and high accountability.
  • Willing and able to work night-shift hours.


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong operational leadership with a product-first mindset.
  • Ability to execute with urgency while thinking strategically.
  • Deep ownership, accountability, and follow-through.
  • Data-driven decision-making and comfort with operational metrics.
  • Strong bias toward process improvement, automation, and scalable systems.
  • Customer-obsessed approach to service quality and issue resolution.
  • Ability to lead teams through ambiguity, change, and rapid growth.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration with product, engineering, customer support, and leadership.
  • Passion for building high-performing teams, better tools, and scalable operating systems.


Why Join Us?

  • Above-industry salary, performance bonus, and monthly bonus opportunities.
  • Long-term stock option opportunities based on performance.
  • High-growth trajectory with rapid learning and career expansion.
  • Significant ownership of operations, product workflows, team performance, and business outcomes.
  • Direct 1:1 time with founders.
  • Team lunches, outings, and a collaborative work culture.
  • Competitive referral bonus program.
  • Opportunity to work with an ambitious, transparent, and fast-moving team.
  • Ability to directly shape the future of Amenify’s operations and product experience.


Meet Our Founders

  • Danish Chopra
  • Everett Lynn
