This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Owner | Senior based in India .

This is a senior product ownership role at the intersection of hardware and software, focused on building a unified productivity ecosystem designed to help users eliminate distractions and improve focus. You will own the end-to-end product experience across a smart physical device, mobile and desktop applications, and a growing set of integrations and automation capabilities. The role requires strong product judgment and the ability to turn complex, fast-moving inputs into clear priorities and executable plans. You’ll work closely with engineering, design, and cross-functional teams to ensure product coherence across all surfaces. Success in this role means shaping not just features, but a cohesive system that drives activation, retention, and long-term engagement. The environment is fast-evolving, highly experimental, and deeply user-focused, with significant ownership and autonomy from day one.

Accountabilities

  • Own and evolve the product as a unified ecosystem spanning hardware, mobile apps, desktop applications, and integrations, ensuring consistent user experience across all surfaces.
  • Define, structure, and prioritize the product roadmap, translating feedback, data, and strategic goals into clear delivery plans.
  • Design and refine key user journeys such as focus modes, timers, distraction blocking, status systems, and automation workflows.
  • Align hardware and software behavior to ensure seamless interaction between device, applications, and third-party integrations.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and design teams to define requirements, user flows, and acceptance criteria for new features.
  • Monitor product performance metrics including activation, retention, engagement, and repeat usage, using insights to guide prioritization.
  • Coordinate product direction across design, engineering, marketing, support, and operations to maintain a coherent product vision.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, or Product Leadership roles with end-to-end responsibility for digital products.
  • Strong ability to operate at the intersection of hardware and software, with an understanding of system-level product design.
  • Proven experience turning ambiguous inputs into structured roadmaps, priorities, and clear product requirements.
  • Comfortable working with technical concepts such as APIs, integrations, device behavior, and cross-platform architecture.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to write precise, structured, and actionable product documentation.
  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers and designers in agile, fast-paced environments.
  • Strong product judgment grounded in user behavior, data, and practical constraints rather than intuition alone.
  • Ability to protect focus and ensure roadmap discipline in complex, fast-moving product environments.
  • Nice-to-have: experience with consumer hardware, productivity tools, behavioral UX, automation, or community-driven products.

Benefits

  • Fully remote work from anywhere in the world.
  • Provided equipment to ensure a productive and comfortable work setup.
  • Benefits package including private healthcare (VHI), corporate sports programs, language courses, and therapy support.
  • Flexible working model with a five-day workweek and adaptable start times.
  • Opportunity to build and scale a category-defining productivity ecosystem spanning hardware and software.

About Freshworks

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.

Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.

Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.



Job Description

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Vision & Strategy: Define and drive the long-term design vision and strategy for integrated product portfolios.

  • User advocacy: Champion a deep understanding of users to ensure products are not just functional, but indispensable.

  • Cross-functional alignment: Collaborate with senior leadership in Product Management and Engineering to create a cohesive product strategy that anticipates market trends and user needs.

  • Executive communication: Evangelize the power of design thinking to solve complex challenges, presenting strategies and concepts to executive stakeholders.

  • Team leadership: Lead, mentor, and expand a world-class product design team, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

  • Design execution: Oversee the entire design lifecycle:

    • Partner with our Research leader to drive foundational understanding of our user base.

    • Partner with our PM leaders to drive a design strategy that is focused on revenue growth, and long term retention

    • Drive design excellence with your product design team. Ensure deliverables are of high quality.

    • Evangelize the work - Regular updates to leadership, as needed.

  • Design systems: Partner with the Design systems leader to ensure the system serves the product needs, and stays up to date with the innovations being made in the product portfolio.

  • Data-informed process: Insist on a data-informed approach, leveraging user analytics and qualitative research to validate hypotheses and measure the impact of design solutions.

  • Supercharge team velocity: Transform the design team's operational efficiency by embedding AI into daily workflows, moving beyond personal productivity to fundamentally accelerate how quickly and effectively the team delivers enterprise-grade experiences.

Impact You Will Create

  • Drive business growth: Transform business software from a blocker into a tool that propels growth by creating better experiences for customers and employees.

  • Simplify complexity: Make the most complex processes simple, intelligent, and efficient.

  • Drive customer retention: You are customer obsessed. You advocate for a deep understanding of our customers, the ICP, and their unmet needs. This advocacy should directly tie to improved CSAT and overall better retention (NDRR).

  • Enhance productivity: Eliminate friction to make employees more effective and organizations more productive.

  • Deliver actionable insights: Tackle the immense challenge of visualizing complex relationships, streamlining critical workflows, and turning massive amounts of operational data into actionable insights.

Champion AI-Augmented design operations: Act as an early adopter and evangelist for integrating AI technologies into the end-to-end design lifecycle. Operationalize AI tools for rapid prototyping, generative asset creation, and automated research analysis to exponentially increase your team's output and elevate the quality of their strategic work.



Qualifications

  • Experience: 15 years in product design, with at least 5 years managing managers and senior ICs (Principal, Sr.Staff level).

  • Domain Expertise: Extensive experience designing complex, data-rich enterprise SaaS applications.

  • Portfolio: A compelling portfolio that showcases leadership and design work on products involving complex workflows, data visualization, and systems thinking.

  • Leadership Record: Proven ability to build, manage, and motivate high-performing design teams in a competitive technology landscape.

  • Technical Acumen: A strong aptitude for understanding highly technical domains and the ability to translate that complexity into simple, intuitive user experiences.

  • AI Adoption Record: Demonstrable experience integrating AI tools and methodologies into a design team's workflow at scale, with clear examples of how this adoption improved the overall velocity and quality of the team's deliverables.

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, or a related field.



Additional Information

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director, Product Operations

Director, Product Operations, Interchange Governance

Overview

The Director, Network Products, will join a team driving the product strategy, roadmap, and execution of Mastercard’s global core payments network—one of the company’s most critical strategic assets, directly generating over $8B in revenue and enabling a broad portfolio of products and services.

The ideal candidate is a proven, forward thinking leader who collaborates effectively across business, pricing, and technology organizations. This role partners closely with Global and Regional Pricing and Engineering teams to deliver operationally ready, market leading solutions. Responsibilities include leading teams accountable for documentation, governance, and enablement to improve customer experience, speed to market, and operational excellence. The role’s objective is to deliver a globally standardized, transparent, and scalable interchange governance model while improving implementation quality, customer satisfaction, and enterprise alignment.

The Role

The Director of Interchange Governance provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for Mastercard’s global interchange capability. The role owns interchange governance, enablement, and execution, and is accountable for accelerating time to market, standardizing processes, and ensuring high quality, customer centric implementations across all regions.

  • Define and own the global Interchange operating model, including governance, decision frameworks, standardized processes, and global documentation across all regions and engineering.
  • Establish and lead a Single Door Entry governance model for all Interchange requests globally, ensuring transparency, prioritization, capacity management, and consistent decision-making.
  • Set the strategic direction for Interchange enablement, aligning enterprise objectives, growth priorities, regulatory requirements, and evolving customer needs.
  • Serve as the executive escalation point for complex, high-impact, or cross-regional Interchange initiatives.
  • Drive speed to market by reducing implementation timelines through process optimization, tooling improvements, and cross-functional alignment.
  • Lead an agile, scalable implementation model that balances speed, quality, and risk while enabling flexibility for regional market nuances.
  • Oversee global Interchange demand intake and solutioning, ensuring technical feasibility, alignment to governance, and consistency with global standards.
  • Partner with global and regional pricing, product, and technology teams to align roadmaps, readiness, and execution.
  • Champion customer-centric implementation and testing practices, increasing customer engagement, improving quality, and ensuring compliance with operational and regulatory standards.
  • Drive enterprise enablement and continuous improvement through training, implementation playbooks, stakeholder communications, KPIs, and data-driven performance insights.


About You

  • Brings deep expertise in the payments industry, including strong hands on knowledge of Interchange and GCMS, with a proven understanding of the Mastercard ecosystem and how technology delivery drives business outcomes.
  • Operates with a high degree of independence and accountability, demonstrating sound judgment and end to end ownership of program delivery.
  • Builds strong, trusted relationships across the organization and effectively influences stakeholders at all levels, including senior and executive leadership, while establishing credibility with cross functional teams.
  • Demonstrates strong people leadership by attracting, developing, and retaining top talent, and fostering an environment that promotes growth, accountability, and high performance.
  • Apply continuous improvement principles to enhance delivery frameworks, operational processes, and overall team efficiency.
  • Makes thoughtful, data driven decisions by assessing risks, managing trade offs, and resolving escalations in fast moving, complex environments.
  • Leverages emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, to improve program management practices, increase operational efficiency, and support more informed decision making.
  • Exhibits a self starter mindset with a strong ability to learn quickly, work independently, thrive in fast paced environments, and adapt to shifting priorities while managing multiple responsibilities.
  • Possesses exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage, lead, and influence stakeholders across all levels of the organization, as well as internal and external partners.
  • Demonstrates strong visual storytelling capabilities, including data visualization and the creation of clear, compelling executive level presentations.
  • Brings strong project management capabilities, with demonstrated excellence in organization, planning, and task execution.
  • Is a highly collaborative partner, able to work effectively across functions to drive shared outcomes.


Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

About The Role

We are looking for a Product Owner to join our delivery team for a fintech client engagement in the consumer lending and payments space. You will work closely with the client and our engineering team to define, prioritise, and ship product across a mobile-first platform. This is a hands-on execution role suited for someone comfortable owning a backlog end-to-end in a fast-paced agile environment.

What you will do

  • Own and prioritise the product backlog — user stories, PRDs, and acceptance criteria
  • Run agile ceremonies — sprint planning, grooming, and retrospectives with the dev team
  • Act as the primary interface between the client and the internal delivery team
  • Define and track key product metrics — activation, engagement, and retention
  • Coordinate third-party integrations such as KYC, payment gateways, and APIs
  • Ensure product decisions align with compliance and regulatory requirements relevant to fintech

What we are looking for

  • 4–6 years in product management or product ownership, preferably in fintech, lending, or payments
  • Experience shipping mobile app products (Android/iOS) end to end
  • Solid understanding of consumer-facing financial products — credit, billing, repayment flows
  • Familiarity with Indian payment ecosystem — UPI, NACH, payment aggregators
  • Strong agile execution skills — backlog management, user story writing, sprint delivery
  • Proficiency with Figma or equivalent for wireframing and flow documentation
  • Clear, structured communicator — both written and verbal

Good to have

  • Exposure to BNPL or short-cycle credit products
  • Understanding of KYC/AML flows and digital onboarding
  • Working knowledge of SQL for pulling product metrics independently
  • Experience managing merchant-side or B2B product alongside a consumer app

At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk.

Role: Director of Product Operations

The Director of Product Operations role exists to define, drive adoption and accountability of an efficient software development lifecycle at Arctic Wolf. This individual will own codification of the product management outcomes through the SDLC, ensuring consistency in product management-specific documentation, standards, and training; owning the strategy and implementation for any product management specific SDLC tooling and to drive consistent adoption and accountability. This role will monitor the implementation of the SDLC to ensure the product management organization is consistently driving to the standard, identifying gaps, and driving solutions in collaboration with PM leaders.

The Director of Operations is a strategic and execution‑focused leader responsible for driving operational excellence across the organization. This role oversees cross‑functional processes, ensures alignment between product, engineering, and business teams, and establishes scalable operational frameworks that enable growth and efficiency. The Director of Operations will partner closely with senior leadership to define operational strategy, optimize performance, and ensure organizational readiness as the business evolves.

A key component of this role is serving as a subject matter expert (SME) in the Aha! product management platform or demonstrating significant experience with a comparable product management tool, ensuring strong transferable skills in product planning, roadmapping, workflow management, and cross‑team coordination.

Primary Responsibilities And Duties

  • Develop, implement, and continually refine operational strategies, processes, and systems that support organizational goals.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that drive efficiency, operational alignment, and predictable delivery.
  • Establish and manage performance metrics, operational dashboards, and reporting frameworks to monitor progress and inform decision‑making.
  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Program Management to streamline workflows, prioritize initiatives, and support successful execution of product roadmaps.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement solutions that improve throughput, quality, and scalability.
  • Lead operational planning cycles, including annual planning, resourcing, and sequencing of strategic initiatives.
  • Standardize processes, documentation, and governance to ensure clarity, accountability, and operational consistency across teams.
  • Manage risk assessment and mitigation strategies, ensuring operational reliability.
  • Serve as the organizational subject matter expert in Aha! or a similar product management tool, enabling teams to drive adoption, optimize usage, and leverage data for decision‑making.
  • Support onboarding, training, and best‑practice integration for operations‑related tools and processes.
  • Influence and support change‑management efforts to ensure smooth integration of new systems, tools, and methodologies.
  • Influence
    • Provide scalable solutions, like recorded training, best practices, templates, targeted coaching to product managers to facilitate the creation of high quality epics throughout the product lifecycle; supporting clear understanding of problems, suggested implementations and success metrics, and an effective refinement process with engineering
    • Ensure product managers are creating and using effective, meaningful success metrics; In partnership with PMO, drive a process that regularly reviews deliverables against success criteria
    • Assist product management leaders with best practices and tactics to drive product manager involvement throughout the entire SDLC to enable consistent communication of value, rapid problem solving, and quick scope adjustment
    • Assist product management leaders with standard process for user acceptance test (beta, EAP, Design partners) and enabling cross-functional collaboration
    • Ensure Product Marketing are embedded early and often in the product development lifecycle and the software development lifecycle
    • Drive processes to enable high-impact UX engagement throughout the SDLC process so that UX time can be invested on the highest value work
    • Foster an environment with early and often cross-functional collaboration and involvement (IT, ProdSec, Legal, GTO, S2, etc)
    • Facilitate quick decision-making by acting as the point of contact for prioritization assistance
  • Own
    • Product Organization Fiscal Year Annual Operating Planning process
    • Product Organization Quarterly Business Review process
    • Product Development Process and tools– “Product Manager of the Product Management process and implementation”; identify hotspots in the process to address and identify coaching opportunities; Develop a cadence of spot-checking product management processes as teams move through the development process to identify areas of growth for the teams and undesired friction in the process
    • Identify opportunities to bring knowledge and data that provide value across all product management teams; implement ways to enable self-serve access to that knowledge and data
    • Implement and maintain a road-mapping process that allows for efficient support of greenlight process requirements and consistently communicates and delivers customer and stakeholder value
    • Own Product Management specific tooling (usage, contracting, mgmt); Drive consistent, standardized and efficient usage our tooling (Aha!, Jira, Confluence, XLS), determine what the right tool is for the outcome
    • Own the pieces of the SDLC with product involvement; enable a culture of continuous learning and improvement; monitor the effective implementation of the SDLC, identify opportunities for tooling, process and people improvements and drive a metrics-oriented view of the health of the PM components of the SDLC
    • Own and drive a set of metrics in support of the SDLC and at the discretion of the product SVP, to support the product lines as a whole function
    • Own the business case template and lifecycle – from pitch through launch, ensuring clear reporting against goals throughout the lifecycle
    • Own the product line strategy templates and lifecycle – Ensuring strategies include 3yr plan, where are you going, how you are going to win, supporting research; clear reporting against strategic goals for AWN

Key Skills

  • Strong operational strategy development and execution abilities
  • Exceptional Product Management Knowledge – This role is the Product Manager of the Product Management process; must have a deep, experiential knowledge of product management and be able to translate that experience into best practices, templates and standardization
  • Excellent cross-functional leadership, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills
  • Expertise in scaling processes, optimizing workflows, and implementing operational frameworks
  • Ability to analyze complex data, identify trends, and make data‑driven decisions
  • Strong problem‑solving, critical thinking, and organizational skills
  • High proficiency with operational and productivity tools
  • Deep experience with Aha! or strong transferable expertise from similar tools (e.g., Jira Advanced Roadmaps, Productboard, Monday.com, etc.)
  • Ability to influence without authority and build strong relationships across teams
  • High EQ; able to build consensus without direct authority through ‘disagree and commit’ style agreements; Exemplary communicator across all mediums (Slack, Video, Email, Powerpoint, Word); Ability to influence and align across many stakeholder groups
  • Strong presentation and executive communication skills
  • Continuous Learner – researching new things to get better
  • “Left Shift the problems” – driving towards continuous improvement as a culture Streamline Process to get the right outcomes– identify bottlenecks, and come up with solutions to remove the bottlenecks; implement scalable processes across product teams
  • Extensive Agile SDLC experience, frameworks and tools
  • Tempo Setter – not just a braintrust, evangelist of the process – driving culture and setting a tone; Advocate for excellence in the process – create a sense of spirit across teams; celebrate accomplishment & achievement, reinforcing good behaviors

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Product Management, or related field
  • 8+ years of experience in operations, program management, product operations, or a similar discipline
  • Proven experience leading cross‑functional initiatives in a complex, fast‑paced environment
  • Demonstrated ability to build and optimize operational processes
  • Experience with Aha! or equivalent product‑management tools
  • Strong analytical and reporting capabilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree (MBA or related discipline)
  • 10–12+ years of experience in operations leadership roles
  • Experience supporting product or technology organizations at scale
  • Certification in Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or similar methodologies
  • Prior responsibility for tool governance, configuration, and enablement of Aha! or comparable platforms
  • Experience in change management, organizational design, or operational maturity transformation
  • Background in software or technology‑focused environments

Don’t meet all the requirements? That’s okay! We still want you to apply. We have many opportunities, and we are always looking for top talent.

Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. descriptionHtml:
Job Description

As a Product Owner, you will be responsible for translating business objectives into actionable product features. This role involves managing the product roadmap, collaborating closely with stakeholders, and ensuring smooth execution. Your expertise in Agile methodologies and stakeholder management will be key to delivering high-quality products.

Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the product roadmap, ensuring timely and effective delivery.
  • Refine the backlog, prioritize tasks, and write clear user stories with measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, development teams, and QA to deliver exceptional features.
  • Present clear, focused updates to stakeholders and leadership, keeping them informed.
  • Act as the primary liaison, fostering a shared understanding between business and technology teams.
  • Synthesize stakeholder inputs into well-defined priorities and decisions.
  • Support Agile ceremonies, promoting an iterative delivery approach.
  • Ensure delivery plans align with hardware dependencies and vendor timelines when applicable.
  • Translate business requirements into user stories, considering business value and constraints.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Product Owner, Manager, or Analyst roles with delivery ownership.
  • Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum teams in iterative delivery environments is a must.
  • Experience with hardware-involved products and vendor coordination is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of business objectives and their translation into product requirements.
  • Ability to prioritize work based on business value, stakeholder needs, and delivery constraints.
  • Proven track record in translating business requirements into user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a focus on collaboration.
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments with multiple teams.
  • Proficiency in Agile tools like Linear, Jira, and Azure DevOps, and documentation platforms.
  • Experience with planning and presentation tools such as PowerPoint, Google Slides, and Miro.

About Us

At Zensar, we’re “experience-led everything”. We are committed to conceptualizing, designing, engineering, marketing, and managing digital solutions and experiences for over 130 leading enterprises. We are a company driven by a bold purpose: Together, we shape experiences for better futures. Whether for our clients, our people, or the world around us, this belief powers everything we do. At the heart of our culture is ONE with Client - a set of four core values that reflect who we are and how we work: One Zensar, Nurturing, Empowering, and Client Focus.

Part of the $4.8 billion RPG Group, we’re a community of 10,000+ innovators across 30+ global locations, including Milpitas, Seattle, Princeton, Cape Town, London, Zurich, Singapore, and Mexico City. Explore Life at Zensar and join us to Grow. Own. Achieve. Learn. to be the best version of yourself.

We believe the best work happens when individuality is celebrated, growth is encouraged, and well-being is prioritized. We are an equal employment opportunity (EEO) and affirmative action employer, committed to creating an inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, marital status, family medical leave status, or protected veteran status.

descriptionHtml:
AI Product Owner

Work mode: Remote

Notice period: Immediate joiners


So, what’s the role all about?

We are seeking an AI Product Owner to own and drive end-to-end internal AI initiatives across NiCE, turning AI from experimentation into measurable productivity gains. You will be the single accountable owner for internal AI transformation solutions that fundamentally change how core processes work across IT, HR, Finance, Sales, and other business functions. You will lead initiatives where AI agents significantly automate end-to-end processes (e.g., recruitment, finance operations, internal IT workflows), partnering with our internal AI delivery teams and business stakeholders to move from idea to live, adopted, value-generating AI solutions.


How will you make an impact?


You will own the full lifecycle of cross-functional AI initiatives: from opportunity framing through delivery, adoption, and measured outcomes. You will redesign business processes, translate business needs into actionable AI initiatives, and coordinate delivery with the IT AI Center of Excellence and business stakeholders.

This is a high-impact role for someone who combines strong business analysis with project leadership, thrives on driving concrete outcomes under ambiguity, and is energized by leading AI transformation across multiple business areas.



Project Ownership & Accountability

  • Own the full lifecycle of cross-functional AI initiatives, from opportunity framing through production rollout, adoption, and measured impact
  • Act as the single accountable owner for each AI transformation solution, with dedicated focus and clear lines of accountability
  • Drive concrete outcomes even when the solution is evolving or exploratory at the start; manage risks, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment proactively

Business Process Leadership

  • Analyze business processes deeply; identify where AI agents can automate, accelerate, or rethink existing work
  • Translate business needs into actionable AI initiatives with clear scope, success metrics, owners, and timelines
  • Partner with Finance, HR, IT, Sales, and other functions to redesign processes around agent-driven automation
  • Work hand-in-hand with the IT AI Center of Excellence

Outcomes & Impact

  • Partner with the AI analysts to define and report measurable impact: hours saved, cycle-time reduction, deflection, adoption, and ROI
  • Ensure every initiative reaches production with documented handover to operations and ongoing ownership


Have you got what it takes?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Information Systems or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience as a technical project manager/product manager with proven business analysis capabilities, of which at least 1 year was hands-on with AI projects
  • Familiarity with Anthropic Claude, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or similar agent platforms
  • Solid understanding of AI agents, automation, and how AI reshapes the way processes are designed
  • Experience with leading complex, cross-functional projects, ideally combining transformation, automation, or digital programs
  • Demonstrated experience leading products that change how a process works, not only deliver software

  • Skills & Competencies:

    • Analyst + PM hybrid: strong business process analysis combined with product leadership - able to map a process end-to-end and drive its transformation
    • Comfort leading initiatives where the solution is evolving; able to drive toward concrete outcomes under ambiguity
    • Strong stakeholder management across business and technology functions, up to executive level
    • Excellent written and verbal communication; full professional fluency in English


    Regards,

    Aravindhan

description: Role Summary:- The Product Owner is responsible for managing complex business requirements, driving solution discussions, and ensuring successful delivery of product capabilities across domains and systems.The role requires strong product thinking, insurance domain expertise, and the ability to operate effectively in AI-enabled delivery environments. The Product Owner is expected to leverage AI-assisted workflows to improve speed, quality, traceability, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration.The Product Owner is a member of the Product Management team of IDIT R&D, responsible for managing requirements for complex features in the system. Should have some technical experience before transitioning to a BA/Product role.  Insurance or BFSI experience is a must.  Prior knowledge of Core Insurance is a must.  Experience of having worked in at least one implementation project.  Led end-to-end requirements for at least 2 modules. Key Responsibilities Product & Requirement Ownership  Gather business requirements for medium to complex features and interfaces in the system (Contact/Policy, Claims/Accounting/Interfaces).  Document requirements in SDS.  Analyse and prioritize defects.  Conduct requirement discussions with Product Managers, Domain Managers, and customers.  Conduct walkthroughs of requirements with development and QA teams.  Attend daily stand-ups.  Conduct User Forums.  Conduct training sessions for junior members of the team. descriptionHtml:
Role Summary:-

The Product Owner is responsible for managing complex business requirements, driving solution discussions, and ensuring successful delivery of product capabilities across domains and systems.

The role requires strong product thinking, insurance domain expertise, and the ability to operate effectively in AI-enabled delivery environments. The Product Owner is expected to leverage AI-assisted workflows to improve speed, quality, traceability, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration.

The Product Owner is a member of the Product Management team of IDIT R&D, responsible for managing requirements for complex features in the system. The candidate should be able to run workshops with domain managers, Product Managers, and customers to elicit requirements, present solution designs, and take requirements through to implementation.

Pre-requisites

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT preferred) or equivalent qualification.
  • MBA preferred.

Experience

  • 6–9 years of relevant experience.
  • Should have some technical experience before transitioning to a BA/Product role.
  • Insurance or BFSI experience is a must.
  • Prior knowledge of Core Insurance is a must.
  • Experience of having worked in at least one implementation project.
  • Led end-to-end requirements for at least 2 modules.

Key Responsibilities

 Product & Requirement Ownership

  • Gather business requirements for medium to complex features and interfaces in the system (Contact/Policy, Claims/Accounting/Interfaces).
  • Document requirements in SDS.
  • Analyse and prioritize defects.
  • Conduct requirement discussions with Product Managers, Domain Managers, and customers.
  • Conduct walkthroughs of requirements with development and QA teams.
  • Attend daily stand-ups.
  • Conduct User Forums.
  • Conduct training sessions for junior members of the team.
  • Work as a core representative to project teams as needed.
  • Convert business requirements into Epics, Features, User Stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Drive end-to-end solution discussions across Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, and Delivery teams.
  • Perform impact analysis across modules, systems, and business processes.
  • Prioritize backlog items aligned to business outcomes and roadmap objectives.
  • Ensure traceability from business requirements to implementation and validation.
  • Support product roadmap execution and release planning.

AI-Enabled Responsibilities

  • Use AI tools to accelerate requirement analysis, documentation, prioritization, and workshop preparation.
  • Use AI-assisted techniques for: story generation, acceptance criteria generation, process mapping, impact analysis, test scenario generation, SQL/query generation, knowledge retrieval, and defect analysis.
  • Validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, feasibility, traceability, hallucinations, and bias.
  • Use AI-enabled insights to improve delivery efficiency and decision-making.
  • Contribute reusable prompts, templates, and AI-assisted delivery assets.
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled ways of working within teams.
  • Apply responsible AI practices including governance, explainability, privacy, and human oversight.

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong understanding of insurance processes and core insurance systems.
  • Experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or Solution Design.
  • Ability to manage complex cross-functional requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills.
  • Experience with Agile delivery methodologies.
  • Strong analytical and prioritization capabilities.
  • Working knowledge of APIs, integrations, and enterprise systems.
  • Excellent analytical skills and good design skills.
  • Intermediate SQL and data modelling skills (mandatory).
  • Understanding of SDLC and Agile concepts (mandatory).
  • Very good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to document business requirements as user stories; break large epics into smaller features and stories and document them in SDS.
  • Ability to conduct demos and walkthroughs with POs and business users.
  • Techno-functional and business solutioning capability.
  • Ability to effectively leverage AI-enabled delivery tools.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with AI-enabled delivery platforms and workflows.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering and AI-assisted analysis.
  • Exposure to digital transformation initiatives.
  • Exposure to Agentic AI concepts and orchestration-based workflows.

Key Characteristics

  • Outcome-oriented mindset.
  • Strong ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to balance speed with quality and governance.
  • Systems thinking and cross-domain understanding.
  • Coaching and mentoring mindset.

You will work in a fast-paced, international environment alongside cross-functional teams including analytics, design, and engineering. Accountabilities

  • Own and continuously improve the post-payment customer journey across core product experiences, ensuring users reach meaningful engagement quickly and consistently.

  • Identify friction points in discovery, recommendation, and matching flows, and design solutions to improve relevance and user satisfaction.
  • Optimize the quality and personalization of offers, invites, and recommendations based on user behavior and preferences.
  • Define and refine customer segmentation strategies to tailor experiences to different user needs and expectations.
  • Collaborate closely with analytics, engineering, and design teams to test hypotheses, measure impact, and iterate on solutions.
  • Develop engagement and reactivation mechanics, including personalization, gamification, and communication tools to improve retention and value realization.

Requirements

  • Strong experience in B2C product management, ideally in platforms with complex discovery, matching, or recommendation systems.
  • Proven track record of improving user activation, onboarding, or time-to-value in consumer-facing digital products.
  • Solid understanding of customer journey design, particularly in post-payment or subscription-based environments.
  • Experience working with data-driven product development, including experimentation, A/B testing, and behavioral analysis.
  • Ability to design and improve segmentation, personalization, and recommendation logic.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify core user problems beyond surface-level feature requests.
  • Experience working with high-choice environments where users navigate multiple offers, options, or pathways.

  • Proven ability to lead requirement gathering sessions and translate business needs into technical and functional documentation.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Product Owner (Technology Driven Role) based in India.

In this role, you will act as a key bridge between business stakeholders and engineering teams, driving the discovery, definition, and delivery of high-impact digital and technology-enabled products. You will shape product direction by translating complex business needs into clear, actionable requirements, ensuring alignment across technical and non-technical teams. This position requires strong ownership of end-to-end product lifecycle activities, from ideation and requirements gathering through delivery and validation. You will work closely with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment to prioritize features, manage dependencies, and optimize delivery outcomes. The role is highly strategic, combining product thinking, process optimization, and technology understanding to enable scalable digital solutions. You will also play a critical role in improving business processes through automation and modern platform capabilities. This is an opportunity to influence enterprise-level product transformation initiatives in a fast-paced, global delivery environment.

Accountabilities

  • Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and software delivery teams, ensuring alignment on product goals and priorities.
  • Lead requirements gathering sessions, workshops, and stakeholder interviews to capture and translate business needs into user stories, functional specifications, and process flows.
  • Manage, refine, and prioritize product requirements in collaboration with product management and cross-functional teams.
  • Analyze complex business processes and identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and reengineering.
  • Define and document system dependencies, integration flows, and data mapping requirements across platforms.
  • Collaborate with project managers to plan scope, timelines, resources, and delivery milestones while managing risks and issues.
  • Support Agile delivery by grooming backlogs, facilitating sprint planning, and ensuring clear communication across teams.
  • Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and ensure delivered solutions meet business expectations and quality standards.
  • Work closely with QA teams to validate functionality and ensure alignment with specifications.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in product ownership and business analysis.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar IT product delivery role.
  • Strong experience working with web and mobile platforms, including API-driven architectures.
  • Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Proven ability to lead requirement gathering sessions and translate business needs into technical and functional documentation.
  • Experience creating wireframes, mockups, and prototypes to support solution design.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to evaluate and improve complex business processes.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder management and ability to work across multiple teams and priorities in high-pressure environments.
  • Highly self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong collaboration skills and experience working in cross-functional, team-oriented environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Benefits

  • Opportunity to work on large-scale digital and AI-driven transformation initiatives.
  • Exposure to global clients across multiple industries and domains.
  • Agile, collaborative, and innovation-driven work environment.
  • Strong focus on professional growth, ownership, and leadership development.
  • Flexible and dynamic work culture with cross-functional learning opportunities.
  • Competitive compensation aligned with experience and seniority.
  • Access to modern tools, platforms, and enterprise-grade technology ecosystems.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

The Senior Product Owner works to fulfill the strategic product roadmap established by the Product Management leadership team and meet business objectives. The person in this position manages multiple teams and backlogs for more than one product and/or for more complex products. This role is responsible for defining the detailed product deliverables. The Senior Product Owner must have a firm understanding of the business domain and product needs taking into account multiple types of users utilizing each solution. This position works closely with engineering on the specifications to ensure their Agile teams have all of the information needed to deliver a product that provides maximum value to the users.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Product Managers to understand the market demands, priorities, and overall product strategy.
  • Partner with UX and Product Managers on market research efforts to understand and prioritize customer needs.
  • Work with one or more engineering teams to deliver timely, quality releases that provide high business value and exceed customer expectations.
  • Flexibility to support more than one product within a portfolio, potentially across value streams
  • Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes
  • Work with the Product Manager and Agile team to define the scope included in a release.
  • Understand user personas and partner with UX to develop
  • Create detailed specifications/requirements for the product features so they are clearly understood by the development team.
  • Write user stories and establish acceptance criteria in collaboration with the team.
  • Actively participate in PI planning, product sprints and daily stand-up meetings
  • Research and clarify details as the team develops the application
  • Be aware of customer commitments in order to communicate internally to assist with managing team expectations
  • Manage dependencies in and across sprints and releases
  • Work with the Agile team to manage and prioritize the backlog to ensure alignment with changing business needs.
  • Prioritize support work as needed
  • Assist with system status communication and escalation as needed including customer communication
  • Perform demos to all stakeholders on a regular basis
  • Keep stakeholders apprised of progress and incorporate their feedback
  • Understand project budgets, scope and timelines and work to maintain a balance
  • Use metrics and feedback to improve team and organization processes, best practices, performance, and delivery
  • May provide work direction or guidance to colleagues with less experience
  • Act as a product champion within the company

Skills Required

  • 7+ years’ proven experience as a Quality Engineer.
  • Experience with testing tools such as WebDriverIO/ any UI Automation tool , Postman, ReadyAPI / RestSharp/ any API automation tool.
  • Proficiency in languages like TypeScript, Groovy, or Java.
  • Extensive experience testing APIs/web services (REST, SOAP, etc.) using Postman.
  • Knowledge of AWS services (S3, Athena, DynamoDB, Kubernetes, Secrets Manager).
  • Experience with test management tools like Azure DevOps and Zephyr.
  • Proven experience working in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) environments.
  • Experience using GitHub for version control.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams and Strong problem-solving skills and a continuous learning mindset with a willingness to adapt to new technologies.

FICO (NYSE: FICO) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a strategic and technically grounded product leader to serve as Director of Platform Product Management – Infrastructure. This role will define and execute the product strategy for core infrastructure capabilities that power enterprise platforms and applications. The infrastructure platform serves both internal and external customers, enabling scalable, secure, and resilient systems.

What You’ll Contribute

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for infrastructure platform capabilities including compute, storage, networking, cloud services, and infrastructure automation.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure engineering, architecture, operations, and security teams to deliver solutions that meet performance, availability, scalability, and compliance requirements.
  • Drive initiatives that improve infrastructure availability, performance, cost efficiency, and defect reduction, with clear KPIs and continuous monitoring.
  • Champion observability and monitoring practices to ensure visibility into infrastructure health and performance.
  • Advocate for secure-by-design principles and ensure infrastructure services meet enterprise security and governance standards.
  • Partner with internal product and application teams to ensure infrastructure services are reliable, scalable, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Prioritize infrastructure investments based on business impact, risk, and technical feasibility.
  • Communicate product vision, strategy, and progress to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends in cloud infrastructure, automation, and platform engineering to inform strategy.


What We’re Seeking

  • 15+ years of industry experience in technology, with at least 10 years in product management roles.
  • Proven success in managing infrastructure platform products at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), virtualization, containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), and networking.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible), observability platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Datadog), and security frameworks.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence without direct authority.
  • Experience in financial services or other regulated industries highly desired.
  • Deep experience with compliance standards, data center operations, and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor/Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field. MBA or equivalent business education.


Our Offer to You

  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.


Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

  • Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
  • Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
  • Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.


Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers

FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.

Information submitted with your application is subject to the FICO Privacy policy at https://www.fico.com/en/privacy-policy

preserve long‑term maintainability and upgradeability.Coordinate with vendors, managed service providers and third‑party integrators as required to deliver platform capabilities and QualificationsBachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field — or equivalent experience.Minimum 5–8 years’ experience in IT product management, business analysis, or a comparable role, ideally with direct responsibility for ITSM products.Strong practical knowledge of IT Service Management and ITIL practices and how to implement them on an enterprise ServiceNow platform.Hands‑on experience owning product lifecycle activities: defining vision and roadmap, managing backlogs, scoping releases, and delivering value through development, testing, deployment and support.Proven track record translating business needs into technical requirements and user stories, and communicating technical concepts clearly to non‑technical stakeholders.Good understanding of project and risk management practices and experience balancing scope, time and resources to achieve outcomes.Direct experience working with ServiceNow in an ITSM context (configuration, workflows, catalog, CMDB, integrations) or equivalent enterprise service management platforms.Familiarity with integration approaches, data considerations and operational readiness required for ServiceNow deliveries.Experience working with development, QA and operations teams to ensure quality, release readiness and stable operations.Experience leading cross‑functional teams to deliver product objectives and coordinate work across development, operations, support and business stakeholders.Ability to allocate and coordinate resources, manage competing priorities and dependencies across concurrent initiatives.Authority and judgement to make decisions on feature prioritization, trade‑offs and delivery timelines while managing stakeholder expectations.Experience with product lifecycle management and agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe or hybrid models).Comfortable participating in and driving agile ceremonies, backlog refinement and continuous improvement activities.Strong analytical and conceptual thinking with a pragmatic, solution‑oriented approach.Detail‑oriented and disciplined in requirement definition, acceptance criteria and quality gates.Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; effective facilitation of stakeholder reviews and consensus building.Demonstrated problem‑solving ability, critical thinking and a results‑driven mindset.Flexible and adaptable; able to operate effectively in global, cross‑functional and changing environments.High ownership and accountability for product outcomes and operational stability.ServiceNow certifications and agile/product certifications (e.g., PSPO/CSPO, SAFe, CSA, CIS‑ITSM) and prior domain experience (e.g., healthcare/life sciences) are advantageous.SkillsDemonstrable problem-solving skills.Demonstrable organizational skills.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

Solinas, a deep-tech startup incubated at IIT Madras, is India’s pioneering asset management venture transforming the water and sanitation sector. Recognized and commended by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Solinas is on a mission to tackle pressing challenges such as manual scavenging, water accessibility, and the prevention of floods and sewer overflows. At the core of our vision lies a commitment to developing homegrown, affordable robotics and AI solutions for pipeline inspections, manhole and septic tank cleaning, and underground asset management.


Since 2018, we have transformed operations across 30+ cities, earning accolades such as Best On-Campus Startup by the Economic Times, an appearance on Shark Tank India, and partnerships with industry leaders like Ashirvad Pipes and The/Nudge Institute. On the global stage, Solinas has been named Best Southeast Asian Startup by Imagine H2O — a testament to our innovation, impact, and purpose driven growth


About the role

As Product Owner for Swasth AI, you'll sit at the intersection of engineering, field operations, and customer impact. You'll own the product backlog, translate real-world infrastructure problems into actionable user stories, and work hand-in-hand with our engineering team to ship features that utilities and city planners actually use. This is not a coordination role. You'll be a decision-maker — setting priorities, challenging assumptions, and holding the bar for quality and user value.


What You'll Own

Product Strategy & Backlog

✓ Own and continuously refine the product backlog, ensuring every item is well-defined, prioritized, and tied to real user value

✓ Translate field visits, customer conversations, and data into crisp epics and user stories the team can act on immediately

✓ Define and track KPIs that actually measure whether the product is working — not just whether it shipped Cross-Functional Leadership

✓ Be the connective tissue between engineering, operations, sales, and the end users in the field

✓ Facilitate sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives that energize the team rather than drain it

✓ Communicate product direction clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences — including leadership Delivery & Execution

✓ Drive Agile ceremonies using SAFe or Scrum, ensuring the team moves fast without breaking trust

✓ Proactively surface risks and blockers — and come with a proposed path forward, not just a flag

✓ Travel to customer sites when needed to gather ground-truth requirements; infrastructure problems can't always be understood from a desk


What We're Looking For

Must-Have

✓ 3–5 years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager in a product-based company or startup ✓ Proven ability to own a backlog end-to-end in an Agile environment (SAFe, Scrum, or Kanban)

✓ Strong communication skills — you write clearly, present confidently, and listen carefully

✓ Data-driven mindset: you make decisions backed by evidence, not gut instinct alone

✓ Technical acumen sufficient to have credible conversations with engineers about architecture and trade-offs


Great to Have

✓ Experience with pipeline, utilities, water/wastewater, or smart city infrastructure

✓ Product Owner or Project Management certification (CSPO, SAFe PO/PM, PMI-ACP)

✓ Background in product marketing or go-to-market strategy ✓ Experience managing multiple products simultaneously


Why Solinas

✓ Work on technology that prevents manual scavenging and saves lives

✓ Direct access to leadership: you'll work closely with the leadership team and have real influence on product direction

✓ High-growth startup with proven traction: 30+ cities, multiple national awards, Shark Tank India alumni ✓ Competitive salary with performance-linked incentives and comprehensive healthcare

✓ A team of engineers, roboticists, and domain experts who take the mission seriously — and have fun doing it

About Costco Wholesale:

Costco Wholesale is a multi-billion-dollar global retailer with warehouse club operations in eleven countries. They provide a wide selection of quality merchandise, plus the convenience of specialty departments and exclusive member services, all designed to make shopping a pleasurable experience for their members.


About Costco Wholesale India:

At Costco Wholesale India, we foster a collaborative space, working to support Costco Wholesale in developing innovative solutions that improve members’ experiences and make employees’ jobs easier. Our employees play a key role in driving and delivering innovation to establish IT as a core competitive advantage for Costco Wholesale.


Job Description:

Position Summary:

Global Digital Experience (GDX) is looking for a passionate and experienced Product Owner to shape the future of retail at a global scale. At Costco, we're building the next generation of retail technology, and we're looking for talented individuals to drive our digital transformation.

Costco is a company that not only delivers exceptional value to millions of members worldwide but also deeply values its employees, fosters a culture of innovation, and offers genuine opportunities for career growth.


The Costco GDX team is looking for a talented individual to strategically define, guide, and champion the products that power our multi-billion dollar eCommerce business. In this role, you'll be working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, focusing heavily on defining the product strategy, roadmap and backlog. You will have the opportunity to make a tangible impact on millions of members globally within a rapidly expanding eCommerce landscape.


You'll have direct responsibility for:

  • Delivering innovative capabilities that enhance the member experience across various digital touchpoints.
  • Driving product strategy and roadmap in partnership with the Business stakeholders and Product Management.
  • Ensuring the longevity, scalability and quality of our systems through continuous improvement, comprehensive documentation, and meticulous profiling.


Job Duties / Essential Functions:

  • Collaborates with Product Managers and technology stakeholders (Engineers, Architects) to strategically align the product backlog with the overall Product vision and strategy.
  • Strategically prioritizes product features, balancing technical debt, platform improvements, architectural enablers with user-facing features.
  • Defines and communicates the minimum viable product (MVP) based on business value and technical feasibility.
  • Translates IT and Business Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) into actionable sprint goals.
  • Creates user stories with clear acceptance criteria and metrics that establish the criteria for delivery readiness
  • Leads and is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of the product backlog.
  • Drives cross-team collaboration to align on dependencies and timelines.

title: Group Product Manager, Project Capability
description: OverviewThe OpportunityProfitability at the project level is the financial question every contractor, consultant, nonprofit, and field service operator is trying to answer. descriptionHtml:
Overview

The Opportunity

Profitability at the project level is the financial question every contractor, consultant, nonprofit, and field service operator is trying to answer. It is also the question most financial platforms cannot answer well.

The project accounting software market is valued at $1.9 billion today and growing at nearly 7% annually — but that understates the real opportunity. Construction alone represents a $2 trillion industry, and when you add field services, professional services, and nonprofits, the addressable market for purpose-built project financial management runs well into the tens of billions. In 2023, over 68% of mid-market and large enterprises globally adopted some form of project-focused financial software — yet most are running on fragmented, legacy tools that were never built for AI-native financial intelligence.

Project capability is Intuit's horizontal infrastructure layer — built once, configured per vertical — that makes this possible across Construction, Field Services, Nonprofit, and Professional Services. Job costing, WIP, grant tracking, T&M billing — the surfaces differ, the financial core does not. Getting this right is one of Intuit's most important platform bets.

As Group PM, you will own that bet — leading the team building Intuit's agentic project financial platform, setting the shared capability strategy, and sequencing the investments that let every vertical go deeper without rebuilding foundations.

What You'll Own

Platform Strategy. Own the cross-vertical project capability roadmap — the build, buy, and partner decisions that define the shared infrastructure and the sequencing that balances vertical depth with platform efficiency.

Team Leadership. Lead a lean team of 2 PMs — developing talent, maintaining velocity, and influencing across Construction, Field Services, Nonprofit, and Professional Services teams without direct authority over vertical roadmaps.

Project Accounting Architecture. Own the data model for project dimensions, cost codes, WIP, revenue recognition, and project-level P&L — from simple job costing to complex ASC 606 multi-deliverable contracts.

Agentic Project Intelligence. Own the agentic layer — agents that track burn versus budget, flag cost variances before overruns, trigger milestone invoices from project completion signals, and generate EAC forecasts with confidence scores.

Cross-Vertical Alignment. Drive alignment across Construction, Field Services, Nonprofit, and Professional Services on shared capability investments — managing competing vertical priorities and building consensus around platform decisions that compound over time.

Who You Are

You understand project financial management across multiple verticals — job costing, WIP, revenue recognition, resource utilization, and billing structures. You see shared platform infrastructure as a strategic bet, not just an engineering efficiency, and you know how to sequence it without losing vertical credibility.

You lead through influence — aligning vertical teams around shared platform decisions, developing a lean PM team, and driving cross-functional consensus without organizational authority. You build AI-native products — writing agentic specs with objectives, tool definitions, confidence thresholds, and escalation logic — and know how to evangelize an ambitious platform vision across engineering, design, and vertical teams simultaneously.

About The Company

Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Unified Collaboration Product Manager with 15+ years in product management, telecom, or enterprise collaboration domains. The role will lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of unified collaboration solutions encompassing UCaaS, cloud telephony and video conferencing.

The ideal candidate combines deep domain expertise, strong business insights, and technical understanding to drive innovative, scalable, and customer-centric solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and lifecycle for unified collaboration solutions.
  • Align product strategy with business goals, market trends, and customer needs.
  • Identify emerging technologies (AI, automation, cloud communications) and integrate into offerings.

Market & Customer Insights

  • Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer discovery.
  • Build deep understanding of enterprise collaboration needs across industries.
  • Translate insights into high-impact product features and differentiation.

Product Development & Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation to launch and scaling.
  • Work closely with engineering, UX, architecture, and operations teams to deliver solutions.
  • Define product requirements, user stories, and success metrics (KPIs).

Unified Collaboration Ecosystem

  • Oversee products covering:
    • Enterprise & cloud voice telephony (VoIP, SIP, PBX)
    • Video conferencing & meetings platforms
    • Messaging and team collaboration tools
    • Ecosystem(tools/EMS/NMS/Automation tools/API Integrations) supporting Services
    • Integration with enterprise tools (CRM, ITSM, APIs)
  • Ensure interoperability across platforms and vendors.
  • Law of the land & its regulations
Go-to-Market & Business Growth

  • Define pricing, service offering and positioning strategies.
  • Partner with sales, marketing, and channel teams for successful launches.
  • Drive revenue growth, adoption, and customer retention.

Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with senior leadership, partners, and vendors.
  • Manage cross-functional stakeholders across technology, delivery and operations.
  • Present roadmap, progress, and performance metrics to executives.

Performance & Analytics

  • Establish KPIs and monitor product performance.
  • Use data-driven insights to optimize features, UX, and monetization.
  • Drive continuous improvement and innovation.

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in Product Management, Telecom, UCaaS, or Enterprise Collaboration.
  • Proven track record of launching and scaling unified communication or SaaS products.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Microsoft Teams Cloud Telephony (Teams DR/ Team OC/PBX Solutioning options)
    • Collaboration ecosystems (Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Cisco Webex, etc.)
  • Excellent stakeholder management and leadership skills.
  • Experience working with Global Service Integrators & Global Managed Service Providers.
Preferred Skills

  • Experience in AI-driven collaboration (chatbots, transcription, analytics).
  • Knowledge of market offering vs positioning for MS Cloud Telephony options.
  • Exposure to security, compliance, and enterprise-grade architecture.
  • MBA or advanced degree in Business/Technology preferred.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking
  • Customer-Centric Mindset
  • Strong Communication & Influencing Skills
  • Analytical & Data-Driven Decision Making
  • Execution Excellence
  • Leadership & Team Collaboration

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and customer satisfaction (NPS)
  • Revenue growth and market share
  • Time-to-market and delivery efficiency
  • Platform scalability and reliability
  • Innovation and feature differentiation
