descriptionHtml:
Summary

We’re seeking a hands-on engineer to accelerate developer productivity and engineering quality by operationalizing GitHub Copilot (Business/Enterprise) across the SDLC, with a strong focus on secure, governed adoption. You will design and maintain Copilot customization assets (prompt files, custom instructions, reusable agents) for common .NET delivery workflows, and build supporting GenAI services on Azure where needed. You will partner with platform engineering, security, and product teams to define guardrails, measure impact (productivity, quality, and risk), and continuously improve developer experience.

Technical Expertise & Essential Job Functions

GitHub Copilot Enablement & Productization

Own and evolve an enterprise-ready Copilot enablement approach: usage patterns, prompt standards, and governance for regulated environments.

Create and curate a repository-backed library of reusable prompt files (.github/prompts) for common engineering scenarios (bug fixes, brownfield enhancements from user stories, refactoring, test generation, security remediation).

Author and maintain custom instruction files (repository and organization patterns) to enforce coding standards, architecture conventions, error handling, logging, and testing practices.

Design interactive ‘guided’ prompts that ask one question at a time, minimize friction for low adopters, and require user confirmation before applying code changes.

Collaborate with teams to integrate Copilot into day-to-day workflows in Visual Studio and GitHub (PR templates, checklists, review guidance).

Guardrails, Security & Quality

Define and implement guardrails so AI-assisted code can’t land without required quality and security signals (tests, reviews, and automated scanning).

Configure and enforce GitHub Advanced Security practices where applicable (CodeQL code scanning, dependency review/alerts, secret scanning/push protection) and integrate results into PR gating.

Establish measurement for AI-assisted development: Copilot usage metrics (suggested vs added LOC, acceptance actions) and repo outcomes (review cycle time, defect inflow proxies, security findings), with clear limitations and directional interpretation.

Partner with AppSec and compliance stakeholders to ensure safe handling of sensitive data in prompts, logs, and test artifacts.

  • NET Engineering & Platform Integration

Contribute to and review C#/.NET codebases (ASP.NET Core, EF Core) to ensure Copilot guidance and templates match real architecture and patterns.

Build small, maintainable developer tooling and automation (e.g., GitHub Actions, internal utilities, code generators where appropriate) that complements Copilot rather than replacing engineering discipline.

Create and maintain sample reference implementations and ‘golden paths’ that demonstrate secure patterns, test-first fixes, and high-quality PRs.

GenAI Solution Engineering (Supporting)

Develop LLM-powered workflows on Azure (Azure OpenAI) to support developer experience and engineering insights (e.g., PR summarization, guided debugging, quality dashboards).

Implement prompt contracts, tool/function calling patterns, and evaluation harnesses for reliability, cost, and safety.

Where needed, build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and connectors to enterprise knowledge sources with grounding/citations.

Basic Qualifications

Security-minded engineering: familiarity with secure coding practices and integrating automated checks (SAST, dependency scanning, secret detection) into the delivery pipeline.

Azure fundamentals for deploying services (App Service/Functions/Container Apps) and secure configuration (Key Vault, RBAC).

Ability to convert moderately detailed requirements into clear designs (ADRs/sequence diagrams) and production-ready implementations.

Nice-to-Have

GitHub Copilot administration experience (policy management, organizational customization, adoption measurement and reporting).

Experience building developer tooling or IDE extensions (Visual Studio/VS Code), internal CLIs, or PR automation.

Hands-on with GitHub Advanced Security (CodeQL, secret scanning, dependency review/Dependabot) and rulesets/required checks for merge gating.

Experience with Azure OpenAI, prompt evaluation, and/or RAG (Azure AI Search or equivalent).

Data engineering and analytics experience for telemetry pipelines and dashboards (SQL, data modeling, Power BI).

Core Competencies

Developer Productivity Leadership: pragmatic enablement, playbooks, and training that drive real adoption.

System Design: clear, scalable architecture with documented trade-offs.

Code Quality: readable, tested, maintainable code with robust error handling.

Security & Governance: secure-by-default patterns, auditability, and responsible AI practices.

Measurement & Insights: metrics that are transparent, repeatable, and grounded in tooling constraints.

Other Qualifications

Copilot customization assets (prompts/instructions/workflows) that materially improve cycle time and developer experience without compromising quality or security.

Clear, trustworthy reporting of Copilot adoption and impact, including known limitations of telemetry and measurement.

Reduced friction for common work (small fixes, bug triage, test creation) through repeatable Copilot-guided workflows that keep developers in control.

Well-governed, secure AI-assisted development practices aligned with enterprise standards.

title: Director, Product Management
description: Who We AreAt Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!See yourself at TwilioJoin the team as Twilio’s next Director, Product Management.About The JobTwilio is looking for a Director, Product Management, to help deliver on our strategic vision for the Twilio Flex product that is part of the Twilio Platform. In this role, you will be responsible for the features, UI, APIs, Agentic approach, and documentation that powers the Flex product ecosystem. You will help define and drive the roadmap that enables internal teams, partners, third-party developers, and customers to innovate and scale their contact center solutions on Twilio. As a strategic leader, you collaborate closely with other product leaders, Engineering, Architecture, and Go-To-Market teams to deliver robust, scalable, and forward-looking Flex capabilities. As a leader and manager, you will manage and lead a team of strong individual Product Managers. descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Director, Product Management.

About The Job

Twilio is looking for a Director, Product Management, to help deliver on our strategic vision for the Twilio Flex product that is part of the Twilio Platform. In this role, you will be responsible for the features, UI, APIs, Agentic approach, and documentation that powers the Flex product ecosystem. You will help define and drive the roadmap that enables internal teams, partners, third-party developers, and customers to innovate and scale their contact center solutions on Twilio. As a strategic leader, you collaborate closely with other product leaders, Engineering, Architecture, and Go-To-Market teams to deliver robust, scalable, and forward-looking Flex capabilities. As a leader and manager, you will manage and lead a team of strong individual Product Managers. And finally, as a key leader of the Twilio India location, you will help guide and shape the working experience of hundreds of other Twilions as you partner with senior leadership in Bangalore, India.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Define, build, and execute a comprehensive product roadmap for the foundational services, APIs, and developer infrastructure powering the Twilio Flex product ecosystem.
  • Lead the evolution of Twilio Flex from a standalone application into a set of decomposable, AI-native components, aligning with Twilio’s strategic platform vision.
  • Provide clear ownership, hands-on product management, managing roadmap execution, and operational oversight for the consolidated Flex Product Management team.
  • Manage and mentor a team of strong individual Product Managers, fostering a culture of technical rigor, continuous learning, and high performance.
  • Champion an outstanding customer experience by driving improvements in APIs, SDKs, documentation, and tooling for internal teams, partners, and external developers.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Architecture, Design, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver robust, scalable, and forward-looking Flex capabilities.
  • Serve as a key leader for the Twilio India site, partnering with senior leadership in Bangalore to guide and shape the working experience of hundreds of other Twilions.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

  • Required:
  • 15+ years of product management experience, with at least 4 years as a manager leading platform or infrastructure-focused product teams.
  • Proven experience in developing and managing platform products such as APIs, developer tools, and cloud-native infrastructure.
  • Strong technical acumen and ability to engage deeply with engineering teams on architectural trade-offs, scalability, and highly distributed systems.
  • At least 5 years experience working on multi-tenant SaaS and cloud platforms.
  • Experience in the Contact Center (CCaaS) or Customer Engagement Platform (CEP) space.
  • Demonstrated ability to hire, manage, and mentor a team of Product Managers.
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience.

Desired

  • Familiarity with Voice AI, Agentic frameworks, and AI use in Contact Center products.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across time zones with globally distributed teams.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in India (only in Karnataka, TamilNadu, Maharashtra, Delhi, Telangana).

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

descriptionHtml:
The Product Management Senior Manager is a senior management level position responsible for managing a broad range of Product Management employees, setting strategy and providing direction, leadership and budgetary management, etc. Additionally, this role will be responsible for the development of product plans, strategies, and tactics while coordinating product lines through product life-cycles in coordination with the broader Product Management team. The overall objective of this role is to coordinate the promotion of products to develop new markets, increase share of market and obtain competitive position.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of professional to accomplish established goals and conduct personnel duties for team (e.g. performance evaluations, hiring and disciplinary actions)
  • Manage strategic program roadmap, program/product launch, and program marketing to gain maximum benefit from each product
  • Monitor client and competitor market research to ensure successful execution of a marketing plan spanning product, brand, acquisition, customer and retention, and improving performance, brand preference, and client engagement
  • Develop plans and execute functional strategies for a country, group of countries, region, or business requiring coordination and integration across units
  • Manage day-to-day product marketing for core products such as product delivery, client experience, and client communication strategies as well as help the team prioritize, negotiate, and remove obstacles to achieve business results
  • Participate in development of client valued propositions, positioning, segmentation, pricing, targeting, channel strategies, and competitive differentiation to achieve preferred status as a partner to Citi clients
  • Oversee program life cycle including market demands, technology trends, and the competitive field as well as develop and communicate a business plan to approach the marketplace
  • Define and launch new products, features, and capabilities including defining the product/feature and go-to-market strategy, and participate in technology development and market launch activities
  • Engage with external partners and/or vendor relationships, engage in negotiations, manage ongoing relationships, and prepare agreements
  • Deploy profitable marketing strategies, lead conceptualization and implementation of key growth initiatives, and maintain current market intelligence on the overall industry verticals and competitors
  • Assist in building new relationships in supported verticals using available tools such as industry publications, direct mail, internet presence, trade shows, calls, and strategic alliances
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.

Qualifications:

  • 10 plus years of relevant experience
  • Previous supervisory experience across multi-function and/or global business
  • Experience with banking and investment products
  • Working knowledge of the different systems, theories, and practices relevant to a function as well as practical experience of multiple business cycles
  • In-depth knowledge of industry and competitor products/services
  • Working knowledge of industry practices and standards
  • Working knowledge of strategic direction of the function within the business as well as a solid conceptual/practical grounding in function and/or area of expertise
  • Ability to develop strategy, resources, and inspire a diverse set of individuals
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
  • Demonstrated negotiation skills

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred

Job Summary

The person will lead the strategic development, solutioning and positioning of international solutions from GIFT city for both affluent clients onshore and offshore. The person will drive the product strategy, both inbound and outbound solutions across Funds, AIFs, Insurance, Fixed Income, Deposits and Structured products and own the P&L.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • The person will lead the strategic development, solutioning and positioning of international solutions from GIFT city for both affluent clients onshore and offshore. The person will drive the solution product strategy, both inbound and outbound solutions across Funds, AIFs, Insurance, Fixed Income, Deposits and Structured products and own the P&L.

Business

  • Drive the product strategy across Funds, PMS, AIFs, Insurance, Fixed Income, Deposits and Structured Products.
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of market conditions, economic trends, and structure solutions across wealth & deposit products for Inbound for offshore affluent clients and outbound solutions for resident clients.
  • Collaborate with country and group product teams across MI, CMPS, Equity and Bancassurance to deliver comprehensive solutions to clients.
  • Manage partner agreements and engagement from GIFT City and ensure optimisation of cost structure.

Processes

  • Ensuring the appropriateness of solutions and compliance to all internal and regulatory related policies. Ensure the implementation of appropriate systems and operational processes to measure and manage KPIs and profitability

People & Talent

  • Collaborate with frontline (specialists, RMs) and support functions to deliver and provide effective client solutions and expand our International solutions proposition.

Risk Management

  • To ensure timely identification, assessment, and mitigation of international solution business. Ensure adherence to Group Risk policies.

Governance

  • Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
  • Ensure adherence with the highest standards of ethics and compliance with relevant policies, processes and regulations forms part of the culture.
  • Engage with all audit report findings and ensure feedback is acted upon

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  • Exercise authorities delegated by the Board of Directors and act in accordance with Articles of Association (or equivalent)

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: Group Product Manager, Knowledge Platform
description: Why HarveyAt Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. With 1500+ customers in 60+ countries, strong product-market fit, and world-class investor support, we’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.Role OverviewHarvey is building AI that transforms how the world's most sophisticated professionals work. We are looking for a Group Product Manager based in Bengaluru to drive the strategy, development, and delivery of Harvey's Knowledge Platform — the systems that connect Harvey to the legal world's content and tools. This means owning how we build and scale our ecosystem of third-party connectors and data partner integrations that bring rich legal context into Harvey, strengthening core user engagement. This is Harvey's first PM hire in India and a foundational role: you will own a critical product area end-to-end, work closely with our India Engineering team and cross-functional partners across time zones, and shape how Harvey builds and ships products. You will collaborate daily with Engineering, Design, Business Development, Legal Engineering, and GTM teams.What You'll DoDevelop the product roadmap for Harvey's integrations and Knowledge Platform, defining vision, strategy, and priorities across document management systems, the legal tech connector ecosystem, and private legal data.Partner closely with Harvey's India Engineering team to scope, design, and ship high-quality integrations and platform experiences at a rapid paceDrive the strategy for expanding Harvey's connector ecosystem: integration aggregators and self-serve pathways that allow customers and partners to connect their own tools to Harvey at scale.Work closely with business development to engage with partners and manage complex joint developmentsDeeply understand the workflows of lawyers at leading law firms and in-house legal teams, translating that understanding into product decisions, especially around how enterprise knowledge (DMS files, matter data, firm content) flows into and shapes AI-powered workflows.Act as a bridge between India and HQ (San Francisco / New York), ensuring tight communication loops and strategic alignment across sites.Contribute to shaping Harvey's India product culture — setting the bar for how PMs operate in the region.What You Have15+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years at a Staff or Senior PM level at a high-growth technology company.Demonstrated ability to own and drive a product area end-to-end, from strategy through execution and iteration.Strong technical fluency — you can have deep, substantive conversations with engineers about system design, data pipelines, API architecture, and infrastructure trade-offs, including topics like vector search, orchestration systems, and sync reliability.Familiarity with enterprise SaaS go-to-market dynamics: customer commitments, partner integrations, access control and governance requirements, and the operational complexity of shipping to large law firms or regulated industries.Track record of effective cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Design, GTM, and Customer Success — including navigating dependency-heavy roadmaps and partner relationships.Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present to executives and external stakeholders with clarity and confidence.Experience working in distributed or multi-site teams, with comfort operating across time zones.Based in Bengaluru and eligible to work in India. Harvey does not currently offer visa sponsorship for this role.Nice to HaveExperience in legal tech, professional services technology, or regulated industries.Experience as a founding or early PM in a new-market or new-office setting.Familiarity with LLMs, RAG architectures, or AI-native product design, and an intuition for how data quality and pipeline design affect AI output.Additional InformationWork eligibility: Must be authorized to work in India. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices [here].Harvey is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made by emailing accommodations@harvey.ai

We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey is building AI that transforms how the world's most sophisticated professionals work. We are looking for a Group Product Manager based in Bengaluru to drive the strategy, development, and delivery of Harvey's Knowledge Platform — the systems that connect Harvey to the legal world's content and tools. This means owning how we build and scale our ecosystem of third-party connectors and data partner integrations that bring rich legal context into Harvey, strengthening core user engagement. This is Harvey's first PM hire in India and a foundational role: you will own a critical product area end-to-end, work closely with our India Engineering team and cross-functional partners across time zones, and shape how Harvey builds and ships products. You will collaborate daily with Engineering, Design, Business Development, Legal Engineering, and GTM teams.

What You'll Do

  • Develop the product roadmap for Harvey's integrations and Knowledge Platform, defining vision, strategy, and priorities across document management systems, the legal tech connector ecosystem, and private legal data.
  • Partner closely with Harvey's India Engineering team to scope, design, and ship high-quality integrations and platform experiences at a rapid pace
  • Drive the strategy for expanding Harvey's connector ecosystem: integration aggregators and self-serve pathways that allow customers and partners to connect their own tools to Harvey at scale.
  • Work closely with business development to engage with partners and manage complex joint developments
  • Deeply understand the workflows of lawyers at leading law firms and in-house legal teams, translating that understanding into product decisions, especially around how enterprise knowledge (DMS files, matter data, firm content) flows into and shapes AI-powered workflows.
  • Act as a bridge between India and HQ (San Francisco / New York), ensuring tight communication loops and strategic alignment across sites.
  • Contribute to shaping Harvey's India product culture — setting the bar for how PMs operate in the region.

What You Have

  • 15+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years at a Staff or Senior PM level at a high-growth technology company.
  • Demonstrated ability to own and drive a product area end-to-end, from strategy through execution and iteration.
  • Strong technical fluency — you can have deep, substantive conversations with engineers about system design, data pipelines, API architecture, and infrastructure trade-offs, including topics like vector search, orchestration systems, and sync reliability.
  • Familiarity with enterprise SaaS go-to-market dynamics: customer commitments, partner integrations, access control and governance requirements, and the operational complexity of shipping to large law firms or regulated industries.
  • Track record of effective cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Design, GTM, and Customer Success — including navigating dependency-heavy roadmaps and partner relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present to executives and external stakeholders with clarity and confidence.
  • Experience working in distributed or multi-site teams, with comfort operating across time zones.
  • Based in Bengaluru and eligible to work in India. Harvey does not currently offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in legal tech, professional services technology, or regulated industries.
  • Experience as a founding or early PM in a new-market or new-office setting.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, RAG architectures, or AI-native product design, and an intuition for how data quality and pipeline design affect AI output.

Additional Information

  • Work eligibility: Must be authorized to work in India. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices [here].

Harvey is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made by emailing accommodations@harvey.ai

descriptionHtml:
About the Company

We are a fast-growing U.S.-based consumer lending fintech company redefining how consumers access credit and manage their financial lives. Our mission is to simplify and democratize financial access through smart, data-driven digital solutions.


Role Overview

We are seeking a Vice President of Product to lead our India-based product organization. This leader will manage a team of 10–15 high-performing Product Managers and play a critical role in defining and delivering our global product vision. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product strategist, skilled communicator, and inspiring leader who thrives at the intersection of technology, business, and user experience.


Key Responsibilities

• Drive the end-to-end product strategy, vision, and execution for our consumer lending and digital financial products.

• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 10–15 Product Managers to create a high-performance product culture.

• Partner closely with global executives, engineering, design, and analytics to deliver best-in class fintech experiences across full customer life cycle (including but not limited to application stage, delinquency management, and returning customer strategy).

• Translate the company's strategic goals into clear product roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

• Oversee product lifecycle management—from concept to launch, iteration, and scale.

• Leverage data and user insights to drive decisions that enhance product performance and customer satisfaction.

• Stay current with fintech trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to ensure product innovation.

• Collaborate with U.S. stakeholders to ensure strong communication and alignment across global teams.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree from a reputed institution (MBA or equivalent preferred).

• 10+ years of experience in Product Management, with at least 5 years leading product teams. US experience will be a plus.

• Proven track record of building and scaling digital products in fintech, digital lending, or e commerce ecosystems.

• Strong analytical and strategic thinking abilities with a data-driven decision-making approach.

• Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills across global teams.

• Hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work in fast-paced, evolving environments.

• Deep understanding of technologies in fintech systems, APIs, cloud platforms, and user experience design.


Why Join Us

• Opportunity to influence a global product vision from India.

• Work with world-class technology and leadership teams.

• High-impact role in a mission-driven fintech shaping the future of digital lending.

• Competitive compensation, benefits, and flexibility in a remote-first environment.

descriptionHtml:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk.

Role: Director of Product Operations

The Director of Product Operations role exists to define, drive adoption and accountability of an efficient software development lifecycle at Arctic Wolf. This individual will own codification of the product management outcomes through the SDLC, ensuring consistency in product management-specific documentation, standards, and training; owning the strategy and implementation for any product management specific SDLC tooling and to drive consistent adoption and accountability. This role will monitor the implementation of the SDLC to ensure the product management organization is consistently driving to the standard, identifying gaps, and driving solutions in collaboration with PM leaders.

The Director of Operations is a strategic and execution‑focused leader responsible for driving operational excellence across the organization. This role oversees cross‑functional processes, ensures alignment between product, engineering, and business teams, and establishes scalable operational frameworks that enable growth and efficiency. The Director of Operations will partner closely with senior leadership to define operational strategy, optimize performance, and ensure organizational readiness as the business evolves.

A key component of this role is serving as a subject matter expert (SME) in the Aha! product management platform or demonstrating significant experience with a comparable product management tool, ensuring strong transferable skills in product planning, roadmapping, workflow management, and cross‑team coordination.

Primary Responsibilities And Duties

  • Develop, implement, and continually refine operational strategies, processes, and systems that support organizational goals.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that drive efficiency, operational alignment, and predictable delivery.
  • Establish and manage performance metrics, operational dashboards, and reporting frameworks to monitor progress and inform decision‑making.
  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Program Management to streamline workflows, prioritize initiatives, and support successful execution of product roadmaps.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement solutions that improve throughput, quality, and scalability.
  • Lead operational planning cycles, including annual planning, resourcing, and sequencing of strategic initiatives.
  • Standardize processes, documentation, and governance to ensure clarity, accountability, and operational consistency across teams.
  • Manage risk assessment and mitigation strategies, ensuring operational reliability.
  • Serve as the organizational subject matter expert in Aha! or a similar product management tool, enabling teams to drive adoption, optimize usage, and leverage data for decision‑making.
  • Support onboarding, training, and best‑practice integration for operations‑related tools and processes.
  • Influence and support change‑management efforts to ensure smooth integration of new systems, tools, and methodologies.
  • Influence
    • Provide scalable solutions, like recorded training, best practices, templates, targeted coaching to product managers to facilitate the creation of high quality epics throughout the product lifecycle; supporting clear understanding of problems, suggested implementations and success metrics, and an effective refinement process with engineering
    • Ensure product managers are creating and using effective, meaningful success metrics; In partnership with PMO, drive a process that regularly reviews deliverables against success criteria
    • Assist product management leaders with best practices and tactics to drive product manager involvement throughout the entire SDLC to enable consistent communication of value, rapid problem solving, and quick scope adjustment
    • Assist product management leaders with standard process for user acceptance test (beta, EAP, Design partners) and enabling cross-functional collaboration
    • Ensure Product Marketing are embedded early and often in the product development lifecycle and the software development lifecycle
    • Drive processes to enable high-impact UX engagement throughout the SDLC process so that UX time can be invested on the highest value work
    • Foster an environment with early and often cross-functional collaboration and involvement (IT, ProdSec, Legal, GTO, S2, etc)
    • Facilitate quick decision-making by acting as the point of contact for prioritization assistance
  • Own
    • Product Organization Fiscal Year Annual Operating Planning process
    • Product Organization Quarterly Business Review process
    • Product Development Process and tools– “Product Manager of the Product Management process and implementation”; identify hotspots in the process to address and identify coaching opportunities; Develop a cadence of spot-checking product management processes as teams move through the development process to identify areas of growth for the teams and undesired friction in the process
    • Identify opportunities to bring knowledge and data that provide value across all product management teams; implement ways to enable self-serve access to that knowledge and data
    • Implement and maintain a road-mapping process that allows for efficient support of greenlight process requirements and consistently communicates and delivers customer and stakeholder value
    • Own Product Management specific tooling (usage, contracting, mgmt); Drive consistent, standardized and efficient usage our tooling (Aha!, Jira, Confluence, XLS), determine what the right tool is for the outcome
    • Own the pieces of the SDLC with product involvement; enable a culture of continuous learning and improvement; monitor the effective implementation of the SDLC, identify opportunities for tooling, process and people improvements and drive a metrics-oriented view of the health of the PM components of the SDLC
    • Own and drive a set of metrics in support of the SDLC and at the discretion of the product SVP, to support the product lines as a whole function
    • Own the business case template and lifecycle – from pitch through launch, ensuring clear reporting against goals throughout the lifecycle
    • Own the product line strategy templates and lifecycle – Ensuring strategies include 3yr plan, where are you going, how you are going to win, supporting research; clear reporting against strategic goals for AWN

Key Skills

  • Strong operational strategy development and execution abilities
  • Exceptional Product Management Knowledge – This role is the Product Manager of the Product Management process; must have a deep, experiential knowledge of product management and be able to translate that experience into best practices, templates and standardization
  • Excellent cross-functional leadership, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills
  • Expertise in scaling processes, optimizing workflows, and implementing operational frameworks
  • Ability to analyze complex data, identify trends, and make data‑driven decisions
  • Strong problem‑solving, critical thinking, and organizational skills
  • High proficiency with operational and productivity tools
  • Deep experience with Aha! or strong transferable expertise from similar tools (e.g., Jira Advanced Roadmaps, Productboard, Monday.com, etc.)
  • Ability to influence without authority and build strong relationships across teams
  • High EQ; able to build consensus without direct authority through ‘disagree and commit’ style agreements; Exemplary communicator across all mediums (Slack, Video, Email, Powerpoint, Word); Ability to influence and align across many stakeholder groups
  • Strong presentation and executive communication skills
  • Continuous Learner – researching new things to get better
  • “Left Shift the problems” – driving towards continuous improvement as a culture Streamline Process to get the right outcomes– identify bottlenecks, and come up with solutions to remove the bottlenecks; implement scalable processes across product teams
  • Extensive Agile SDLC experience, frameworks and tools
  • Tempo Setter – not just a braintrust, evangelist of the process – driving culture and setting a tone; Advocate for excellence in the process – create a sense of spirit across teams; celebrate accomplishment & achievement, reinforcing good behaviors

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Product Management, or related field
  • 8+ years of experience in operations, program management, product operations, or a similar discipline
  • Proven experience leading cross‑functional initiatives in a complex, fast‑paced environment
  • Demonstrated ability to build and optimize operational processes
  • Experience with Aha! or equivalent product‑management tools
  • Strong analytical and reporting capabilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree (MBA or related discipline)
  • 10–12+ years of experience in operations leadership roles
  • Experience supporting product or technology organizations at scale
  • Certification in Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or similar methodologies
  • Prior responsibility for tool governance, configuration, and enablement of Aha! or comparable platforms
  • Experience in change management, organizational design, or operational maturity transformation
  • Background in software or technology‑focused environments

Don’t meet all the requirements? That’s okay! We still want you to apply. We have many opportunities, and we are always looking for top talent.

On-Camera Policy

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2025), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2025), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024-2026), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024-2026). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.

Our Values

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion, and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.

We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.

All Wolves Receive Compelling Compensation And Benefits Packages, Including

  • Equity for all employees
  • Flexible annual leave, paid holidays and volunteer days
  • Training and career development programs
  • Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
  • Fertility support and paid parental leave

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodation by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf.com.

Security Requirements

  • Conducts duties and responsibilities in accordance with AWN’s Information Security policies, standards, processes, and controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of AWN business information (in accordance with our employee handbook and corporate policies).
  • Background checks are required for this position.
  • This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). Please note that, if applicable, an offer for employment will be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Experian unlocks the power of data to create opportunities for consumers, businesses and society. We gather, analyze and process data in ways others can’t. We help individuals take financial control and access financial services, businesses make smarter decision and thrive, lenders lend more responsibly, and organizations prevent identity fraud and crime. For more than 125 years, we’ve helped consumers and clients prosper, and economies and communities flourish – and we’re not done. Our 17,800 people in 45 countries believe the possibilities for you, and our world, are growing. We’re investing in new technologies, talented people and innovation so we can help create a better tomorrow.

Job Description

Experian India is seeking a strategic and visionary senior leader to head its Fraud and ID Verification Solutions team. This client-facing role is central to driving solution excellence, market leadership, and product innovation in the financial services sector. The ideal candidate will be a recognized expert in fraud prevention and identity verification, capable of translating client challenges into impactful solutions while influencing product strategy and market execution.

In today’s era of data-driven decision-making, Experian is uniquely positioned to solve client problems by being at the forefront of data analysis, solutioning, and innovation. Our platform-first approach enables seamless integration of data from multiple sources, creating a one-stop solution for the financial industry in India.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Strategic Solutioning

  • Lead a team of specialists to engage with clients, deeply understand their fraud and ID verification challenges, and strategically position Experian’s solutions to address these needs.
  • Collaborate with Sales teams on day-to-day sales activities, providing strategic guidance and solution expertise to support deal progression and closure.
  • Ensure that analytics-driven insights are embedded into client conversations and product evolution.
  • Ensure that proposed solutions are optimal, scalable, and aligned with client needs and regulatory frameworks.

Post-Sales Success & Adoption

  • Oversee the transition from sales to onboarding, ensuring smooth implementation and client satisfaction.
  • Drive client adoption and usage of solutions, acting as a strategic advisor to maximize value realization.

Product Feedback & Innovation

  • Serve as the voice of the customer to internal product teams, providing actionable insights on product performance and enhancement opportunities.
  • Influence the development of new features and capabilities based on client feedback and market trends.
  • Work closely with Experian’s highly proficient analytics teams to co-create innovative, data-led solutions.
  • Identify trends across liabilities and assets onboarding, spanning both consumer and MSME segments.
  • Leverage advanced analytics to address fraud not only from a consumer perspective but also through digital device footprints, behavioral signals, and emerging fraud typologies.

Go-To-Market Strategy

  • Partner with GTM and sales teams to launch new Fraud and ID Verification products.
  • Define target segments, positioning, messaging, and market entry strategies.
  • Support enablement and training of sales teams on new offerings.

Industry Leadership & Advocacy

  • Represent Experian at fraud forums, conferences, and industry events.
  • Establish Experian as the leading authority on fraud and ID verification in India’s financial services sector.
  • Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across banks, NBFCs, and regulatory bodies.

Community Building & Thought Leadership

  • Lead the planning and execution of the Annual Fraud Closed User Group Summit for Hunter platform users and industry leaders.
  • Manage the Hunter Advisory Board, a quarterly forum of top financial institutions to discuss product evolution and regulatory developments.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate across product, customer success, onboarding, analytics, and GTM teams to drive holistic client outcomes.
  • Inspire and lead a high-performing team of specialists, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and innovation.

Qualifications

Qualifications & Experience:

  • 15+ years of experience in fraud prevention, identity verification, or related domains within financial services or technology.
  • Proven experience in strategic client engagement and solutioning.
  • Strong understanding of the fraud landscape in India’s financial services sector.
  • Experience in product strategy, GTM planning, and cross-functional leadership.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and strategic thinking skills.
  • Prior experience in hosting industry summits or advisory boards is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic influence on sales outcomes and client satisfaction.
  • High adoption and usage rates post-implementation.
  • Strong market presence and thought leadership in the fraud domain.
  • Continuous product improvement driven by client insights.
  • Seamless collaboration across internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Delivery of innovative, data-driven solutions that address emerging fraud patterns.

Why us

  • We’re a high-performance and driven team but we don’t forget to celebrate success
  • We offer strong career and international opportunities for high performers
  • We invest heavily in our products and our people
  • We offer training and support from experienced subject matter experts and managers plus dedicated learning & development time

Additional Information

  • We are looking for someone who:
  • Is a consultative business professional
  • Is confident, clear, certain and consistent
  • Is able to work alongside a sales team managing multiple opportunities concurrently
  • Passionate, resourceful, gracious and adaptable
  • High moral standards, honesty and an ethical approach to doing business
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving skills and ability to see the big-picture & develop conceptual solutions
  • Candidates that have prior relevant work experience, excel in ambiguous situations, and possess a passion for helping companies become more competitive
  • Business acumen combined with a comfort with technology is a must

descriptionHtml:
Business Unit: EPSAutomotive Electronics

Role: Product Leader - Electrification

As a Product Leader – Electrification, you will own the strategy, technology roadmap and execution for our electrification product portfolio, mainly motor control units including inverters, motors etc. You will act as the strategic interface between OEM customers, engineering teams, and business leadership - shaping innovative, safe, and efficient solutions that accelerate the transition to sustainable mobility. This is a cross-functional leadership role that blends technical depth, customer engagement, and business strategy in a high-growth, fast-evolving domain.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Vision
  • Define and own the product strategy and technology roadmap for motor control units used in electric drive systems (eAxles, traction motors, hybrid drives) for India and global.
  • Analyze evolving EV architectures, regulations (emissions, homologation etc.), and OEM needs to guide feature prioritization.
  • Stay current with trends in e-motors, inverters, power electronics (SiC, GaN), and battery systems.
  • Collaborate with R&D teams on emerging technologies such as 800V architectures and thermal management optimization.
  • Analyze market trends, regulatory requirements (AIS, NCAP, ISO 26262, UNECE), and competitive products to guide feature prioritization.
  • Identify new business opportunities in ePowertrain and energy management solutions.
  • Develop clear value propositions and business cases for product investments.
  • Contribute to technology partnerships and innovation scouting.
  • Execution & Delivery
  • Translate user needs, customer/regulatroty/safety requirements into clear product goals and technology roadmaps & specifications.
  • Lead cross-functional teams (software, systems, hardware, validation) through the product lifecycle - from concept to SOP (Start of Production).
  • Prioritize features, manage trade-offs between performance, cost, and schedule.
  • Manage product lifecycle from concept through production and post-launch updates.
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Work closely with regulatory authorities, other tier1 stakeholders and internal stakeholders to align product goals and technology roadmaps.
  • Be the primary product interface to OEM customers - gather requirements, define specifications, and drive joint development programs.
  • Collaborate with sales and engineering teams to support RFQ (Request for Quotation) responses and define optimal product configurations.
  • Translate OEM requirements into clear internal product specifications and technical deliverables.
  • Collaborate with sales, engineering, and program management to ensure customer satisfaction and project success.
  • Present progress and outcomes to executive leadership and external partners.
  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and standards bodies.
  • Education
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Electronics or Computer Science Engineering.
  • MBA or certification in Product Management is an advantage.
  • Experience
  • 15+ years of experience in automotive product management, program management or systems engineering, including at least 3–5 years in electrification or ePowertrain.
  • Proven experience managing OEM customer programs at a Tier 1 supplier.
  • Deep understanding of high-voltage systems, power electronics, and vehicle integration.
  • Familiarity with ASPICE, AUTOSAR, and model-based development (MBSE).
  • Strong leadership and strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Ability to balance technical depth with business priorities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

descriptionHtml:
About CTeBS

CTeBS (Classic Technologies & Business Solutions) is a technology company building an integrated ecosystem of software products for the fashion manufacturing industry. As a subsidiary of Classic Fashion, one of the leading garment manufacturers, CTeBS builds software products that are first developed, implemented, and matured within Classic Fashion's own manufacturing operations, and subsequently offered to external customers across the industry. This unique model means our products are battle-tested in real production environments before they reach the market, giving us deep domain credibility and a genuine understanding of manufacturing floor challenges.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead and grow the Product Management function at CTeBS. This is a player-coach role — you will directly own one or more software products while also providing leadership, mentorship, and strategic direction to the existing PM team of 3. The ideal candidate combines strong product management expertise with hands-on knowledge of manufacturing operations — ideally in apparel, garments, textiles, or closely adjacent industries (footwear, home textiles). You should be someone who understands shop floor realities, production planning, quality workflows, and the pain points of factory operations, and can translate that knowledge into compelling software products.


Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership & Strategy

  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for one or more CTeBS software products — from discovery and ideation through development, launch, and iteration.
  • Define and maintain product roadmaps aligned with both Classic Fashion's internal needs and external market opportunities.
  • Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer discovery to identify product-market fit for external commercialisation.
  • Drive the transition of internally-matured products into market-ready offerings for external garment manufacturing customers.
  • Establish and track product KPIs, OKRs, and success metrics to measure product health and business impact.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 3 product professionals with varying experience levels.
  • Establish product management best practices, frameworks, and processes across the team.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, product reviews, and sprint retrospectives to ensure quality and accountability.
  • Build a culture of data-driven decision making, customer empathy, and continuous learning within the PM function.

Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary interface between the product team and Classic Fashion's manufacturing operations leadership.
  • Navigate the dual-stakeholder dynamic — balancing Classic Fashion's internal requirements with what makes products viable and scalable for external customers.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, design, QA, and delivery teams to ensure timely and quality product releases.
  • Present product strategy, progress, and outcomes to senior leadership and key stakeholders.

Domain Application

  • Leverage garment manufacturing domain expertise to identify high-impact product opportunities in areas such as production planning, line balancing, quality inspection, cut-make-trim operations, fabric management, and compliance tracking.
  • Translate complex manufacturing workflows into intuitive software experiences.
  • Stay current with industry trends in fashion manufacturing technology, Industry 4.0, and smart factory solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of overall professional experience with 6–7+ years specifically in product management roles.
  • Proven experience in manufacturing software — ERP, MES, PLM, factory operations platforms, or production management systems.
  • Domain knowledge in garment/apparel manufacturing, textiles, footwear, or closely adjacent industries.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or mentoring other product managers (not just managing products).
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working with cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Excellent analytical skills with experience using data to drive product decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to present to senior stakeholders with confidence.
  • Experience with B2B SaaS product commercialisation — taking an internal tool or early product to external paying customers.
  • Familiarity with smart factory / Industry 4.0 concepts: IoT on the shop floor, real-time production monitoring, digital twins.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA or equivalent is a plus.

What We Offer

Opportunity to build and lead the Product Management function at a growing smart factory software company. Direct impact — your products will be used on real manufacturing floors serving global fashion brands. A unique product development model where every product is validated in real operations before market release. Collaborative work environment in Kochi with exposure to Classic Fashion's global manufacturing operations.

descriptionHtml:
About The Team

Would you like to be part of creating a unicorn within a unicorn? Solve some of the biggest challenges facing the financial inclusion of Bharat? Well, then here’s your chance! Financial Services (FS) is one of the fastest growing new businesses at Meesho. It's a large 10X opportunity for Meesho to build financial products for Bharat users and serve the unmet needs of millions of our users. And you will be at the center of this journey, building and scaling the business and serving millions of Meesho users. Meesho FS has several lines of products primarily in lending space, service sellers, users and logistics partners of Meesho.

We aspire to create one of the country’s largest financial services businesses, drawing inspiration from global giants such as Alibaba, Shopee, and Mercado Libre, who have thrived in markets comparable to India and built large financial businesses.

As part of this role, you will get to wear multiple hats, from strategy to execution, problem solving, to team and work closely with the leadership team to build and grow Meesho’s user lending business. You will also work closely with other cross functional teams such as Credit Risk, Product, Technology, User Growth and our external partners, including NBFCs and Banks. Moreover, you will be required to manage budgets and P&L with end to end responsibilities and ownership of managing the business. If you are looking for a high impact role, and a journey to cherish, this role is for you.

About The Role

In this role, you will be expected to lead one or more lending products, you will play a vital role in shaping the direction of the business and essentially own the P&L and success of the product. In addition you will own and manage partnerships with lenders and drive KRs on capital supply. You can expect to work on a wide range of problem statements spanning across business, product, P&L, team management and growth and create impact for our users and the organization.

What You Will Do

  • Build and scale business: develop a deep understanding of user needs for credit and build a differentiated product offering catering to different segments. This will need you to strategize and execute with a problem-first and impact mindset. You will be owning the strategy, building partnerships and execution roadmaps for your P&L
  • Growth: Grow the business, drive adoption, manage pricing and develop marketing strategies and positioning to increase awareness and adoptions on the platform. Take bold bets and ambitious targets for the business.
  • Capital Supply: Create long term lender strategy, work closely with partnership team to bring in the right partners and ensure sufficient capital supply.
  • P&L: Manage the overall P&L, identify levers across pricing and risk and manage them, monitor portfolio performance, collections and work closely with risk teams to identify and mitigate risks,
  • Developing processes and systems:build systems and processes ground up, apply your problem solving that to drive continuous improvements
  • Team Management: manage the user business team, build KPIs/ targets and grow your team. Help them imbibe Meesho values and culture and enable them to be the best version of themselves.
  • Stakeholder Management - you will get to work closely with Meesho founders and the leadership team to build the business, align them on business direction and approvals, including budgets and P&L.


What You Will Need

  • About eight to twelve years of work experience managing a business growth and P&L
  • Lending or fintech experience is preferred,
  • Execution experience, demonstrated examples of delivering high impact projects
  • Strong problem solving mindset and ability to break down complex complex problems, leverage data and come up with impactful solutions
  • Ability to aim big and take bold bets and work in agile fashion
  • Inquisitive mindset, continuous problem solving to improve and grow
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Product Owner – Capstock POD to join our Fund & Investor Services (FIS) Platform team. This role is located in India – Pune.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

  • Own end-to-end product strategy and delivery for Transfer Agency and Capstock flows into accounting, aligned to platform priorities and client outcomes.
  • Lead the migration of legacy processing onto ATOMx, with clear transition plans and execution against defined milestones.
  • Drive standardized and scalable processing that improves straight-through processing, reduces manual intervention, and lowers operational risk.
  • Define and prioritize the roadmap across Transfer Agency and Capstock workflows, including event processing, positions, and accounting integration.
  • Partner with Operations, Technology, and Data teams to align delivery to target operating models, control requirements, and platform strategy.
  • Act as the key coordination point across dependent PODs and platforms to manage upstream and downstream dependencies and ensure adoption of strategic flows.
  • Establish clear ownership boundaries between Product, Operations, and Technology to drive execution discipline and avoid duplication.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Extensive experience in asset servicing or post-trade environments, with strong exposure to Transfer Agency, Capstock, or accounting flows.
  • Proven experience operating at Director or Senior Vice President level as a Product Owner, Product Lead, or equivalent in a complex, regulated organization.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end trade and event lifecycle processing and accounting integration.
  • Experience delivering platform migration or transformation programs, including movement from legacy to strategic architecture.
  • Demonstrated ability to set clear direction, manage dependencies, and drive delivery across multiple teams.
  • Experience leading senior product or change professionals, with accountability for delivery outcomes.

About Us

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

About The Team

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom & BNY LinkedIn

Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards

  • America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
  • World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
  • “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025

Our Benefits And Rewards

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer - Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

descriptionHtml:
Role Description:


Designation: Sr Manager/ DGM/ Associate Director

Band- B4-1/B4-2

Location - Mumbai/ Pune

Line Of Business: Business Collaboration


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Unified Collaboration Product Manager with 12 to 18+ years in product management, telecom, or enterprise collaboration domains. The role will lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of unified collaboration solutions encompassing UCaaS, cloud telephony and video conferencing.

The ideal candidate combines deep domain expertise, strong business insights, and technical understanding to drive innovative, scalable, and customer-centric solutions.


Key Responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Vision

Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and lifecycle for unified collaboration solutions.

Align product strategy with business goals, market trends, and customer needs.

Identify emerging technologies (AI, automation, cloud communications) and integrate into offerings.


Market & Customer Insights

Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer discovery.

Build deep understanding of enterprise collaboration needs across industries.

Translate insights into high-impact product features and differentiation.


Product Development & Delivery

Lead end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation to launch and scaling.

Work closely with engineering, UX, architecture, and operations teams to deliver solutions.

Define product requirements, user stories, and success metrics (KPIs).


Unified Collaboration Ecosystem

Oversee products covering:

Enterprise & cloud voice telephony (VoIP, SIP, PBX)

Video conferencing & meetings platforms

Messaging and team collaboration tools

Ecosystem (tools/EMS/NMS/Automation tools/API Integrations) supporting Services

Integration with enterprise tools (CRM, ITSM, APIs)


Ensure interoperability across platforms and vendors.

Law of the land & its regulations


Go-to-Market & Business Growth

Define pricing, service offering and positioning strategies.

Partner with sales, marketing, and channel teams for successful launches.

Drive revenue growth, adoption, and customer retention.


Stakeholder Management

Collaborate with senior leadership, partners, and vendors.

Manage cross-functional stakeholders across technology, delivery and operations.

Present roadmap, progress, and performance metrics to executives.


Performance & Analytics

Establish KPIs and monitor product performance.

Use data-driven insights to optimize features, UX, and monetization.

Drive continuous improvement and innovation.


Required Qualifications

12 -18+ years of experience in Product Management, Telecom, UCaaS, or Enterprise Collaboration.

Proven track record of launching and scaling unified communication or SaaS products.


Strong understanding of:

Microsoft Teams Cloud Telephony (Teams DR/ Team OC/PBX Solutioning options)

Collaboration ecosystems (Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Cisco Webex, etc.)


Excellent stakeholder management and leadership skills.

Experience working with Global Service Integrators & Global Managed Service Providers.


Preferred Skills:

Experience in AI-driven collaboration (chatbots, transcription, analytics).

Knowledge of market offering vs positioning for MS Cloud Telephony options.

Exposure to security, compliance, and enterprise-grade architecture.

MBA or advanced degree in Business/Technology preferred.


Key Competencies:

Strategic Thinking

Customer-Centric Mindset

Strong Communication & Influencing Skills

Analytical & Data-Driven Decision Making

Execution Excellence

Leadership & Team Collaboration


Success Metrics

Product adoption and customer satisfaction (NPS)

Revenue growth and market share

Time-to-market and delivery efficiency

Platform scalability and reliability

Innovation and feature differentiation
