Job Description

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

About The Job

At Sanofi, we’re committed to providing the next-gen healthcare that patients and customers need. The Digital Launch & Market Product team ( LMP) is one of the key vertical towers within Digital R&D, includes product line teams to serve global regulatory Affairs ( GRA), Patient Safety and Pharmacovigilance (PSPV), R&D CMO/Medical etc. domains. We focus on delivery of innovative digital products to support and accelerate product launches, accelerating cycle times to bring medicines to patients faster while improving operational efficiency and ensure regulatory compliance.

This position operates within Sanofi Digital R&D - Digital Launch & Market Product (LMP) - Patient Safety and Pharmacovigilance (PSPV) Product Line whose mission is to help improve Patient Safety with AI and automation enabled Digital Solutions.

As Digital Product Owner, you will be accountable to: Define - strategy and roadmap, Drive - delivery and management, Measure - value and impact of the Digital Product.

Main Responsibilities –

  • Product Vision
    • Set and communicate - the vision for the product, working closely with Digital and Business Leadership and key stakeholders.
    • Ensure vision is aligned with Company strategic direction.
    • Manage strong relationships and partnerships with Digital R&D verticals and across Business functions, that interact with Portfolio management and decision-making.
    • Stay current in industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in Product management.
    • Identify opportunities for process improvement using AI and automation.
    • Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the product team
  • Product Delivery
    • Define clear and actionable goals to deliver incremental value.
    • Lead delivery of Product from conception, MVP(minimum viable product) through continuous improvements.
    • Define, implement and lead Governance around the Digital Product - to ensure best practices are followed, prioritizations aligned, value realized, risks managed.
    • Ensure collaboration with the architecture, Digital Data and AI, and digital R&D Data Product and Platform teams
    • Ensure Agile framework and methodologies are followed, to deliver incremental value.
    • Manage backlog prioritization, balancing short-term deliverables with long-term goals and breakthrough ideas.
    • Champion modern AI tooling to accelerate design, testing, and iteration.
  • Product Value
    • Ensure AI-driven insights, automated workflows are integrated in the product and aligns with user journey – data, process, people.
    • Drive user adoption by delivering intuitive, user-centric solutions. Gathering regular feedback, monitoring usage metrics, user satisfaction.
    • Ensure each sprint delivers measurable improvements to cycle times, internal productivity, quality and compliance, user experience.
    • Deliver Continuous improvement in changing digital landscape, regulatory requirements and business strategy.
    • Demonstrate product value through measurable use cases
About You

Education & Experience:

  • 10+ IT industry experience with 5+ years of experience working in Digital Product delivery and leadership as a product owner or product manager
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Engineering, or STEM related field. Master degree is preferred.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical industry with knowledge of pharmaceutical Drug lifecycle, R&D value chain.
  • Functional and technical expertise in the Pharmacovigilance ( PV) domain is highly desirable.
  • Experience of software development in a GxP regulated environment is a strong plus.

Key Skills

  • Expertise in leading cross-functional teams to create Digital Strategies and Implementation roadmaps. Distinctive focus on solution objectives and application of product methodologies.
  • Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical designs and solutions, with a strong business and technical acumen
  • Experienced in complex solution implementation & delivery in agile.
  • Demonstrated track record of designing, developing, and delivering transformative digital products – particularly in the AI space is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrate product value through measurable use cases
  • Demonstrate product value through measurable use cases
  • Strong technical/functional background, with the ability to understand and communicate complex functional/technical concepts.
  • Solid knowledge and experience of Lean & Agile practices, UX/UI and Application Design & Integration

About Us

Location - Hyderabad, India

Level - Team Leader/ Professional

Working Pattern - Work from office.

Benefits - Benefits At Ideagen

Salary - this will be discussed at the next stage of the process, if you do have any questions, please feel free to reach out!

Join our dynamic Agile development team as a Technical Product Owner, where you will play a pivotal role in the Software Development Lifecycle, ensuring the timely delivery of innovative products. We are seeking a detail-oriented individual who is passionate about professional advancement, contributing to Sprint backlog development to drive the achievement of Product team goals.

As a Technical Product Owner, you will play a critical role in driving the development and success of our products. You will work closely with the Product Manager and cross-functional teams to gather requirements, prioritise features, and ensure the timely delivery of high-quality products. This is an excellent opportunity for an aspiring Product Owner to gain valuable experience in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

Impact on Strategy

  • Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with stakeholders, and internal teams to gather and document product requirements, ensuring a clear understanding of the desired outcomes.
  • Communication and Coordination: Facilitate effective communication between the development team, and stakeholders. Act as a liaison to clarify requirements, answer questions, and address concerns.
  • User Story Development: Assist in breaking down high-level requirements into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria, ensuring that the development team understands what needs to be built.
  • Sprint Review and Retrospective: Contribute to sprint review sessions to ensure that the product meets customer expectations. Participate in retrospectives to identify areas for improvement and implement lessons learned.
  • Product Documentation: Assist in creating and maintaining product documentation, including user manuals, release notes, and feature descriptions, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Progress Reporting: Report on the progress of the development team to ensure any impacts are communicated and understood early to enable the team to ‘fail-fast’.

Leadership and Management

  • Sprint Planning: Participate in sprint planning sessions, assisting the Product Manager in determining the scope of work for each sprint and establishing achievable goals.
  • Backlog Management: Assist in maintaining and prioritizing the product backlog, ensuring that user stories and tasks are well-defined, estimated, and prioritized based on business value and customer needs.

Any other duties that may be required by your Manager or the Company, providing you have been adequately trained to execute them. These duties may be required from time to time or on a permanent basis.

Skills And Experience

  • 3-5 years of experience in a product-related role, such as Product Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar. Experience in Agile methodologies is preferred.
  • Proven ability to identify and resolve problems effectively, displaying a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Experience with data analytics and metrics tracking desirable.

Technical Expertise

  • Strong Analytical Skills: Ability to analyse complex problems, break them down into smaller components, and propose effective solutions.
  • Excellent Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey ideas and requirements clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborative Nature: Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, cross-functional environment, building relationships and fostering collaboration.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong organisational skills with a keen eye for detail, ensuring that requirements and deliverables are accurately documented and tracked.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, and able to quickly adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
  • Passion for Technology: Enthusiasm for emerging technologies, software development processes, and the ability to stay updated with the latest industry trends.
  • Self-Motivated: A proactive individual who takes ownership of tasks and demonstrates the drive to learn, grow, and take on additional responsibilities.

About Ideagen

Ideagen is the invisible force behind many things we rely on every day - from keeping airplanes soaring in the sky, to ensuring the food on our tables is safe, to helping doctors and nurses care for the sick. So, when you think of Ideagen, think of it as the silent teammate that's always working behind the scenes to help those people who make our lives safer and better. Everyday millions of people are kept safe using Ideagen software. We have offices all over the world including America, Australia, Malaysia and India with people doing lots of different and exciting jobs.

What is next?

If your application meets the requirements for this role, our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch to guide you through the next steps.

To ensure a flexible and inclusive process, please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments by contacting us at recruitment@ideagen.com. All matters will be treated with strict confidence.

At Ideagen, we value the importance of work-life balance and welcome candidates seeking flexible or part-time working arrangements. If this is something you are interested in, please let us know during the application process.

Enhance your career and make the world a safer place!

At Fresenius Medical Care, we are the global leader in kidney care, committed to improving the lives of patients with chronic kidney disease. Within our Care Enablement segment, we develop and provide life-sustaining medical products, digital health solutions, and therapies that empower clinical teams and improve patient outcomes. Our FME Reignite strategy drives transformation through innovation, efficiency, and sustainable growth.

Our values guide how we work:


  • We Care for our patients, each other, and our communities
  • We Connect across teams and borders to deliver excellence together
  • We Commit to doing things the right way— growing with purpose and leading kidney care with integrity and innovation


In-Center as one of three therapy verticals focuses on delivering high-quality, clinic-based hemodialysis to patients worldwide. Its mission is to support healthcare providers in offering safe, consistent, and patient-centered care in dialysis clinics.

The team collaborates across Product Design, Clinical Protocols, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, and Commercial functions to equip clinics with effective, innovative solutions that meet high standards and improve patient outcomes. Join our passionate team and help shape healthcare worldwide!

The Director, Product Management & Upstream Marketing is responsible for defining and driving the global portfolio strategy and lifecycle management, with a strong focus on profitability, competitiveness, and sustainability. The role leads the entry and value‑segment strategy and ensures portfolio alignment with overall business objectives, particularly in highly price‑sensitive and tender‑driven markets. Join our passionate team and help shape healthcare worldwide!

Your Responsibilities:


  • Define and drive the global portfolio strategy, including lifecycle management, optimization, and rationalization
  • Lead the entry and value‑segment strategy to ensure strong competitiveness in price‑sensitive markets
  • Manage portfolio trade‑offs to balance growth, profitability, and complexity
  • Identify and drive initiatives to improve cost, margin, and portfolio efficiency
  • Align closely with value streams and senior leadership on portfolio priorities and decisions
  • Partner with regional and country teams on pricing, tenders, and market‑specific portfolio strategies
  • Develop a deep understanding of competitive dynamics and define response strategies against low‑cost competitors
  • Support countries in the preparation and execution of requests for proposals (RFPs)
  • Provide structured product and portfolio training in collaboration with HQ functions
  • Build strong working relationships with global sales, marketing, and cross‑functional teams
  • Engage senior leadership with clear updates on portfolio performance, risks, and strategic initiatives
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal SOPs


Your Profile:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Life Sciences, or equivalent; MBA or advanced degree in Marketing, Strategy, or General Management
  • 15+ years of experience in product management within the medical device or healthcare industry
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Demonstrated experience managing global portfolios across the full product lifecycle
  • Proven leadership and collaboration skills across cross‑functional and global teams, including the ability to lead and influence within complex matrix organizations without direct authority, with a self‑motivated, results‑oriented approach and comfort operating in dynamic and changing environments
  • Deep market and therapy‑area knowledge, ideally in dialysis or renal care
  • Strong expertise in upstream marketing, portfolio strategy, and lifecycle management
  • Medical‑technical knowledge of hemodialysis products and therapies
  • Experience or familiarity with digital marketing, marketing automation, and project management tools


Our Offer for you:

There is a lot you can discover at Fresenius Medical Care, regardless in which field you are an expert and how much experience you have - all dedicated to your professional journey.


  • Whether in front of or behind the scenes - you are helping to make ever better medicine available to more and more people around the world
  • Individual opportunities for self-determined career planning and professional development
  • A corporate culture in which there is enough room for innovative thinking - to find the best solution together, not the quickest one
  • A large number of committed people with a wide range of skills, talents and experience
  • The benefits of a successful global corporation with the collegial culture of a medium-sized company

descriptionHtml:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

What We'll Bring

We are seeking a Product Owner to join TransUnion’s Global Fraud Solutions team and play a hands-on role in delivering high-quality, customer-focused capabilities across our Core Fraud Solutions.

As a Product Owner, your primary focus will be translating product and business needs into well-defined user stories, supporting development teams through execution, and ensuring delivered functionality meets business expectations. You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA, and business stakeholders, owning day-to-day backlog execution and UAT readiness rather than high-level feature or epic ownership.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to delivery, thrives in Agile environments, and takes pride in the quality and completeness of what gets released.

This position is based in India, with limited travel.

What You'll Bring

What You’ll Do

  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand product vision and roadmap, and translate them into clear, actionable user stories for development teams.
  • Own the day-to-day product backlog execution, including writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, refining requirements, and supporting backlog grooming sessions.
  • Break down requirements into executable stories that can be delivered within a sprint, ensuring clarity for engineering and QA teams.
  • Create lightweight wireframes, user flows, or mockups to clearly communicate user experience and functional expectations.
  • Actively support Agile scrum teams by answering questions, clarifying requirements, and making quick trade-off decisions during development.
  • Plan, coordinate, and participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by defining test scenarios, validating solutions, and ensuring readiness for release.
  • Partner with QA, Engineering, and stakeholders to ensure defects, enhancements, and refinements are properly understood and prioritized.
  • Work effectively in a matrixed, global environment with multiple development teams and stakeholders.
  • Use modern tools, including AI-enabled tools, to improve productivity in story writing, analysis, documentation, testing support, and overall delivery efficiency.

Impact You'll Make

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or in a similar delivery-focused product role within B2B software or services.
  • Strong hands-on experience writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and supporting sprint execution.
  • Proven experience working in Agile/Scrum teams and supporting multiple sprint teams simultaneously.
  • Solid experience with UAT execution, including test planning, validation, and stakeholder sign-off.
  • Ability to create wireframes, mockups, or user flows to support requirement clarity and user experience discussions.
  • Familiarity with identity fraud, risk management, authentication, or financial services platforms is highly desirable.
  • Good understanding of application architecture, APIs, databases, and system integrations, enabling effective collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Comfort using AI-powered tools to enhance analysis, documentation, testing workflows, or delivery outcomes (hands-on experience is a plus; curiosity and openness are essential).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, or a related field. MBA preferred

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

Consultant, Product Management

Description

About Norstella:

Norstella is a premier and critical global life sciences data and AI solutions provider dedicated to improving patient access to life-saving therapies. Norstella supports pharmaceutical and biotech companies across the full drug development lifecycle — from pipeline to patient. Our mission is simple: to help our clients bring therapies to market faster and more efficiently, ultimately impacting patient lives.

Norstella unites market-leading brands - Citeline, Evaluate, MMIT, Panalgo, Skipta and The Dedham Group and delivers must-have answers and insights, leveraging AI, for critical strategic, clinical, and commercial decision-making. We help our clients: 

  • Accelerate the drug development cycle 
  • Assess competition and bring the right drugs to market 
  • Make data driven commercial and financial decisions
  • Match and recruit patients for clinical trials
  • Identify and address barriers to therapies


Norstella serves most pharmaceutical and biotech companies around the world, along with regulators like the FDA, and payers. By providing critical proprietary data supporting AI-driven workflows, Norstella helps clients make decisions faster and with greater confidence. Norstella’s investments in AI are transforming how data is consumed and decisions are made, disrupting inefficient legacy workflows and helping the industry become more efficient, innovative, and responsive to patient needs.

Job Description

  • Norstella is seeking a skilled and dynamic Technical Product Owner with a background in Market Access to join our team.
  • As a Technical Product Owner, you will play a crucial role in driving the development and success of our innovative internal platforms and solutions.
  • You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, stakeholders to ensure the successful delivery of these solutions.
  • MMIT, a Norstella company, is focused on solving the “what and why” of market access, and has been a trusted, go-to-market partner to more than 1,300 biopharma and payer customers for nearly three decades. MMIT believes that patients who need life-saving treatments should not face delays because accessing drugs can be confusing. MMIT’s expert teams of clinicians, data specialists and market researchers provide clarity and confidence so that our clients can make better decisions. 


Responsibilities

  • Manage the product backlog and prioritize features based on business value, customer needs, and market trends.
  • Define, refine, and communicate product vision, goals, and user stories to the development team and stakeholders.
  • Collaborate closely with the development team to translate requirements into actionable tasks and ensure timely delivery of high-quality products.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, address concerns, and ensure alignment on product strategy and roadmap.
  • Facilitate agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for platform-related questions, issues, and updates from stakeholders.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of the market, industry regulations, and market access challenges to inform decision-making.

  • Collaborate closely with product, engineering, sales, and customer success teams to ensure alignment between user experience and commercial outcomes.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating experience in designing dashboards, data-heavy interfaces, and scalable SaaS systems.
  • Proven ability to design products that drive user engagement, retention, or expansion through UX and interaction design.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise user behavior, adoption dynamics, and product-led growth principles.
  • Strong proficiency in Figma and experience building or maintaining scalable design systems.
  • Analytical mindset with familiarity in A/B testing, product analytics, and usage-driven design iteration.
  • Ability to operate as a high-ownership individual contributor while influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Strong strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution capability in fast-paced environments.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate design decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working in high-visibility roles where design directly impacts business outcomes.

  • Fully remote opportunity with global collaboration across distributed teams.
  • High autonomy role with ownership over end-to-end product design strategy and execution.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Position Name: Product Owner- 5G RAN

Location: Bangalore

Exp: 8- 14 years

In our software development, we use methods and principles from Lean and Agile methodologies to create products that excels. Early customer and stakeholder interaction are a key element in our development process. We rely on team collective responsibility to complete all tasks according to a prioritized backlog.

To expand our organization’s capability and responsiveness towards market needs we are looking for ambitious, intelligent, creative and inspiring individuals to join us. We provide a fun and challenging environment where you can grow and help to inspire your colleagues to further growth.

What You Will Do

As OPO, you and your teams will work in one or more programs, to secure best possible time to market for the features in the program scope, with quality and in line with allocated capabilities and priorities. The OPO is responsible for the features, product improvements and TRs within products from a business and customer perspective, to maximize the product value.

  • Secure that the feature scope is clear, and that the solution has the right scope, fit for the purpose.
  • Communicate, coordinate and align feature scope, time and risks with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure that the Feature information is visible and transparent in the backlog.
  • Secure the overall priorities in the Team backlog.
  • Secure that the team knows what we do and why we do it to contribute to high team motivation.
  • Secure that each feature is developed with good quality and promote a product level quality thinking.
  • Develop business, value and technical understanding within the domain.

You Will Bring

To take on this role you need to have a broad technical know-how within software development combined with great people skills. This enables you to make legitimate prioritizations, identify risks and opportunities, as well as drive effective discussions within the development team. As OPO, you’ll be one of the leaders within the organization, hence it is important that you have a high interest in people, processes and technologies. You are passionate about Lean and Agile development and can articulate a clear vision that motivates others and inspires them to move in the same direction.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience (8+ years) within product development; as product owner, developer, team facilitator or similar roles.
  • Good communication skills, be able to communicate with internal and external stakeholders at different levels.
  • Good business understanding.
  • Good understanding of the domain/area.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within a dynamic team environment.
  • Proven decision-making skills, including the ability to assess information, weigh alternatives, and take decisive action.
  • Experience working according to Lean and Agile methodologies.
  • Lead and drive with high energy.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Diversity, equity and inclusion (tietoevry.com)

title: Product Owner - Career
description: Whether you started from the product side and developed technical skills or started as a technical resource, you have a knack for the product side of the business. You possess the necessary technical product knowledge to drive strategic conversations about the product and enhance value to Equifax and its customers.Equifax is seeking a  technical product owner  who is a master at bridging the desires of the customer and the capabilities of the technology, removing barriers to software development. You will be responsible for grooming the product backlog and have insight into technical requirements of individual stories thus creating a more efficient user experience.What You Will Do Connects with the Customer in partnership with Product Management - Know the customer & stakeholders: Understands the needs of customers and stakeholders in a broader context; Develops partnership relationships with key engineering and QA counterparts and engages with Architecture teams as needed; Understands the Problem(s) to be solved: Participates in interviews with users, customers and stakeholders to understand requirements; Can articulate and decompose the work into discrete increments that align to customer needs; Provides inputs in business/technical requirements definition; Develops whole product solutions: Understands the end product/functionality needed and can articulate a broader need to deliver a more holistic solution; Provides guidance to engineering and QA teams when clarity about business requirements is needed.  Contributes to the Plan and Roadmap - Solutioning and Estimation: Active participant in solutioning and epic decomposition process to groom the backlog of stories, as well as initial t-shirt sizing sessions; Provides inputs to QE partners to ensure testing approach and high level use cases are considered in the solution and estimation; Helps drive MVP definition with stakeholders when applicable; Dependency management: Drives the process to identify, capture and document dependencies required to deliver the plan in partnership with engineering and architecture teams; Interacts with dependent teams to understand dependencies; Backlog Prioritization and planning: Active participant in the process of initial estimates and value/effort assessment to define scope of quarterly increments; Contributes to the analysis of how work should be sequenced and the implications to the critical path.  Manages & Prioritizes Team Backlog(s) - User Story creation: Reviews initial drafts of stories developed and/or contributes to refinement for Product Management review; Prioritization and sprint planning: Aligns prioritization with Product Management and Product Owner best practices for defined backlog; Creates sprint, sprint goal, ensures sprint plans are in place for the current sprint and the subsequent two sprints; Drives alignment with upstream dependencies to deliver; Testing and Acceptance Criteria: Drives adherence to story acceptance criteria to ensure development team delivers according to desired outcome and readiness checklist; Partners with QE and Engineering lead to define testing approach, scope and planning; Provides final sign-off/acceptance of stories; Demos: Reviews initial drafts and partners with product managers to prepare sprint/quarterly demos. Is capable of presenting the demo itself.  Getting and Applying Feedback & Lessons Learned - Captures feedback from Demos: Actively lead documentation and synthesize feedback from demos for tangible future work efforts to be considered in the backlog with Product Management; Delivery Retrospectives: Velocity, quality (incidents/bugs), reasons for delays: Understands drivers of team velocity; Understands testing gaps that drove incidents and bugs; Understands drivers for delays in committed deliverables; Synthetizes learnings and proposes a prioritized set of changes in partnership with technology partners; Monitors adoption KPIs: Understands metrics driving the adoption success of the released value and proposes changes to upcoming deliverables to drive improvements; Adopts feedback in future iterations: Drives the scope and/or changes to new release increments to feedback collected. What Experience You Need– Section required (customize as necessary) Bachelor's degree in a related discipline strongly preferred; equivalent experience may be considered  5-7 years of product owner experience in a cloud-based and/or SaaS environment  Working experience using Agile methodologies, facilitating Agile ceremonies and Lean product management required  Working experience with data structures, data analytics and AI concepts preferred  Experience working with cross functional teams preferred  Exposure and experience understanding and tracking capacity against the budget of product initiatives  Cloud certification strongly preferred What Could Set You Apart Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.  6+ years of experience as a Product Owner or similar role in a technical environment.  Proven experience working with batch processing systems and data products.  Strong understanding of data management, data integration, and data quality principles. descriptionHtml:
Whether you started from the product side and developed technical skills or started as a technical resource, you have a knack for the product side of the business. You possess the necessary technical product knowledge to drive strategic conversations about the product and enhance value to Equifax and its customers.

Equifax is seeking a technical product owner who is a master at bridging the desires of the customer and the capabilities of the technology, removing barriers to software development. You will be responsible for grooming the product backlog and have insight into technical requirements of individual stories thus creating a more efficient user experience.

What You Will Do

  • Connects with the Customer in partnership with Product Management - Know the customer & stakeholders: Understands the needs of customers and stakeholders in a broader context; Develops partnership relationships with key engineering and QA counterparts and engages with Architecture teams as needed; Understands the Problem(s) to be solved: Participates in interviews with users, customers and stakeholders to understand requirements; Can articulate and decompose the work into discrete increments that align to customer needs; Provides inputs in business/technical requirements definition; Develops whole product solutions: Understands the end product/functionality needed and can articulate a broader need to deliver a more holistic solution; Provides guidance to engineering and QA teams when clarity about business requirements is needed.
  • Contributes to the Plan and Roadmap - Solutioning and Estimation: Active participant in solutioning and epic decomposition process to groom the backlog of stories, as well as initial t-shirt sizing sessions; Provides inputs to QE partners to ensure testing approach and high level use cases are considered in the solution and estimation; Helps drive MVP definition with stakeholders when applicable; Dependency management: Drives the process to identify, capture and document dependencies required to deliver the plan in partnership with engineering and architecture teams; Interacts with dependent teams to understand dependencies; Backlog Prioritization and planning: Active participant in the process of initial estimates and value/effort assessment to define scope of quarterly increments; Contributes to the analysis of how work should be sequenced and the implications to the critical path.
  • Manages & Prioritizes Team Backlog(s) - User Story creation: Reviews initial drafts of stories developed and/or contributes to refinement for Product Management review; Prioritization and sprint planning: Aligns prioritization with Product Management and Product Owner best practices for defined backlog; Creates sprint, sprint goal, ensures sprint plans are in place for the current sprint and the subsequent two sprints; Drives alignment with upstream dependencies to deliver; Testing and Acceptance Criteria: Drives adherence to story acceptance criteria to ensure development team delivers according to desired outcome and readiness checklist; Partners with QE and Engineering lead to define testing approach, scope and planning; Provides final sign-off/acceptance of stories; Demos: Reviews initial drafts and partners with product managers to prepare sprint/quarterly demos. Is capable of presenting the demo itself.
  • Getting and Applying Feedback & Lessons Learned - Captures feedback from Demos: Actively lead documentation and synthesize feedback from demos for tangible future work efforts to be considered in the backlog with Product Management; Delivery Retrospectives: Velocity, quality (incidents/bugs), reasons for delays: Understands drivers of team velocity; Understands testing gaps that drove incidents and bugs; Understands drivers for delays in committed deliverables; Synthetizes learnings and proposes a prioritized set of changes in partnership with technology partners; Monitors adoption KPIs: Understands metrics driving the adoption success of the released value and proposes changes to upcoming deliverables to drive improvements; Adopts feedback in future iterations: Drives the scope and/or changes to new release increments to feedback collected.

What Experience You Need

– Section required (customize as necessary)

  • Bachelor's degree in a related discipline strongly preferred; equivalent experience may be considered
  • 5-7 years of product owner experience in a cloud-based and/or SaaS environment
  • Working experience using Agile methodologies, facilitating Agile ceremonies and Lean product management required
  • Working experience with data structures, data analytics and AI concepts preferred
  • Experience working with cross functional teams preferred
  • Exposure and experience understanding and tracking capacity against the budget of product initiatives
  • Cloud certification strongly preferred

What Could Set You Apart

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Owner or similar role in a technical environment.
  • Proven experience working with batch processing systems and data products.
  • Strong understanding of data management, data integration, and data quality principles.
  • Proficient in Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence).
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.

  • You are a self-starter who is organized, detail oriented, takes initiative with minimal direction, and understands concepts quickly
  • You understand the value of product ownership and can effectively communicate the value proposition
  • You have experience working with multiple partners in a global setting with varying level of needs
  • You bring a consultative, creative and process driven approach to your work
  • You have an aptitude for handling multiple concurrent demands and prioritizing responsibilities in a dynamic, high energy environment
  • Your problem-solving skills enable you to effectively and creatively find solutions for hard problems while maintaining a high level of professionalism and integrity

descriptionHtml:
Summary

We’re seeking a hands-on engineer to accelerate developer productivity and engineering quality by operationalizing GitHub Copilot (Business/Enterprise) across the SDLC, with a strong focus on secure, governed adoption. You will design and maintain Copilot customization assets (prompt files, custom instructions, reusable agents) for common .NET delivery workflows, and build supporting GenAI services on Azure where needed. You will partner with platform engineering, security, and product teams to define guardrails, measure impact (productivity, quality, and risk), and continuously improve developer experience.

Technical Expertise & Essential Job Functions

GitHub Copilot Enablement & Productization

Own and evolve an enterprise-ready Copilot enablement approach: usage patterns, prompt standards, and governance for regulated environments.

Create and curate a repository-backed library of reusable prompt files (.github/prompts) for common engineering scenarios (bug fixes, brownfield enhancements from user stories, refactoring, test generation, security remediation).

Author and maintain custom instruction files (repository and organization patterns) to enforce coding standards, architecture conventions, error handling, logging, and testing practices.

Design interactive ‘guided’ prompts that ask one question at a time, minimize friction for low adopters, and require user confirmation before applying code changes.

Collaborate with teams to integrate Copilot into day-to-day workflows in Visual Studio and GitHub (PR templates, checklists, review guidance).

Guardrails, Security & Quality

Define and implement guardrails so AI-assisted code can’t land without required quality and security signals (tests, reviews, and automated scanning).

Configure and enforce GitHub Advanced Security practices where applicable (CodeQL code scanning, dependency review/alerts, secret scanning/push protection) and integrate results into PR gating.

Establish measurement for AI-assisted development: Copilot usage metrics (suggested vs added LOC, acceptance actions) and repo outcomes (review cycle time, defect inflow proxies, security findings), with clear limitations and directional interpretation.

Partner with AppSec and compliance stakeholders to ensure safe handling of sensitive data in prompts, logs, and test artifacts.

  • NET Engineering & Platform Integration

Contribute to and review C#/.NET codebases (ASP.NET Core, EF Core) to ensure Copilot guidance and templates match real architecture and patterns.

Build small, maintainable developer tooling and automation (e.g., GitHub Actions, internal utilities, code generators where appropriate) that complements Copilot rather than replacing engineering discipline.

Create and maintain sample reference implementations and ‘golden paths’ that demonstrate secure patterns, test-first fixes, and high-quality PRs.

GenAI Solution Engineering (Supporting)

Develop LLM-powered workflows on Azure (Azure OpenAI) to support developer experience and engineering insights (e.g., PR summarization, guided debugging, quality dashboards).

Implement prompt contracts, tool/function calling patterns, and evaluation harnesses for reliability, cost, and safety.

Where needed, build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and connectors to enterprise knowledge sources with grounding/citations.

Basic Qualifications

Security-minded engineering: familiarity with secure coding practices and integrating automated checks (SAST, dependency scanning, secret detection) into the delivery pipeline.

Azure fundamentals for deploying services (App Service/Functions/Container Apps) and secure configuration (Key Vault, RBAC).

Ability to convert moderately detailed requirements into clear designs (ADRs/sequence diagrams) and production-ready implementations.

Nice-to-Have

GitHub Copilot administration experience (policy management, organizational customization, adoption measurement and reporting).

Experience building developer tooling or IDE extensions (Visual Studio/VS Code), internal CLIs, or PR automation.

Hands-on with GitHub Advanced Security (CodeQL, secret scanning, dependency review/Dependabot) and rulesets/required checks for merge gating.

Experience with Azure OpenAI, prompt evaluation, and/or RAG (Azure AI Search or equivalent).

Data engineering and analytics experience for telemetry pipelines and dashboards (SQL, data modeling, Power BI).

Core Competencies

Developer Productivity Leadership: pragmatic enablement, playbooks, and training that drive real adoption.

System Design: clear, scalable architecture with documented trade-offs.

Code Quality: readable, tested, maintainable code with robust error handling.

Security & Governance: secure-by-default patterns, auditability, and responsible AI practices.

Measurement & Insights: metrics that are transparent, repeatable, and grounded in tooling constraints.

Other Qualifications

Copilot customization assets (prompts/instructions/workflows) that materially improve cycle time and developer experience without compromising quality or security.

Clear, trustworthy reporting of Copilot adoption and impact, including known limitations of telemetry and measurement.

Reduced friction for common work (small fixes, bug triage, test creation) through repeatable Copilot-guided workflows that keep developers in control.

Well-governed, secure AI-assisted development practices aligned with enterprise standards.

About Us

Volante Technologies is the leading global provider of low-code cloud Payments as a Service solution for financial businesses. We are disruptors and innovators and we are growing fast. For the last three years, we have been the #1 seller of wholesale payment systems worldwide. At Volante, we are all about revolutionizing the world of Payments.

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly driven Platform Product Owner (PO) to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of the foundational platform that powers our cutting-edge payments application.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned techno-functional leader with deep experience in banking technology, strong architecture and solutioning expertise, and a hands-on mindset to bridge business goals with platform capabilities. As the PO for our platform, you will work at the intersection of product, engineering, architecture, and operations to ensure our core platform evolves in line with business needs, modern architecture principles, and enterprise-grade scalability.

What You’ll Do

  • Define, own, and manage the product roadmap for the platform in alignment with the strategic direction of our payments application.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across engineering, QA, architecture, business, and operations to ensure smooth delivery.
  • Prioritize backlog items based on business impact, technical dependencies, and delivery feasibility.
  • Act as the voice of the platform, communicating roadmap updates, capability rollouts, and platform benefits to business and technical audiences.
  • Monitor and evaluate platform performance and continuously identify opportunities for improvement, modernization, and innovation.
  • Ensure that all platform-level work adheres to regulatory, security, and compliance standards in the payments domain.
  • Continuously evaluate and optimize infrastructure and design patterns for maximum efficiency, reusability, and future-readiness.
  • Define and enforce platform-wide non-functional requirements (NFRs) related to performance, reliability, and security.
  • Ensure alignment of platform architecture and operational standards with industry benchmarks and best practices (e.g., latency, throughput, uptime SLAs).

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
  • 12 to 15 years of experience in Banking IT with a strong focus on platforms, architecture, or product solutioning (payments domain preferred).
  • Proven track record in solution architecture and design across banking or financial services domains.
  • Experience with platform product ownership or roadmap management is highly desirable.
  • Strong functional knowledge of the banking/payments ecosystem, including payment orchestration, settlement, and reconciliation flows.
  • Technical proficiency in one or more industry-standard BPM tools, orchestration engines, or workflow platforms.
  • Hands-on understanding of integration technologies including APIs (REST, SOAP), middleware, event-driven architecture, and data pipelines.
  • Working experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies, backlog management, and sprint planning.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills — able to collaborate across technical and business teams.
  • High attention to detail with excellent documentation and presentation skills.
  • Exposure to AI-driven use cases or intelligent automation is an added advantage.

What We Offer

✔ Competitive compensation

✔ Health benefits

✔ Remote/flexible work options

✔ Professional development support

📍 Location

Chennai, Pune

At Volante Technologies, we believe diversity drives innovation and inclusion fuels success. We are committed to creating a performance driven workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic self to work. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and ensure equitable opportunities for growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, age, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. Together as ONE TEAM, we celebrate differences and foster collaboration, creativity, and belonging.

descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

Palo Alto Networks is seeking a Director of Strategy & Operations to help drive transformation for our AI Experiences organization within the Network Security business.

This organization sits within Product Management and operates at the intersection of Customer Support, Product, Engineering, and Operations. Our mission is to fundamentally reimagine customer support through AI, automation, product-driven serviceability, and scalable operational transformation.

This role will serve as a key strategic leader and operational partner to senior executives across Product, Engineering, Support, IT, and Operations. You will work directly on some of the company’s highest-priority transformation initiatives spanning AI-enabled support experiences, organizational transformation, operational excellence, and product-serviceability strategy.

The role is designed for highly strategic, first-principles thinkers who are equally comfortable shaping executive-level strategy, driving large-scale operational programs, and rolling up their sleeves to execute in fast-moving environments.

This leader will build and manage a high-performing India-based Strategy & Operations team, including a distributed team spanning strategy, operations, analytics, and product management initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead strategic initiatives for the AI Experiences organization within Network Security
  • Partner closely with senior executives across Product, Engineering, Customer Support, and Operations to solve complex business and operational challenges
  • Structure ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses, perform data-driven analysis, and drive actionable recommendations
  • Drive cross-functional transformation programs from strategy through execution
  • Build executive-level deliverables including strategic narratives, business cases, operating models, roadmap plans, and transformation updates
  • Support operational planning, organizational scaling, governance rhythms, and business performance management
  • Drive AI-enabled transformation initiatives focused on improving customer support outcomes, operational efficiency, and product serviceability
  • Operate as a force multiplier for leadership teams by driving alignment across multiple organizations and stakeholders
  • Manage and mentor a team and cross-functional contributors across strategy, operations, analytics, and PM-related initiatives
  • Establish scalable operating mechanisms, tracking frameworks, and execution cadences across strategic programs
  • Partner with global stakeholders across NAM, EMEA and JAPAC to drive coordinated execution
  • Help shape the long-term operating model and strategic direction of the AI Experiences organization

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional experience with significant experience in management consulting, strategy, business operations, or transformation roles
  • Prior experience at a top-tier consulting firm strongly preferred
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to communicate effectively with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Exceptional structured problem-solving and first-principles thinking capabilities
  • Experience driving large-scale transformation or operational improvement initiatives
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational execution
  • Strong analytical and storytelling capabilities, including development of executive-ready presentations and business cases
  • Experience operating in highly cross-functional, matrixed environments
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing teams and influencing without direct authority
  • Self-starter mentality with the ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments
  • Strong collaboration mindset and willingness to “roll up sleeves” to get things done

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in enterprise software, SaaS, AI/GenAI, customer support, or product operations environments is preferred
  • MBA or equivalent graduate degree preferred

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join Siemens Gamesa and step into a hands-on role where you shape how SCADA hardware platforms are built, configured, and delivered at scale. You start your day partnering with engineering, production, and procurement to ensure the right hardware and software, BOMs, and variants are ready for real projects. You lead decisions that balance standardization, flexibility, cost, and compliance, keeping platforms reliable and easy to manufacture. Along the way, you stay close to business units on production processes and suppliers, turning long-term platform standards into practical, repeatable solutions that support the global energy transition.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Own and maintain the generic and configurable Bill of Materials (BOM) for SCADA projects across business units
  • Define and manage product variants and part numbers, ensuring accuracy, usability, and lifecycle clarity
  • Collaborate with engineering, production, and suppliers to ensure hardware platforms meet software, system, and project requirements
  • Ensure platforms are compliance-ready, including CE and UL marking, working closely with internal teams and suppliers
  • Partner with Business units, production facilities, procurement, and service teams to deliver manufacturable, scalable, and well-documented SCADA solutions


What You Bring

  • Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or in a similar role within hardware, platform, or industrial systems
  • Strong understanding of BOM structures, product variants, and product lifecycle management
  • Hands-on experience working with production environments, suppliers, and procurement teams
  • Familiarity with product compliance and certification standards such as CE and UL
  • Clear, confident communication skills and the ability to collaborate across technical, operational, and commercial stakeholders


About The Team

You will join the Platform Production Team within Siemens Gamesa, focusing on SCADA hardware platforms and BOM management. The team works across engineering, production, procurement, suppliers, and delivery organizations to ensure SCADA platforms are reliable, compliant, and easy to configure. Together, the team supports the full lifecycle of SCADA panel deliveries, from design and production to installation and upgrades. Collaboration, trust, and practical problem-solving are central to how the team operates. The work directly supports multiple business units and real customer projects worldwide.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by multiple nationalities. We celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

  • Opportunities to work with a global team
  • Medical benefits
  • Remote/Flexible work
  • Paid holidays and parental leave
  • Employer-funded pension
  • Subsidised lunch and more

Position Title - Head - Application & Product Development

Years of Experience - 18 to 22

Location - Vilayat, Bharuch, Gujarat


Job Purpose

Establish a fully developed Research & Development Centre targeting to Applied research for Chlor-Alkali products to bring in improvement /value addition to existing Products /Processes and develop a range of products, applications and product variants to suit requirements for Industrial/ water treatment/ Plastic and allied sector aligned to business objective.

Build strong technical competence in resolving customer problems, testing, analysis for Chlor-Alkali products with support for required certification of products.


Key Result Areas


1 - Establishment Research center & execution of research: Identification and execution of long term projects & goals for R&D Centre

  • Identify new segments and markets that require new products and work in collaboration with marketing to develop new products and applications
  • Establishment of Plasticizer Centre
  • Chart out the mandate for the Application Development Center
  • Prepare and pursue Annual P&B for R & D Centre and seek necessary budget approvals
  • Preparation of monthly MIS dashboards and deck presentation in reviews. (Meeting with BH, SBU Head & CMO)
  • Selection of skilled technical resources at R&D Centre

2 - New Product & Application development: Develop applications/ new product development and formulations

  • Understand and analyze the existing market trends, in-house competencies and propose development.
  • Ensure field testing of products to map them to the range of applications.
  • Work closely with Supply chain in optimizing and standardizing raw materials and testing procedures

3 - Recognition, accreditation, collaboration & certification: Identify and collaborate with various bodies for recognitions, accreditations as well collaborate with institutes for research projects and product Certification

  • Coordinate with Government agencies to complete the requisites and file necessary applications.
  • Identify and collaborate with recognized institutes/ organization to collaborate on the research projects.
  • Identification of required certification and ensuring requirement for existing ceritficates for all the products for DCA
  • Supporting the Units for annual audits and ensuring closure of NCs

4 - Product Improvement: Ensure product consistency and improvement by pilot trials.

Monitor, audit and control all testing procedures and set benchmark for product standards.

  • Extend support to the manufacturing team for improvement in existing products and processes.
  • Set up pilot tests, quality plans, procedures, documentations and report
  • Assist marketing in developing product data sheets, brochures, and other supporting documents

5 - Process Improvement: Ensure process reliability by pilot trials.

Monitor, audit and control all testing procedures and set benchmark for process standards.

  • Extend support to the manufacturing team for improvement in existing processes.
  • Set up pilot tests, quality plans, procedures, documentations and report

6 - People development & management: Managing and motivating team and ensure team has relevant skill set and abilities to perform.

  • Have clear goals & review mechanism for all the team members.
  • Formulate training plans for the Team.
  • Provide regular guidance, motivation & clear directions to team members.

7 - Technical support to customers & sales team: Responsible for building expertise and capabilities and support customers and internal team on technical front.

  • Build knowledge pool at Center by evaluating raw material, products and applications.
  • Regular trainings on NPD/ Application/ trends for internal team and dealers / customers
  • Closely work with customers to identify issues and accordingly work out solutions
  • Organize pilot and plant scale trails at customer site
  • Management of customer complaints, Improvement and communication to management

8 - Communication & IPR

  • Attend seminars and exhibitions to make presentations research findings.
  • Ensure publication and patenting of research findings

9 - Safety & policies: Ensuring Safety practices and implementation of policies

  • Ensuring safety practices in the laboratory at all levels including metrological conditions
  • Ensure implementation of all the HR processes and policies

descriptionHtml:
Who Are We?

RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.

We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.

RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.

Role Overview

The Chief of Staff, Product is a high-impact, high-trust role at the center of RZR's product organization. You will work as a direct partner to the VP of Product — not as a scheduler or note-taker, but as an operator and force multiplier who translates roadmap direction into clear plans, owned milestones, and measurable outcomes.

You will work across Engineering, Design, Analytics, GTM, and Finance, removing execution friction, improving decision quality, and ensuring the organisation stays focused on its highest-leverage product work. You'll own the product operating cadence end-to-end, build executive materials for board and leadership reviews, run deep-dive analyses when needed, and step in directly to drive critical initiatives from problem definition through delivery.

The ideal candidate is a sharp operator and analytical thinker who is genuinely comfortable in ambiguity, can hold their own in any cross-functional room, and cares deeply about outcomes — not activity or optics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end execution of high-priority product and cross-functional initiatives, from problem definition through delivery and follow-through
  • Translate roadmap direction and product strategy into clear plans, milestones, ownership structures, and success metrics
  • Partner with leaders across Engineering, Design, Analytics, GTM, Finance, and People to manage dependencies and ensure timely delivery
  • Own the product operating cadence: roadmap reviews, quarterly and sprint planning, OKR tracking, and executive product reviews
  • Build structured analyses, decision memos, and business cases to support product leadership in high-stakes decisions
  • Run product and usage deep dives directly when needed to unblock decisions or accelerate outcomes
  • Prepare leadership materials for product reviews, board discussions, and strategic planning cycles
  • Track progress against product priorities and ensure decisions are documented, communicated, and executed across the organisation
  • Step in flexibly to cover execution gaps on critical product initiatives as business needs evolve

Required Skills And Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field
  • 5+ years in Chief of Staff, Product Operations, Strategy, Business Operations, Consulting, Program Management, or Product Management — ideally in or adjacent to a product organisation
  • Proven track record leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in fast-paced, high-growth environments
  • Strong analytical skills: structuring ambiguous problems, interpreting product and usage data, and translating insight into action

descriptionHtml:
Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in product management, or a related technical role, including 3 years of people management experience

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience applying AI/ML (including Generative AI or Large Language Models) to solve complex business or user problems, particularly in areas like customer support, sales enablement, workflow automation, or policy issues.
  • Experience with or strong understanding of the Google Ads ecosystem and advertiser needs.
  • Experience working in a complex, cross-functional organization, and influencing senior executives (e.g., Sales, Support, Policy, Engineering leadership).
  • Highly analytical with strong problem solving, data analysis skills as well as proven business judgment.

About The Job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Google Ads is helping power the open internet with the best technology that connects and creates value for people, publishers, advertisers, and Google. We’re made up of multiple teams, building Google’s Advertising products including search, display, shopping, travel and video advertising, as well as analytics. Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses with useful ads. We help grow businesses of all sizes from small businesses, to large brands, to YouTube creators, with effective advertiser tools that deliver measurable results. We also enable Google to engage with customers at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Define and execute a multi-year AI product goal and roadmap, addressing critical advertiser issues and leveraging data and user insights from advertisers, sellers, and support agents.
  • Align goal and land product roadmaps and features across a wide variety of cross-functional partners and leadership. Collaborate effectively with engineering teams to translate product goal into technical specifications and solutions, particularly involving complex AI/ML applications.
  • Partner closely with design, engineering, research, sales, and support operations to ensure cohesive product development and successful launches for High Touch Services.
  • Advocate deeply for users, establish domain expertise in advertiser challenges, and understand how they derive value from ads and support. When our partners succeed, we succeed.
  • Clearly communicate the product goal and value proposition to stakeholders across CE, Ads, GBO, Sales, and Support leadership.


Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

descriptionHtml:
Global Custody: Asset Servicing Product Development (Corporate Actions, Income, Tax and Corporate Governance) lead

The Product organisation is recruiting for the lead role covering Corporate Actions, Income, Tax and Corporate Governance supporting Global Head of Custody Product Development globally.

The individual will partner with the Product team, Global Delivery (operations) and Technology to execute on the overall custody product development initiatives and agenda, in alignment with Custody product strategic objective to strengthen State Street’s position in the industry. State Street’s product organisation is leading an exciting period of transformation for the business and requires experienced leaders to take the business forward.

The role will Initiate and support designing, developing solutions and closing product gaps to support client retention, client growth, enhance client experience and operating framework including product standards for Asset Servicing, including drive and oversee execution of approved product change/development. The focus of the role is building out the SME/BA capabilities within asset servicing practice in Custody covering across all key segments – asset managers, asset owners , SWF and FIs

Function

  • As the lead you will establish the Asset servicing practice that has the depth and expertise to effectively execute on the overall custody product development initiatives and agenda described above. The role reports to the Head of Custody Product Development.
  • The role requires you to be proactively involved in the assessment of available market intelligence (trends, innovations, regulations, market changes) and stakeholder feedback (clients and coverage/product management) to support the evolution of the custody business.


Responsibilities

Vice President will be responsible for the following :

  • Support the development and ongoing maintenance of the Custody product suite, contributing to NIAT growth through product enhancements and digitisation, improved client value, and delivery aligned by geography and capability.
  • Drive the delivery of the Asset Servicing / Core Custody product roadmap, working in collaboration with Custody Product Development leadership and contributing analysis, execution input, and dependency management.
  • Perform analysis of product‑related change, including development of commercially viable and client‑focused business cases, and support prioritization of product, operational, and regulatory change in collaboration with Product Management, Technology, and Global Delivery.
  • Ensure delivery activities remain aligned with applicable regulation and internal policies, escalating issues and risks as appropriate.
  • Support design and efficiency improvements to the operating model, standards, and technical architecture, working with Product Management, Technology, and Global Delivery to drive simplification where possible.
  • Contribute to external and internal market awareness by gathering industry intelligence and participating in relevant forums and working groups to inform product and capability evolution.
  • Support governance activities, including compliance with policies and frameworks, and assist with tracking and oversight of issues, risks, audit, and compliance items related to assigned initiatives.
  • Prepare materials and present updates to senior management as required, and support delivery of assigned initiatives across the change lifecycle.


Skills

  • Custody and operational background or experience
  • Subject matter knowledge across custody capabilities. (e.g. Corporate Actions, Income, SWIFT, Settlements, Tax and Corporate Governance)
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Prior experience of successfully delivering change in a complex environment whilst managing competing environments, and delivering projects using Agile and Waterfall techniques
  • Proven change agent with track record of delivery
  • Integration and understanding of impact on Data Management
  • Track record of engagement with complex clients, solutioning operating models and translating requirements into feature function capability for State Street Custody platform
  • Familiarity with industry integration tools and their applicability in shortening the chain of custody across the investment lifecycle
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with an ability to navigate organization through the solution delivery cycle
  • Agile Development a plus


Experience

  • Seasoned Officer with 7+ years experience in Securities Services
  • Worked in Product organizations in prior roles
  • Operated at a global level
  • Prior experience working in Operations and/or technology
  • Consultative experience working with institutional investors
  • Strong team leadership and management skills
  • Track record of solving data integration challenges across complex and at scale services


Outcomes expected from the roles

  • In depth understanding of asset servicing product and related data management;
  • Proactive input and idea generation for product development roadmap
  • Maintain up to date understanding of regulatory headwinds and other industry disruptors and industry bodies that could impact the area
  • Responsible for issue and risk escalation
  • Project /initiative ownership as requested, with appropriate reporting (with PMO) of prioritised and approved change
  • Appropriate governance and audit trail on documentation of all key decisions and actions.


Split Of Role

  • Product Design & Development : 60%
  • Business Analysis : 30%
  • Market / Client interaction : 20%


About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most.
