descriptionHtml:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.

YOUR MISSION:

We are seeking a Director of Engineering - Consumer Experience to lead the technology organisation responsible for delivering exceptional digital experiences across Web and Mobile platforms. This is a horizontal, platform-level leadership role that sets the engineering direction, standards, and quality bar across all consumer-facing products for our Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) business.

You will own the engineering foundation that product teams build upon, including shared platform capabilities, AI-native tooling, frontend standards, and delivery infrastructure. You will lead a lean team of senior engineers and a network of delivery partners to build fast, accessible, and AI-native experiences that delight our consumers. You hold platform adoption authority and co-own the engineering quality bar across the organisation.

As PUMA continues to scale its DTC Engineering organization, our leaders are expected to be visible culture builders. These roles are office-based and require regular in-person collaboration to accelerate decision-making, strengthen team cohesion, foster innovation, and build a world-class engineering capability from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities & Scope of Ownership:

Technology Vision & Strategy

  • Define and drive the multi-year Consumer Experience technology vision, ensuring alignment with DTC business goals and emerging digital trends.
  • Build and communicate a clear technology roadmap covering Web (desktop, PWA) and Native Mobile (iOS, Android) platforms.
  • Champion AI-native engineering paradigm - from AI-assisted development workflows to front-end personalisation and intelligent UX embedded into the engineering culture from day one.
  • Evaluate, select, and govern the technology stack (ReactJS, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Sanity CMS, GraphQL, and emerging tools) to ensure longevity, performance, and developer productivity.

Standards, Governance & Engineering Excellence

  • Establish and enforce engineering standards, coding practices, design systems, accessibility guidelines (WCAG), and performance benchmarks across all consumer-facing touchpoints.
  • Build and own a component library and design system that enables velocity and consistency for all product teams.
  • Define governance frameworks for third-party vendor engagement including contracts, code quality reviews, delivery cadence, and SLA management.
  • Introduce and maintain observability, performance monitoring, and incident management practices for consumer-facing platforms.

UI/UX & Consumer Experience Leadership

  • Partner closely with UX/Design, Product, and Marketing teams to translate consumer insights into technically excellent digital experiences.
  • Own the front-end architecture for responsive, performant, and accessible web experiences and mobile applications.
  • Drive adoption of modern UX engineering practices such as skeleton screens, optimistic UI, progressive enhancement, micro-interactions.
  • Champion performance engineering - page load, rendering optimisation, image delivery, CDN strategy, and headless CMS integration via Sanity.

Team & Vendor Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a lean team of senior engineers while maintaining a high-trust, high-performance culture.
  • Manage and hold accountable delivery partners for quality, timelines, and engineering standards.
  • Partner with Engineering Heads, Product Owners and peer Directors to ensure horizontal services (design systems, shared APIs, performance tooling) are adopted consistently.

YOUR TALENT:

Key Requirements:

  • 15+ years of progressive engineering experience, with 5+ years in a senior engineering leadership role.
  • Deep architectural and implementation expertise in modern front-end engineering: ReactJS, TypeScript, GraphQL (GQL), REST APIs.
  • Proven experience with Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) and headless CMS platforms (Sanity or equivalent).
  • Demonstrable mobile engineering experience across React Native, iOS (Swift), and/or Android (Kotlin).
  • Proven experience in shipping AI and LLM-driven capabilities in consumer-facing products, including real decisions around model selection, latency and cost trade-offs, and what it takes to make these features reliable in production.
  • Track record of building and governing cross-functional engineering platforms used by multiple product teams.
  • Subject matter expertise in modern consumer web standards, specifically web performance (Core Web Vitals), WCAG 2.1 compliance, and progressive web applications.
  • Background in fashion, retail, or sports DTC commerce environments.
  • Experience with composable/headless commerce architectures.
  • Familiarity with APIGEE or API Gateway platforms.
  • Experience with CI/CD, feature flagging, A/B testing frameworks.

Key Technologies:

  • Front-End: ReactJS, TypeScript, Next.js, GraphQL (GQL)
  • Commerce: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC / SFRA / PWA Kit)
  • CMS: Sanity (headless), content modelling
  • Mobile: React Native, iOS, Android
  • APIs & Integration: GraphQL, REST, APIGEE
  • AI/ML: AI-native tooling, LLM integration, AI-assisted development
  • Observability: Performance monitoring, Web Vitals, CDN/edge tooling

Leadership Expectations:

At PUMA, Directors are expected to operate as enterprise leaders who shape strategy, build capability, and create an environment where teams can deliver exceptional outcomes at speed and scale. Successful leaders combine commercial acumen, technical excellence, and people leadership while embodying the mindset and behaviours that define PUMA's culture.

Strategic Thinking & Vision

  • Translate ambitious business goals into clear, executable technology strategies and roadmaps.
  • Demonstrate the courage to challenge conventional thinking and advocate for innovative solutions that create long-term value.
  • Operate effectively in ambiguity, providing clarity, direction, and confidence for teams and stakeholders.
  • Balance immediate business priorities with long-term scalability, sustainability, and consumer impact.

Ownership & Accountability

  • Take end-to-end ownership of outcomes, driving execution with determination and a relentless focus on results.
  • Set high standards for quality, reliability, and operational excellence while fostering a culture of accountability.
  • Navigate setbacks and changing priorities with resilience, maintaining momentum through complexity and uncertainty.
  • Make difficult decisions when required and stand behind them with conviction and integrity.

People & Team Leadership

  • Build, develop, and retain diverse, high-performing teams capable of delivering at scale.
  • Foster an environment of trust, inclusion, collaboration, and mutual respect where individuals can thrive.
  • Create opportunities for learning, growth, and continuous development while empowering teams with autonomy and accountability.
  • Celebrate successes, recognise contributions, and cultivate a culture where high performance and enjoyment go hand in hand.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong partnerships across Product, Design, Data, Marketing, Operations, and Business teams to achieve shared outcomes.
  • Influence effectively across all levels of the organisation through credibility, transparency, and strong communication.

descriptionHtml:
01

Why this exists

What if the app that handles your home's money actually understood how homes work?

The Indian consumer payments stack is functionally solved. UPI works. Wallets work. What's not solved is how money actually moves between the people who live together — flatmates settling rent and groceries, partners managing a shared household, families coordinating around staff and bills and birthday gifts. The everyday money inside an Indian home is still a WhatsApp message and a mental note.

Fave is the bet that this changes — and that the company that wins shared money becomes the operating layer for a generation of Indian consumers.

We've built the beta. Real users, real spend, real signal. Now we need someone to own the product as it scales.

02

The role

You'd own the product end-to-end. Strategy, roadmap, ship cadence, the whole thing.

There's no PM org to inherit — you'll build it. There's no playbook for what we're doing — you'll write it. You'll partner with strong, opinionated peers leading engineering and marketing/design who already know the product cold. The job is to bring product judgment to a team that has nearly everything else.

This is not a managerial role with an IC ladder underneath it. You'll lead, but you'll also build. You'll write specs you actually want to write. You'll prototype a feature before scoping it out. You'll ship a thing on a weekend because you couldn't stop thinking about it. The day you stop contributing individually is the day this role stops working.

What you'll spend time on:

→ Cross-functional leadership. Drive alignment with engineering, design, marketing, and BD — without managing them. The hardest part of this job is moving a team you don't own toward a north star they help define.

→ Knowing the customer better than anyone in the room. Live in the segment. Talk to users constantly. Understand the social, financial, and behavioural texture of how young Indians live and spend together. Customer obsession isn't a value here, it's a daily practice.

→ Combining insight and analytics to make agile decisions. You move between qualitative signal and quantitative truth fluently. You don't wait for the perfect dashboard, and you don't shoot from the hip. You triangulate.

→ Running the experimentation engine. Define hypotheses, design tests, decide what's instrumented, call results honestly. The team should ship 5–10 experiments a month, and you should be able to defend every one of them.

→ Owning activation and retention. The cohort retention number is the north star. You live with it, and you're accountable for it.

→ Defining what we build — and what we don't. The hardest call in a product like this isn't "what's possible." It's "what's next." That's yours.

→ Building the product team. First hires within 90 days. Roughly five PMs in 12 months. You'll set the bar.

→ Carrying the product story. Internally to leadership, externally to partners, candidates, and the press. The story matters as much as the product.

03

Who we're looking for

The best product leaders we've worked with don't reach for a 2x2 when the road forks. They look at the product, the users, the team — and they have a view. They hold it well. They change it when the evidence shifts. They don't perform conviction. They have it.

They've also never stopped doing the work. They write the spec, they sit in the user interview, they sketch the flow, they argue the metric definition. The title says "lead" but the day-to-day says "builder."

Must-have

→ Built consumer products people use repeatedly. Mobile-first, high-frequency, habit-forming products are ideal.

→ Strong product judgment across insight, UX, metrics, and prioritisation. You can move from user conversations to flows to cohort reads to roadmap calls without outsourcing the hard thinking.

→ Early-stage product instincts. You know the difference between optimising a working funnel and finding the wedge before the funnel exists.

→ Hands-on builder energy. You can write a sharp spec, sketch a flow, run a user interview, define an experiment, and make the call when signal is messy.

→ Ability to build the product function. You've hired, mentored, or raised the bar for PMs before — even if the team was small.

→ Built inside a startup. You've operated in a small, fast-paced team where speed, ambiguity, and direct ownership were the defaults. You don't need structure to do your best work — you create it.

Strong signals

→ You've built a product where growth came from the product loop itself, not just paid marketing.

→ You understand Indian consumer behaviour — especially how young people, couples, flatmates, and families coordinate money.

→ You've worked on social, fintech, commerce, payments, or other coordination-heavy products.

→ You've operated in a regulated or high-trust environment.

→ You use AI tools every day to increase the leverage of a small team.

→ You have unusually strong taste in product, copy, interaction design, and consumer storytelling.

Not required

→ A fintech background.

→ A big-company product title.

→ Experience managing a large PM org.

Overview

We are the Windows Servicing and Delivery (WSD) organization, dedicated to keeping over 1.8 billion Windows devices secure and productive by delivering timely updates and innovations to all versions of Windows. Our work helps to protect users and their mission critical infrastructure in a fast-changing security landscape. We create and support new business opportunities across Microsoft, especially with the large and growing Windows installation base. We build delightful experiences for our customers and build products and solutions to empower our commercial and enterprise customers to keep their devices secure, compliant and up to date with latest innovations in Windows.

This Princiapl Lead Technical Program Manager (TPM) role represents an opportunity to develop and operate a massive at-scale service, to protect customers and Microsoft cloud infrastructure while also building and supporting new businesses and business growth across the company. You will lead a high performing team, responsible for keeping our customer base secure, improving the reliability of the platform, addressing customer reported issues, building data insights, and developing features to light up new scenarios and devices in the Windows ecosystem. This is truly a “protect the planet” role!  .

The candidate is a technical leader who can bring the best of a very talented group of technical and passionate people across the globe, and is able to attract, develop, and grow talent through empathy and clear accountability. As an AI-First leader, you incorporate and coach your team on the responsible and effective application of AI-assisted methodologies throughout engineering execution and product management.

We value passion, creativity, drive, agility, accountability, and desire to learn new complex technical areas. Our customers are at the heart of everything we do, and delivering exceptional Windows experiences is our top priority. Their excitement fuels our passion for building high-quality solutions. If you're excited about building world-class teams, thrive on solving tough problems, and are driven by customer impact, we would love to hear from you. 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

  • Attract, lead and develop and retain top talent. Leading and growing a great team of Technical Program Managers and Product Managers and helping to define team culture.
  • You will facilitate the integration of AI-enabled tools, automation, and data-driven insights to enhance product strategy, customer understanding, prioritization, decision-making, engineering efficiency, incident response, quality and customer outcomes, all while maintaining security, privacy, and compliance standards.
  • Drive the long-term vision, strategy, and roadmap for a portfolio of products, aligning cross-functional teams and senior leadership to deliver high-impact business outcomes.
  • Driving efficiency and quality into engineering processes in partnership with the engineering leads.       
  • Foster effective partnerships with teams across the company by aligning, defining, and measuring common goals.
  • Use data to influence & drive decisions.
  • Set priorities for engineering based on a deep understanding of the broader Windows ecosystem and customer scenarios.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 12+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development.
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 2+ year(s) project or people management experience.
  • 3+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
  • Ability to build trust with internal and external partners through quality delivery and integrity.
  • Ability to handle critical situations with confidence, directing the team towards effective response. 
  • Demonstrating the ability to learn and apply learning to improve business outcomes, positive impact for the team and self. 
  • Growth mindset by demonstrating the willingness to be open to new ideas with the ability to lead others along.
  • Proven track record of going technically deep and delivering cloud-scale technologies.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 12+ years experience engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development.
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years people management experience.
  • 5+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
  • 1+ year(s) of experience reading and/or writing code (e.g., sample documentation, product demos).

  • Can influence clients, stakeholders, and teams.
  • Raises the quality of everyone around them.
  • Uses AI as a force multiplier for thinking, research, prototyping, and execution.
  • Understands how AI is reshaping customer behaviour, products, and businesses.
  • Takes ownership, stays curious, and never stops learning.


Your Mission


You will lead some of the most important work inside the company. You will:


  • Own product strategy and experience direction for large engagements.
  • Turn ambiguous client problems into clear product opportunities.
  • Work directly with founders, enterprise CXOs, designers, and engineers.
  • Mentor teams and raise the quality of product thinking across the company.
  • Help enterprises rethink products and experiences for an AI-native future.
  • Shape intelligent experiences where AI enhances customer outcomes and business performance.
  • Drive adoption, retention, and measurable business outcomes, not just design outputs.


What Success Looks Like After 12 months


  • Clients trust your judgement without needing founder intervention.
  • Designers seek your guidance because you consistently improve their work.
  • Projects become sharper, faster, and more outcome-driven.
  • You uncover product and AI opportunities others miss.
  • You become a force multiplier for both the company and our clients.

What We Do Care About


  • Product thinking.
  • Leadership.
  • Systems thinking.
  • Business understanding.
  • Communication.
  • Curiosity.
  • Craft.
  • AI fluency.
  • AI-native ways of working.


What We Don't Care About


  • Fancy process without impact.
  • UX buzzwords.
  • Portfolios that only showcase visuals.
  • Waiting for instructions.
  • Blaming clients, developers, or stakeholders.


3 Great Reasons To Work With Us


We are small but global. Our multidisciplinary team has worked in Mumbai, Barcelona, London, Stockholm, and Tokyo. Get it right, and you'll work with some of the best talent in the world. To us, people are everything. Your growth is as important to us as it is to you. While we don't have beer taps (yet!), we've created a restriction-free, high-energy environment where people can do their best work. Our larger purpose? We believe design and technology can contribute to a better life and a better India. Our ultimate goal is to harness creativity for national development while pursuing excellence in both arts and technology.


Benefits @ BOMBAYDC


  • Stay close to your family: Work for up to 2 weeks each year from your hometown if you've relocated to Mumbai.
  • Breathe easy with lesser travel: If your commute exceeds 60 minutes one way, you can work from home every Tuesday and Thursday after confirmation.
  • We protect your Grey Matter: Our HR team is always available to support, listen, and counsel whenever needed.
  • Winter Break: Enjoy an extended year-end break to spend quality time with family and recharge.
  • Extended Long Weekends: We thoughtfully design our holiday calendar to give you more opportunities to unwind.
  • Caregiver Leave: Take time off or work remotely when family members need your care during medical emergencies.
  • We Invest in You: Through learning subsidies, mentorship opportunities, and direct access to founders.
  • We Appreciate Performance: Through Project Excellence Awards and milestone celebrations throughout your journey with us.

Who This Role Is Perfect For


  • Someone who has spent years designing products and now wants a bigger canvas.
  • Someone who wants influence, ownership, and responsibility.
  • Someone who wants to help build the next generation of intelligent digital products.
  • Someone who could eventually become a Pod Head, Associate Partner, or future leader within BOMBAYDC.


Self-Test


If you read this and thought:


  • That's exactly how I think.
  • I already operate this way.
  • I want more ownership than my current role gives me.
  • I care more about solving problems


We should talk

descriptionHtml:
Director of Product Marketing

Location: Chennai, India (On-site)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Department: Product Marketing

Reports To: Managing Director


About ExpertusOne:

ExpertusOne is an enterprise Learning Management System (LMS) that helps organizations deliver, manage, and measure workforce learning at scale. Our platform serves global enterprises across compliance training, employee development, extended enterprise learning, certifications, classroom training, content management, eCommerce, analytics, AI-powered learning experiences, and more.


As we continue to expand our market presence, we are seeking a strategic and execution-focused Director of Product Marketing to define our product positioning, sharpen our messaging, support revenue growth, and serve as the bridge between Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing.


Role Overview:

The Director of Product Marketing will own the positioning, messaging, go-to-market strategy, competitive intelligence, analyst relations support, sales enablement, and product storytelling for the ExpertusOne platform.


This role requires a unique combination of strategic thinking, market insight, customer empathy, product understanding, and commercial acumen. The successful candidate will work closely with Product Management, Business Solutions Group (BSG), Sales, Pre-Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Executive Leadership to ensure that ExpertusOne's value proposition is clearly communicated and differentiated in the market.


The ideal candidate understands enterprise SaaS, B2B technology marketing, and preferably the Learning & Development (L&D), Talent Development, HR Technology, or Learning Management System market.


Key Responsibilities:


Product Positioning & Messaging

  • Define and continuously refine ExpertusOne's positioning, messaging, and value propositions.
  • Create differentiated messaging for:
  • Enterprise LMS
  • Compliance Training
  • Certifications
  • Skills Development
  • AI-Powered Learning
  • Content Authoring
  • Learning Analytics
  • Extended Enterprise Learning
  • Commerce & Training Monetization
  • Develop messaging tailored to:
  • CLOs
  • HR Leaders
  • L&D Leaders
  • Operations Leaders
  • Compliance Teams
  • Training Administrators
  • Executive Buyers
  • Build messaging frameworks and narrative strategies for new product releases and strategic initiatives.


Go-To-Market Strategy

  • Lead go-to-market planning for product launches, feature releases, platform enhancements, and strategic initiatives.
  • Develop launch plans that align Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams.
  • Create launch readiness programs and internal communication plans.
  • Establish launch success metrics and measure business impact.


Product & Market Intelligence

  • Conduct market research and identify emerging trends within:
  • Learning Management Systems
  • Learning Experience Platforms
  • Skills-Based Learning
  • AI in Learning
  • Workforce Development
  • Compliance Training
  • HR Technology
  • Maintain detailed competitive intelligence on major LMS and learning technology vendors.
  • Develop battle cards, competitor comparisons, win/loss insights, and market analysis reports.
  • Provide strategic recommendations to Product Management based on market feedback.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner closely with,

Product Management

  • Translate product capabilities into customer-facing value.
  • Influence product roadmap decisions using market insights.
  • Support product launch planning and release communications.


Sales

  • Develop sales enablement assets and value-based selling materials.
  • Equip sales teams with competitive differentiation and messaging.
  • Support strategic opportunities and executive presentations.


Pre-Sales / Solutions Consulting

  • Build demonstration narratives and use-case-driven storytelling.
  • Create industry-specific solution positioning.
  • Assist in high-value opportunities and RFP responses.


Business Solutions Group (BSG)

  • Align solution messaging with customer business outcomes.
  • Support enterprise proposals and strategic account pursuits.
  • Develop solution-specific positioning frameworks.


Customer Success

  • Capture customer success stories and business outcomes.
  • Create case studies, references, and customer advocacy programs.
  • Support customer expansion and adoption initiatives.


Corporate Marketing

  • Align demand generation activities with product positioning.
  • Support campaigns, webinars, events, analyst programs, and thought leadership initiatives.


Sales Enablement

  • Own the creation and maintenance of:
  • Sales decks
  • Product presentations
  • Solution briefs
  • One-pagers
  • Battle cards
  • Competitive matrices
  • ROI messaging
  • Value proposition frameworks
  • Train sales and pre-sales teams on product positioning and market differentiation.
  • Develop industry-specific and persona-specific sales assets.


Analyst & Thought Leadership Support

  • Support relationships with industry analysts and market influencers.
  • Contribute to analyst briefings and evaluation submissions.
  • Develop thought leadership content around:
  • Learning Technology
  • AI in Learning
  • Skills Transformation
  • Workforce Development
  • Compliance Training
  • Represent ExpertusOne at industry events, webinars, conferences, and customer forums.


Customer & Voice-of-Market Programs

  • Build programs to gather customer insights and market feedback.
  • Conduct customer interviews and persona research.
  • Lead win/loss analysis initiatives.
  • Translate customer insights into actionable recommendations.


Success Metrics

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Product adoption growth
  • Pipeline influence and contribution
  • Launch effectiveness
  • Sales enablement effectiveness
  • Win-rate improvements
  • Competitive win performance
  • Analyst and market visibility
  • Customer engagement and advocacy growth
  • Messaging consistency across customer touchpoints


Required Qualifications:


Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Technology, Engineering, or related field.
  • MBA preferred.


Experience

  • 15–18+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience.
  • 5+ years in Product Marketing leadership roles.
  • Experience marketing enterprise software platforms.
  • Demonstrated ownership of product positioning, messaging, and GTM strategy.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product Management and Sales organizations.
  • Experience supporting enterprise sales cycles and complex buying committees.


Preferred Industry Experience

Strong preference for experience in one or more of:

  • Learning Management Systems (LMS)
  • Learning Experience Platforms (LXP)
  • Talent Management
  • HR Technology
  • Workforce Development Platforms
  • Enterprise SaaS Platforms
  • Employee Experience Platforms


Required Skills & Competencies:


Strategic Skills

  • Product positioning and messaging
  • Go-to-market strategy
  • Market segmentation
  • Competitive intelligence
  • Pricing and packaging support
  • Analyst relations support


Commercial Skills

  • Enterprise B2B sales enablement
  • Value-based selling
  • Solution marketing
  • Executive communication
  • Customer storytelling


Analytical Skills

  • Market research
  • Win/loss analysis
  • Customer insights
  • Performance measurement
  • Data-driven decision making


Communication Skills

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication
  • Executive presentation skills
  • Thought leadership content creation
  • Workshop facilitation


Leadership Skills

  • Cross-functional leadership
  • Stakeholder management
  • Project management
  • Team mentoring and development


Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate:

  • Has marketed enterprise SaaS products to HR, L&D, Compliance, or Operations leaders.
  • Can convert complex product capabilities into compelling business value.
  • Understands how enterprise software is evaluated, purchased, and expanded.
  • Is comfortable engaging with executives, prospects, customers, analysts, and internal stakeholders.
  • Can influence without authority and drive alignment across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.
  • Brings both strategic thinking and hands-on execution capability.
  • Thrives in a fast-growing product organization where market differentiation and customer value are critical.


Why Join ExpertusOne?

  • Help shape the future of enterprise learning and workforce development.
  • Lead product marketing for a mature enterprise SaaS platform with global customers.
  • Work directly with Product, Sales, and Executive Leadership on company strategy.
  • Drive AI-powered learning innovation and next-generation learning experiences.
  • Build and scale the product marketing function during a high-growth phase.

 

Location Requirement: This role is based in Chennai and requires full-time, on-site presence. Occasional travel may be required for customer meetings, industry events, and company initiatives.


Interested candidates can apply this job post, suitable candidates will be scheduled for the interview.


All the very best!


Warm Regards,

Kannan Lakshmanan

Kenvue Is Currently Recruiting For a

Lead Product Owner

What We Do

At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent.

Who We Are

Our global team is ~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated. We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. For more information, click here.

Role Reports To

Product Manager

Location:

Asia Pacific, India, Karnataka, Bangalore

Work Location:

Hybrid

What You Will Do

Kenvue is currently recruiting for:

Lead Product Owner, Data Products

This position reports into Principal Solutions Architect, Global Data Products and is based in GCC, Bengaluru.

What You Will Do

As a Lead Product Owner, you will be responsible for leading the development and deployment of data-driven products powered by digital, artificial intelligence and analytics technologies. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, software engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to define product vision, strategy, and execution.

Responsibilities

  • Product Vision and Strategy: Collaborate with stakeholders to define the product vision, goals, and roadmap for Digital, Data and AI products that align with business objectives.
  • Requirements Gathering: Work closely with business units to understand their needs and translate them into clear and actionable product requirements.
  • Data Management: Oversee data collection, storage, and preprocessing to ensure data quality and availability for training and model deployment.
  • Machine Learning Models: Coordinate with data scientists and ML engineers to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models that power AI data products.
  • Product Development: Lead the end-to-end product development process, including design, development, testing, and deployment of AI data products.
  • Performance Monitoring: Establish metrics and tracking mechanisms to measure the performance and impact of AI data products.
  • Product Iteration and Improvement: Continuously iterate and improve data products based on user feedback and performance insights.
  • Market Analysis: Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and stay abreast of industry trends.

Required Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experiences with a Bachelor's degree; or 5 years and a Master degree in Business or Information management systems (MIS); or a PhD with 5 years of experiences in the field of Technology, Computer/Software Engineering, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics etc.
  • 3+ years of experience working in CPG/Retail industry and sound knowledge in business/data domains related to Customer, Product, Consumer, Finance etc.
  • Proven experience in product management, preferably with a focus on data-driven products and AI technologies.
  • Understand business requirements and translate to Conceptual (CDM), Logical (LDM) and Physical (PDM) data model by using industry standards.
  • Familiarity with machine learning concepts, algorithms, and model deployment.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to lead cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in data analysis, visualization, and data-driven decision-making and proficiency in writing SQL Queries.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Understanding of data privacy and security considerations in AI product development.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies is a plus.
  • Experience working in Data Governance, Metadata Management, Data Catalog and Business Glossary.

If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

Why Join Iris?

Are you ready to do the best work of your career at one of India’s Top 25 Best Workplaces in IT industry? Do you want to grow in an award-winning culture that truly values your talent and ambitions?

Join Iris Software — one of the fastest-growing IT services companies — where you own and shape your success story.

About Us

At Iris Software, our vision is to be our client’s most trusted technology partner, and the first choice for the industry’s top professionals to realize their full potential.

With over 4,300 associates across India, U.S.A, and Canada, we help our enterprise clients thrive with technology-enabled transformation across financial services, healthcare, transportation & logistics, and professional services.

Our work covers complex, mission-critical applications with the latest technologies, such as high-value complex Application & Product Engineering, Data & Analytics, Cloud, DevOps, Data & MLOps, Quality Engineering, and Business Automation.

Working with Us

At Iris, every role is more than a job — it’s a launchpad for growth.

Our Employee Value Proposition, “Build Your Future. Own Your Journey.” reflects our belief that people thrive when they have ownership of their career and the right opportunities to shape it.

We foster a culture where your potential is valued, your voice matters, and your work creates real impact. With cutting-edge projects, personalized career development, continuous learning and mentorship, we support you to grow and become your best — both personally and professionally.

Curious what it’s like to work at Iris? Head to this video for an inside look at the people, the passion, and the possibilities. Watch it here.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Strategy and Vision
  • Define and communicate the long-term vision and strategic roadmap for the core platform, encompassing infrastructure, shared services, common frameworks, developer tools, and security standards.
  • Act as the voice of the internal customer (other Product Teams, Engineering Teams, DevOps) to understand their dependency needs, pain points, and requirements for performance, scalability, and resilience.
  • Analyze market trends in platform technology (e.g., Cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Observability) to ensure the platform remains modern, cost-effective, and competitive.

  • Serve as the primary liaison between the Platform Engineering team and the consuming Product Teams.
  • Manage communication and dependencies across multiple technical teams, clearly articulating platform capabilities, upcoming changes, and migration paths.

  • Conduct internal demos and training to socialize new platform features and drive adoption across the organization.

Required Qualifications & Skills

descriptionHtml:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

Product Owner – Administration and Permission Management

 

Anaplan is looking for a passionate Product Owner to help drive the development of our next generation Planning and Decision Excellence platform. This person will be based in India and be instrumental in the execution of our product strategy. The role will focus on the Administration and Permission Management areas of the Anaplan Platform.

Applicants should have a Product Ownership background and ideally relevant experience with Anaplan or other equivalent solutions. Applicants would bring experience working with engineering teams to deliver products and solutions to the market, they would have to demonstrate that they will be able to learn a new market and understand the needs of our customers related to the management of SAAS platform for large enterprises.

 

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

 

  • Work with the existing product team to define and drive the vision and roadmap for Platform Management features in Anaplan.
  • Work with the Product leadership, UX, Engineering and other cross-functional teams on roadmap and capacity planning
  • Work closely with engineering leaders and teams to execute on day-to-day development, taking direct ownership of the backlog.
  • Understand the market for Enterprise Software in general and Anaplan specifically. Be the voice of the customer while understanding the competitive Landscape. Be able to define and segment users of the Anaplan platform qualitatively and quantitatively.
  • Drive end-to-end experiences: writing user stories with clear acceptance criteria, working with UX to create prototypes for usability testing and research, working with engineering, documentation, support, and marketing to deliver quality experiences.
  • Effectively collaborate across global teams to create alignment between engineering teams and other product stakeholders.

 

REQUIREMENTS

 

  • Proven experience working as a Product Owner in a technology-driven environment, preferably with experience in SaaS or enterprise software companies.
  • Strong understanding of IT Governance, Separation of Duties, and the expectations of Enterprise IT and Security Teams with respect to SAAS Platforms.
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization practices in Enterprise IT (e.g. RBAC, Service Users, SSO, SAML, SCIM).
  • Strong understanding of typical API usage patterns within Enterprise IT
  • Domain knowledge of Anaplan solutions if possible
  • Strong understanding of the product management lifecycle and launching new products
  • Proficiency in gathering and analysing market and customer insights.
  • Ability to translate customer needs into actionable product requirements.
  • Experience working in an Agile development environment and familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence, etc.
  • Experience in creating enablement documentation including technical & support style documents
  • Excellent organizational skills and experience in managing projects with multiple stakeholders to ensure successful product delivery
  • Highly analytical and able to troubleshoot issues quickly; candidates should be able to go from high level to low level very easily
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Team player with the ability to work autonomously
  • Able and willing to work in a fast paced, quickly changing environment

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

Why Join Iris?

Are you ready to do the best work of your career at one of India’s Top 25 Best Workplaces in IT industry? Do you want to grow in an award-winning culture that truly values your talent and ambitions?

Join Iris Software — one of the fastest-growing IT services companies — where you own and shape your success story.

About Us

At Iris Software, our vision is to be our client’s most trusted technology partner, and the first choice for the industry’s top professionals to realize their full potential.

With over 4,300 associates across India, U.S.A, and Canada, we help our enterprise clients thrive with technology-enabled transformation across financial services, healthcare, transportation & logistics, and professional services.

Our work covers complex, mission-critical applications with the latest technologies, such as high-value complex Application & Product Engineering, Data & Analytics, Cloud, DevOps, Data & MLOps, Quality Engineering, and Business Automation.

Working with Us

At Iris, every role is more than a job — it’s a launchpad for growth.

Our Employee Value Proposition, “Build Your Future. Own Your Journey.” reflects our belief that people thrive when they have ownership of their career and the right opportunities to shape it.

We foster a culture where your potential is valued, your voice matters, and your work creates real impact. With cutting-edge projects, personalized career development, continuous learning and mentorship, we support you to grow and become your best — both personally and professionally.

Curious what it’s like to work at Iris? Head to this video for an inside look at the people, the passion, and the possibilities. Watch it here.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Strategy and Vision
  • Define and communicate the long-term vision and strategic roadmap for the core platform, encompassing infrastructure, shared services, common frameworks, developer tools, and security standards.
  • Act as the voice of the internal customer (other Product Teams, Engineering Teams, DevOps) to understand their dependency needs, pain points, and requirements for performance, scalability, and resilience.
  • Analyze market trends in platform technology (e.g., Cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Observability) to ensure the platform remains modern, cost-effective, and competitive.
  • Define Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) for the platform, focusing on technical metrics like developer velocity, system reliability, security compliance, and cost efficiency.
  • Platform Development and Prioritization
  • Manage, groom, and prioritize the Platform Backlog, translating architectural epics, technical debt, and cross-cutting requirements into clear user stories with defined acceptance criteria.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog refinement, stand-ups, reviews) for the Platform Engineering team.
  • Balance conflicting priorities between immediate feature delivery support, critical security patches, and necessary long-term architectural investment (technical debt repayment).
  • Collaborate with the Chief Architect and Engineering Leads to ensure all platform development aligns with the overall Enterprise Architecture.
  • Accept or reject completed stories based on the Definition of Done, ensuring high standards for code quality, documentation, security, and operational readiness.
  • Stakeholder Management and Communication
  • Serve as the primary liaison between the Platform Engineering team and the consuming Product Teams.
  • Manage communication and dependencies across multiple technical teams, clearly articulating platform capabilities, upcoming changes, and migration paths.
  • Create and maintain high-quality documentation (APIs, integration guides, service catalog) to accelerate adoption and reduce cognitive load for dependent teams.
  • Conduct internal demos and training to socialize new platform features and drive adoption across the organization.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience
  • 5+ years of experience in software development, engineering management, or product ownership in a technical domain.
  • 3+ years specifically serving as a Product Owner or Technical Lead for a platform, infrastructure, or shared services team.
  • Proven experience working with complex, distributed systems (Microservices, APIs) and Cloud-Native technologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Technical Fluency
  • Strong understanding of modern DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and service meshes.
  • Working knowledge of core platform components such as API Gateways, identity management (OAuth/OpenID), monitoring (Observability), and container orchestration (Kubernetes/Docker).
  • Ability to read, understand, and discuss technical designs, architectural diagrams, and trade-offs with Principal Engineers.

Mandatory Competencies

BA - Business Analyst - Requirement Gathering

BA - Business Analyst - GAP Analysis

BA - Business Analyst - SWOT Analysis

BA - SQL

BA - Business Analyst - Business Process Modelling

Beh - Communication and collaboration

About Jll Technologies

JLL Technologies (JLLT) is the technology and data science engine of JLL, one of the world's leading commercial real estate services firms. JLLT builds intelligent, connected, and sustainable workplace solutions powered by proprietary platforms, data products, and AI. The Workplace Management (WPM) Transformation Program is redefining how JLL and its clients operate facilities — embedding real-time insights and AI-powered automation into day-to-day workplace operations.

THE ROLE

We need a product manager who builds things. Not someone who writes strategy decks and hands them over — someone who opens a laptop, fires up a model, strings together an agent, and ships something by end of day. This Director of Product Management role owns the product for Workplace OS, JLL's next-generation workplace management platform, and will be measured by what gets built and whether it works.

You will define features, write specs, experiment with AI tools, prototype workflows, and work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and designers to turn ideas into product. You are energized by the pace of AI development and have a habit of testing new models, frameworks, and tools before anyone tells you to. You hold strong opinions about what makes a great product experience but know that the right answer often comes from trying things — not from more meetings.

What You Will Do

Ship Product

  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for core Workplace OS capabilities — from discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Write clear, detailed product specs and acceptance criteria that engineers can actually build from, including edge cases, error states, and AI output handling.
  • Sit in engineering standups, participate in sprint reviews, and stay close enough to the code to catch problems before they ship.
  • Manage the backlog with discipline: prioritize ruthlessly, cut scope when necessary, and keep the team focused on what matters most.

Experiment Aggressively with AI

  • Prototype new AI-powered features yourself — using tools like Claude, GPT-4o, Cursor, or whatever the current best tool is for the job.
  • Test and evaluate LLMs, agentic frameworks, and automation tools to inform build vs. buy decisions with real evidence.
  • Design and iterate on agentic workflows for workplace operations: safety conversations, compliance tracking, participation nudging, facilities incident routing.
  • Define the human-in-the-loop escalation paths, confidence thresholds, and guardrails that make AI features safe to put in front of real users.
  • Stay current on the AI landscape — not as a hobby, but as a professional obligation. You should know what shipped last week and whether it matters for what we're building.

Drive Clarity from Ambiguity

  • Translate fuzzy business problems and operational pain points into precise product requirements and testable hypotheses.
  • Work directly with Facilities Managers, Account Directors, and HSSE leads to understand what actually breaks in the field — and design for it.
  • Define success metrics for every feature before it ships, and own the post-launch review to determine whether the feature worked.
  • Identify open questions early, flag them loudly, and drive to resolution rather than letting them become blockers mid-sprint.

Collaborate Across the Stack

  • Partner with engineering leads, data scientists, and ML engineers as a peer — not a client. Understand the technical constraints and work within them creatively.
  • Work with design to produce experiences that are simple enough for a Facility Manager to use on their phone between walkthroughs.
  • Coordinate with implementation and customer success to ensure features land well in the field, not just in the demo.
  • Communicate clearly up to VP and executive stakeholders — turn technical progress into business narrative without losing the substance.

Required

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 7+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in enterprise SaaS, platform products, or operational technology.
  • A genuine, demonstrable hands-on relationship with AI tools — you have built things using LLMs, agents, or AI-powered automation in the last 12 months.
  • Technical fluency: you can read an API spec, understand a data schema, review a system design, and have a substantive conversation with an engineer about why something is hard.
  • A track record of shipping product in complex organizations — navigating ambiguity, managing stakeholders, and keeping a team moving.
  • Strong written communication: specs, PRDs, executive updates, and user-facing copy should all be in your range.
  • Comfort with fast iteration — you prefer small bets and rapid feedback loops over long planning cycles.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks or MCP server integrations.
  • Familiarity with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem: Teams, SharePoint, Power Platform, Azure AD.
  • Background in workplace technology, facilities management, IoT, or building operations.
  • Experience designing AI features for regulated or safety-sensitive environments, including audit trails, explainability requirements, and escalation logic.
  • You have a GitHub account with actual commits, a side project running on a cloud function, or a portfolio of things you have personally built or prototyped.

What Good Looks Like In This Role

In 30 days: You understand the Workplace OS platform, the WPM program priorities, and the open product questions. You have shipped at least one small thing.

In 90 days: You own the backlog. You have prototyped at least one AI-powered workflow, gathered feedback from real users, and revised it. Engineering trusts your specs.

In 6 months: You have a track record of delivery. You have improved the AI capabilities of at least one core feature. The team ships faster because of how you work.

What We Offer

  • A product role with real scope — you will own something that matters and see it used in real buildings by real people.
  • Direct access to the VP of Product Management and a seat at the table on WPM program strategy.
  • A genuine culture of experimentation — you will not need to ask permission to try things.
  • Flexible work environment. Remote/hybrid work with a global team across AMER, EMEA, and APAC.
  • Budget for AI tools, research, and ongoing learning — we want you sharp.

About CleanHarbors

Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim.

Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 25,000 employees and has over 750 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.

Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.

Job Title: Product Owner

Experience: 12+ Years with Min 5 years as Product Owner

Location: Hyderabad, Hybrid

Working Hours: 12.00pm to 9.00pm

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to implement new features and improvements
  • Understands UX/UI components, wire-framing elements and design. Knowledge of Figma. Lucid, etc..
  • Apply prompt engineering techniques for wireframing and design.
  • Excellent verbal/written communication skills and presenting ideas in group setting.
  • Prior experience with Atlassian products including JIRA and Confluence
  • Authors Epics and Stories with detailed acceptance criteria for enhancement requests that address stakeholder business problems
  • Works closely with delivery teams & business analysts to translate business requirements into workable product backlogs
  • Partners closely with the Scrum Masters on sprint planning, including prioritizing stories that have the highest business value and are aligned with enterprise standards and business roadmaps.
  • Use lean, iterative experiments and low-fidelity prototyping to find signal, validate hypothesis, and iterate before moving to scale
  • Collaborate with partners to define end-state architecture and drive secure, resilient, performant, and scalable technology solutions
  • Assess opportunities for reusing enterprise solutions and build new platforms with enterprise scalability in mind
  • Develop and maintain an appropriately prioritized backlog of user stories for implementation. A keen curiosity about emerging tools and technologies
  • Understands the enterprise IT processes and works closely with stakeholders to identify appropriate solutions to business problems.
  • Determines scope, estimates work effort, and determines duration of development activities.
  • Designs solutions to meet business requirements and works in close coordination with architects and delivery leads to drive solutions to production
  • Owns and updates the product vision and roadmaps.
  • Collaborates with the agile team to prepare the estimates for the user stories within the product backlog.
  • Conducts the formal review and acceptance of user stories implemented by the agile team within a sprint.
  • Drives the execution of user acceptance testing (UAT) activities with support from business and technology team members.
  • Provides daily support to the application / Product platform; including, integrations and administration

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Technology Product Owner in developing tech platforms for underwriting, and policy lifecycle processes or Insurtech, with a solid understanding of insurance products, processes, and customer needs.
  • Demonstrate ability to combine deep business and product knowledge with technical know-how
  • Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies and experience working within cross-functional Agile teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at various levels.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on delivering user-centered products.
  • Ability to independently plan deliverables and coordinate with team-members.
  • Team player - friendly, communicative, open, honest, thoughtful, and committed.
  • Ability to work cooperatively with others, sharing ideas, collaborating and ultimately, putting team goals first.
  • Experience mentoring and coaching others
  • Demonstrated documentation experience in creating rich content that explains business requirements – usage of various documentation tools is a must

Recommended Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software or other Technical degree.
  • 10+ experience in IT field, 5+ years minimum working as a Product Owner in IT field, with at least 3+ years as Technology Product Owner.
  • Demonstrated experience with building software products using agile methodologies.

  • AI‑enabled design & discovery: Leverage AI-powered design and product tools (e.g., AI-assisted UX/design platforms, analytics, and prototyping tools) to refine user journeys, accelerate discovery, validate product hypotheses, and translate business needs into well-defined epics and user stories.
  • Driving AI‑informed product development: Lead product development discussions using data- and AI-driven insights (e.g., predictive analytics, usage intelligence, automation opportunities) to prioritize backlog, guide architectural trade-offs, and align cross-functional teams on value-driven outcomes.

  • Works with Stakeholders to understand their business process requirements and assists them with enhancement requests for ServiceNow

  • Collaborates with the agile team to prepare the estimates for the user stories within the product backlog.

  • Drives the execution of user acceptance testing (UAT) activities with support from business and technology team members.
  • Provides daily support to the application / Product platform; including, integrations and administration
